"""The revised mechanism is not that raw EPS-to-revenue surprise elasticity is itself a durable operating-leverage estimate. Instead, it isolates the residual between delivered EPS news and the EPS implication of pre-release consensus co-revisions, then trades it only when contemporaneous operating-margin, cash-conversion, and working-capital evidence support the residual's sign. The expected continuation arises when analysts must revise profitability and cash-realization assumptions after a report, while the completed report-day return indicates that the directional implication was not already fully absorbed."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _finite_mask(*frames: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return the aligned mask on which every supplied numeric frame is finite."""
    mask = pd.DataFrame(True, index=frames[0].index, columns=frames[0].columns)
    for frame in frames:
        mask = mask & frame.notna() & np.isfinite(frame)
    return mask


def _carry_post_close_events(event_score: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Carry a report-day score from the next bar through the sixth bar."""
    carried = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=event_score.index, columns=event_score.columns)
    for lag in range(1, 7):
        decay = 1.0 - (lag - 1) / 6.0
        carried = carried + event_score.shift(lag).fillna(0.0) * decay
    return carried


@register_factor
class DeliveredElasticityCalibrationResponseGap(BaseFactor):
    """Post-close residual earnings-news drift confirmed by cash and margins."""

    factor_id = "delivered_elasticity_calibration_response_gap"
    name = "Cash-Confirmed Delivery Residual Drift"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Ranks post-close EPS delivery residuals versus pre-report consensus "
        "elasticity only when margin, cash-conversion, and working-capital "
        "evidence confirm the residual and report-day absorption is incomplete."
    )
    window_length = 84
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "operatingMargin",
        "incomeQuality",
        "workingCapital",
        "revenue",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        eps_actual = data["epsActual"]
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"]
        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"]
        revenue_surprise = data["revenueSurprise"]
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"]
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"]
        operating_margin = data["operatingMargin"]
        income_quality = data["incomeQuality"]
        working_capital = data["workingCapital"]
        revenue = data["revenue"]

        eps_est_t1 = eps_estimate.shift(1)
        eps_est_t21 = eps_estimate.shift(21)
        revenue_est_t1 = revenue_estimate.shift(1)
        revenue_est_t21 = revenue_estimate.shift(21)

        eps_revision = (eps_est_t1 - eps_est_t21) / eps_est_t21.abs().clip(lower=0.01)
        revenue_revision = (revenue_est_t1 - revenue_est_t21) / revenue_est_t21.abs().clip(lower=1000000.0)
        beta = (eps_revision / revenue_revision.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-5.0, 5.0)

        standardized_eps = (eps_surprise / eps_est_t1.abs().clip(lower=0.01)).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
        standardized_revenue = (
            revenue_surprise / revenue_est_t1.abs().clip(lower=1000000.0)
        ).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
        delivery_residual = (standardized_eps - beta * standardized_revenue).clip(-3.0, 3.0)

        operating_margin_lag = operating_margin.shift(63)
        income_quality_lag = income_quality.shift(63)
        working_capital_lag = working_capital.shift(63)
        revenue_lag = revenue.shift(63)

        delta_margin = operating_margin - operating_margin_lag
        delta_income_quality = income_quality - income_quality_lag
        normalized_wc = working_capital / revenue.abs().clip(lower=1000000.0)
        normalized_wc_lag = working_capital_lag / revenue_lag.abs().clip(lower=1000000.0)
        delta_working_capital = normalized_wc - normalized_wc_lag

        confirmation = (
            (delta_margin / 0.02).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
            + 0.5 * delta_income_quality.clip(-1.0, 1.0)
            - 0.5 * (delta_working_capital / 0.05).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        )

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        report_return = close / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        absorption = 1.0 - (
            (np.sign(delivery_residual) * report_return)
            .clip(lower=0.0)
            .clip(upper=0.10)
            / 0.10
        )

        eps_changed = eps_actual.notna() & (
            eps_actual.shift(1).isna() | eps_actual.ne(eps_actual.shift(1))
        )
        revenue_changed = revenue_actual.notna() & (
            revenue_actual.shift(1).isna() | revenue_actual.ne(revenue_actual.shift(1))
        )
        fresh_report = eps_changed | revenue_changed

        revision_valid = _finite_mask(
            eps_est_t1,
            eps_est_t21,
            revenue_est_t1,
            revenue_est_t21,
            eps_revision,
            revenue_revision,
            beta,
        ) & revenue_revision.abs().ge(0.01)
        surprise_valid = _finite_mask(
            eps_surprise,
            revenue_surprise,
            standardized_eps,
            standardized_revenue,
            delivery_residual,
        ) & standardized_revenue.abs().ge(0.01)
        confirmation_valid = _finite_mask(
            operating_margin,
            operating_margin_lag,
            income_quality,
            income_quality_lag,
            working_capital,
            working_capital_lag,
            revenue,
            revenue_lag,
            delta_margin,
            delta_income_quality,
            delta_working_capital,
            confirmation,
        )
        absorption_valid = _finite_mask(close, prior_close, report_return, absorption)
        report_fields_valid = _finite_mask(
            eps_actual,
            revenue_actual,
            eps_surprise,
            revenue_surprise,
        )

        eligible = (
            fresh_report
            & report_fields_valid
            & revision_valid
            & surprise_valid
            & confirmation_valid
            & absorption_valid
            & confirmation.abs().ge(0.25)
            & np.sign(delivery_residual).eq(np.sign(confirmation))
            & np.sign(delivery_residual).eq(np.sign(delta_margin))
        )

        event_score = (
            delivery_residual * confirmation.abs() * absorption
        ).where(eligible, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
        carried_score = _carry_post_close_events(event_score)

        ranked = rank(carried_score)
        return ranked.where(carried_score.ne(0.0), 0.0).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Cash-Confirmed Delivery Residual Drift
programs.trading_idea: The revised mechanism is not that raw EPS-to-revenue surprise elasticity is itself a durable operating-leverage estimate. Instead, it isolates the residual between delivered EPS news and the EPS implication of pre-release consensus co-revisions, then trades it only when contemporaneous operating-margin, cash-conversion, and working-capital evidence support the residual's sign. The expected continuation arises when analysts must revise profitability and cash-realization assumptions after a report, while the completed report-day return indicates that the directional implication was not already fully absorbed.
programs.description: Let t be a fresh report date: epsActual[t] and revenueActual[t] must be non-null, epsSurprise[t] and revenueSurprise[t] must be non-null, and at least one of epsActual[t] or revenueActual[t] must differ from its value at t-1. All report-date quantities are used only after close[t] is known. Pre-report consensus revisions use only the 20-bar window ending at t-1: rE = (epsEstimate[t-1]-epsEstimate[t-21]) / max(abs(epsEstimate[t-21]), 0.01), and rR = (revenueEstimate[t-1]-revenueEstimate[t-21]) / max(abs(revenueEstimate[t-21]), 1000000). The pre-report calibration coefficient is beta = winsorize(rE / rR, -5, 5), but the event is discarded unless abs(rR) >= 0.01. Delivered standardized surprises are sE = winsorize(epsSurprise[t] / max(abs(epsEstimate[t-1]), 0.01), -3, 3) and sR = winsorize(revenueSurprise[t] / max(abs(revenueEstimate[t-1]), 1000000), -3, 3); discard the event unless abs(sR) >= 0.01. The economically scaled delivery residual is D = winsorize(sE - beta*sR, -3, 3), rather than an unbounded ratio of EPS and revenue surprises. Cash-and-operations confirmation is measured over the prior approximately quarterly 63-bar lookback: dOM = operatingMargin[t]-operatingMargin[t-63], dIQ = incomeQuality[t]-incomeQuality[t-63], and dWC = workingCapital[t]/max(abs(revenue[t]), 1000000) - workingCapital[t-63]/max(abs(revenue[t-63]), 1000000). Define Q = clip(dOM/0.02, -1, 1) + 0.5*clip(dIQ, -1, 1) - 0.5*clip(dWC/0.05, -1, 1). Retain an event only when sign(D)=sign(Q), abs(Q)>=0.25, and sign(D)=sign(dOM); otherwise assign zero. This requires positive residuals to coincide with improving operating margin, improving cash conversion, and/or reduced working-capital cash consumption, while negative residuals require deterioration on those dimensions. Any missing input to the event, revision, confirmation, or absorption calculation produces no trade. Report-day absorption is based on the completed close-to-close return R0 = close[t]/close[t-1]-1: A = 1 - clip(max(0, sign(D)*R0)/0.10, 0, 1). The post-close event score is S_t = D*abs(Q)*A. It is first executable at the next bar, t+1, never on report date t. At each bar u from t+1 through t+6, carry S_t with linear decay S_t*(1-(u-t-1)/6); exit after the sixth executable bar. If multiple eligible report events remain active, sum their decayed scores before cross-sectionally ranking the resulting signal.

programs.code:
"""The signal targets earnings announcements where the reported delivery remains large after accounting for the consensus movement already visible before the announcement, and where the same report confirms a directional change in both operating profitability and cash generation. This is not interpreted as a uniquely identified calibration-error premium; rather, it is a conditional post-report forecast-reset signal in which a multi-line operating update is more likely to require gradual revisions to near-term earnings assumptions. The expected drift is positive for positive residual deliveries with improving fundamentals and negative for negative residual deliveries with deteriorating fundamentals."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _fresh_report_event(data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Identify only the initial timestamp of a reported-event-field update."""
    event_fields = [
        data["epsActual"],
        data["revenueActual"],
        data["epsSurprise"],
        data["revenueSurprise"],
    ]
    fresh = pd.DataFrame(False, index=event_fields[0].index, columns=event_fields[0].columns)
    for field in event_fields:
        fresh = fresh | (field.notna() & ~field.eq(field.shift(1)))
    return fresh


def _next_six_bar_hold(event_signal: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Enter one bar after an event and retain its value for exactly six bars."""
    entered = event_signal.shift(1)
    return entered.ffill(limit=5).fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class DeliveryRevisionCalibrationErrorDrift(BaseFactor):
    """Corroborated post-report forecast-reset drift signal."""

    factor_id = "delivery_revision_calibration_error_drift"
    name = "Corroborated Forecast-Reset Drift"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Ranks fresh earnings-report delivery residuals after removing the prior "
        "22-bar consensus revision, requiring matching operating-margin and cash-"
        "flow confirmation, then enters on the next bar for six daily bars."
    )
    window_length = 28
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "marketCap",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "operatingMargin",
        "operatingCashFlow",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        market_cap = data["marketCap"]
        eps_actual = data["epsActual"]
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"]
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"]
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"]
        operating_margin = data["operatingMargin"]
        operating_cash_flow = data["operatingCashFlow"]

        fresh = _fresh_report_event(data)

        eps_prior = eps_estimate.shift(1)
        eps_old = eps_estimate.shift(22)
        revenue_prior = revenue_estimate.shift(1)
        revenue_old = revenue_estimate.shift(22)

        eps_valid = (
            eps_actual.notna()
            & eps_prior.notna()
            & eps_old.notna()
            & eps_prior.abs().gt(0.0)
            & eps_old.abs().gt(0.0)
        )
        revenue_valid = (
            revenue_actual.notna()
            & revenue_prior.notna()
            & revenue_old.notna()
            & revenue_prior.abs().gt(0.0)
            & revenue_old.abs().gt(0.0)
        )

        eps_delivery = (eps_actual - eps_prior) / eps_prior.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        eps_revision = (eps_prior - eps_old) / eps_old.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        eps_residual = (eps_delivery - eps_revision).where(eps_valid)

        revenue_delivery = (revenue_actual - revenue_prior) / revenue_prior.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        revenue_revision = (revenue_prior - revenue_old) / revenue_old.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        revenue_residual = (revenue_delivery - revenue_revision).where(revenue_valid)

        component_valid = eps_residual.notna() & revenue_residual.notna()
        eps_rank = eps_residual.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        revenue_rank = revenue_residual.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        event_score = (0.5 * eps_rank + 0.5 * revenue_rank).where(component_valid)

        # Percentile scores have no economically meaningful zero; the average
        # normalized residual supplies the directional confirmation threshold.
        raw_residual = (0.5 * eps_residual + 0.5 * revenue_residual).where(component_valid)
        margin_change = operating_margin - operating_margin.shift(1)
        cash_flow_change = operating_cash_flow - operating_cash_flow.shift(1)
        positive_confirmation = (
            raw_residual.gt(0.0)
            & margin_change.gt(0.0)
            & cash_flow_change.gt(0.0)
        )
        negative_confirmation = (
            raw_residual.lt(0.0)
            & margin_change.lt(0.0)
            & cash_flow_change.lt(0.0)
        )
        confirmation = positive_confirmation | negative_confirmation

        dollar_volume = (close * volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        adv20 = dollar_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        eligible = close.gt(0.0) & market_cap.gt(0.0) & adv20.notna()

        eligible_fresh = fresh & component_valid & eligible
        liquidity_rank = adv20.where(eligible_fresh).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        top_liquidity = liquidity_rank.gt(0.20)

        confirmed_events = eligible_fresh & top_liquidity & confirmation
        centered_event_signal = (
            2.0 * event_score.where(confirmed_events).rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        )
        centered_event_signal = centered_event_signal.where(confirmed_events)

        return _next_six_bar_hold(centered_event_signal).reindex_like(close).fillna(0.0)

programs.description: A fresh event occurs only on date t when at least one non-null reported-event field among epsActual, revenueActual, epsSurprise, or revenueSurprise changes versus t-1; all other dates receive no new signal. For each fresh event, use the last pre-event consensus values at t-1 and the consensus values at t-22, requiring non-null, nonzero absolute denominators for epsEstimate and revenueEstimate at both dates. Define EPS delivery as (epsActual[t] - epsEstimate[t-1]) / abs(epsEstimate[t-1]), EPS revision as (epsEstimate[t-1] - epsEstimate[t-22]) / abs(epsEstimate[t-22]), and EPS residual delivery as delivery minus revision; define the revenue residual identically using revenueActual and revenueEstimate. The event score is the equal-weight average of the cross-sectional percentile ranks of EPS residual delivery and revenue residual delivery, after requiring both components to be available. Confirmation requires operatingMargin[t] - operatingMargin[t-1] and operatingCashFlow[t] - operatingCashFlow[t-1] to be non-null and to have the same strict sign as the combined residual score; zero changes, zero residual scores, and missing values are excluded. The tradable universe is stocks with positive close, positive marketCap, and non-missing 20-day average dollar volume computed as the 20-bar mean of close times volume; among eligible fresh events, retain the top 80% by that dollar-volume measure. Rank confirmed event scores cross-sectionally within this universe into a centered percentile signal from -1 to +1. Enter on the next daily bar after the report-date signal and hold for exactly 6 daily bars; no position is initiated from forward-filled event values after the initial update.

"""Resolution of EPS-only revisions by cash-confirmed delivered revenue news.

Mechanism: an EPS revision that outruns its revenue revision is often discounted as a
possibly temporary margin/accounting improvement.  When the subsequent reported
release supplies aligned revenue and EPS delivery while operating cash conversion and
the cash cycle corroborate it, investors must rapidly resolve that skepticism into a
more durable earnings path; the symmetric negative resolution is bearish.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _cs_zscore(values: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Robust date-wise standardization, with unavailable observations left at zero."""
    clean = values.where(np.isfinite(values))
    lo = clean.quantile(0.02, axis=1)
    hi = clean.quantile(0.98, axis=1)
    clipped = clean.clip(lower=lo, upper=hi, axis=0)
    mean = clipped.mean(axis=1)
    std = clipped.std(axis=1, ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return clipped.sub(mean, axis=0).div(std, axis=0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)


def _disclosure_event(eps_surprise: pd.DataFrame, revenue_surprise: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Identify a newly available surprise observation without firing on carried values."""
    eps = eps_surprise.where(np.isfinite(eps_surprise))
    rev = revenue_surprise.where(np.isfinite(revenue_surprise))
    eps_new = eps.notna() & (eps.shift(1).isna() | eps.ne(eps.shift(1)))
    rev_new = rev.notna() & (rev.shift(1).isna() | rev.ne(rev.shift(1)))
    return eps_new | rev_new


@register_factor
class TranslationResolutionDeliveryImpulse(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "translation_resolution_delivery_impulse"
    name = "Translation-Resolution Delivery Impulse"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Trades earnings delivery only when a pre-existing EPS-versus-revenue "
        "revision wedge is resolved in the same direction by cash-confirmed "
        "revenue and EPS surprise news."
    )
    window_length = 70
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "revenue",
        "cashConversionCycle",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        eps_est = data["epsEstimate"]
        rev_est = data["revenueEstimate"]
        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"]
        rev_surprise = data["revenueSurprise"]
        operating_cash_flow = data["operatingCashFlow"]
        revenue = data["revenue"]
        cash_cycle = data["cashConversionCycle"]

        prior_eps_est = eps_est.shift(21)
        prior_rev_est = rev_est.shift(21)
        eps_revision = (eps_est - prior_eps_est).div(prior_eps_est.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))
        rev_revision = (rev_est - prior_rev_est).div(prior_rev_est.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))

        # Parent-A state: EPS forecasts have moved ahead of sales forecasts.
        translation_wedge = _cs_zscore(eps_revision) - _cs_zscore(rev_revision)

        cash_margin = operating_cash_flow.div(revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        cash_margin_change = cash_margin - cash_margin.shift(63)
        cycle_change = cash_cycle - cash_cycle.shift(63)
        cash_confirmation = 0.55 * _cs_zscore(cash_margin_change) - 0.45 * _cs_zscore(cycle_change)
        resolution_state = 0.60 * translation_wedge + 0.40 * cash_confirmation

        eps_delivery_raw = eps_surprise.div(eps_est.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))
        rev_delivery_raw = rev_surprise.div(rev_est.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))
        eps_delivery = _cs_zscore(eps_delivery_raw)
        rev_delivery = _cs_zscore(rev_delivery_raw)
        delivery = 0.40 * eps_delivery + 0.60 * rev_delivery

        # Agreement is an interaction, not a blend: delivery gets amplified only
        # when it resolves the pre-report translation/cash state in its own direction.
        agreement = (delivery * resolution_state).clip(-10.0, 10.0)
        multiplier = 0.35 + 1.15 / (1.0 + np.exp(-agreement))

        one_bar_return = close.div(close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)) - 1.0
        reaction_penalty = _cs_zscore(one_bar_return)
        event = _disclosure_event(eps_surprise, rev_surprise)

        event_signal = (delivery * multiplier - 0.15 * reaction_penalty).where(event, 0.0)
        carried = event_signal.fillna(0.0).ewm(halflife=2.5, adjust=False).mean()
        output = rank(carried).fillna(0.5)
        return output.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).astype(float)
programs.name: Translation-Resolution Delivery Impulse
programs.trading_idea: EPS-only estimate upgrades are normally ambiguous: Parent A's negative realized sign suggests the market often interprets them as unsustainable cost, tax, or accounting improvements when revenue expectations have not moved. The child treats that wedge as a latent skepticism state and trades only when a subsequent earnings release delivers a same-signed revenue/EPS surprise together with improving cash conversion and a shortening cash cycle. This interaction captures the rapid repricing when a previously untrusted margin-led forecast is converted into verified top-line-and-cash evidence, an informational resolution neither an estimate wedge nor a delivered surprise identifies alone.
programs.description: On earnings-update dates, the factor combines standardized delivery surprise with an EPS-versus-revenue consensus translation wedge and a cash-conversion confirmation state. It retains the signal briefly with exponential decay and discounts announcements whose directional price reaction has already occurred.

programs.code:
"""The revised mechanism does not interpret elevated pre-report volatility as evidence that a public estimate revision contains superior private information. Instead, idiosyncratic range-variance acceleration is treated as a price-discovery and adverse-selection warning: when a stock has already experienced unusually rapid volatility acceleration relative to its sector, the information motivating a subsequent consensus change may already be reflected in price and implementation costs are likely elevated. The factor therefore seeks late-quarter estimate revisions only where sector-adjusted variance acceleration is subdued, consistent with slower diffusion of public analyst information into constrained institutional portfolios over the subsequent six sessions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _report_age(reset: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return bars elapsed since the latest point-in-time report reset."""
    n_rows, n_cols = reset.shape
    positions = pd.DataFrame(
        np.broadcast_to(np.arange(n_rows, dtype=float)[:, None], (n_rows, n_cols)),
        index=reset.index,
        columns=reset.columns,
    )
    latest_reset = positions.where(reset).ffill()
    return positions - latest_reset


def _finite_change_reset(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Identify actual-value updates relative to the preceding available value."""
    prior_available = actual.ffill().shift(1)
    current_valid = actual.notna() & ~actual.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    prior_valid = prior_available.notna() & ~prior_available.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    return current_valid & prior_valid & actual.ne(prior_available)


def _normalized_revision(
    estimate: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    lag: int,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute a lagged estimate revision with a causal cross-sectional floor."""
    prior = estimate.shift(lag)
    valid = (
        eligible
        & estimate.notna()
        & prior.notna()
        & ~estimate.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
        & ~prior.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    )
    prior_abs = prior.abs().where(valid)
    cross_sectional_floor = 0.01 * prior_abs.median(axis=1)
    denominator = prior.abs().where(
        prior.abs().ge(cross_sectional_floor, axis=0),
        cross_sectional_floor,
        axis=0,
    ).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    revision = ((estimate - prior) / denominator).where(valid)
    return revision.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _sector_acceleration_zscore(
    q: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Calculate sector robust z-scores, falling back to the eligible universe."""
    q_valid = q.where(eligible)
    universe_median = q_valid.median(axis=1)
    universe_mad = q_valid.sub(universe_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)

    labels = sector.ffill().iloc[-1].astype(object)
    labels = labels.where(labels.notna(), "__UNKNOWN_SECTOR__")
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=q.index, columns=q.columns, dtype=float)

    for _, members in labels.groupby(labels).groups.items():
        group_q = q_valid.loc[:, members]
        group_count = group_q.notna().sum(axis=1)
        group_median = group_q.median(axis=1)
        group_mad = group_q.sub(group_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        use_group = group_count.ge(5)
        location = group_median.where(use_group, universe_median)
        dispersion = group_mad.where(use_group, universe_mad)
        output.loc[:, members] = group_q.sub(location, axis=0).div(
            1.4826 * dispersion + 1e-12,
            axis=0,
        )

    return output.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


@register_factor
class ReportClockVarianceAccelerationRevision(BaseFactor):
    """Late-quarter revisions screened for sector-relative range-variance acceleration."""

    factor_id = "report_clock_variance_acceleration_revision"
    name = "Late-Clock Revision Diffusion with Variance-Completion Screen"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Ranks late-quarter EPS and revenue consensus revisions, then attenuates "
        "them when Parkinson range variance has accelerated unusually rapidly "
        "relative to the stock's sector."
    )
    window_length = 90
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "sector",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        if close.empty:
            return close.astype(float)

        eps_actual = data["epsActual"]
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"]
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"]
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"]

        reset = _finite_change_reset(eps_actual) | _finite_change_reset(revenue_actual)
        age = _report_age(reset)
        eligible = age.ge(35) & age.le(65)

        eps_revision = _normalized_revision(eps_estimate, eligible, 21)
        revenue_revision = _normalized_revision(revenue_estimate, eligible, 21)

        eps_score = 2.0 * eps_revision.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        revenue_score = 2.0 * revenue_revision.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        revision_score = 0.60 * eps_score + 0.40 * revenue_score

        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        valid_range = high.gt(0.0) & low.gt(0.0)
        range_ratio = high.where(valid_range) / low.where(valid_range)
        range_variance = np.log(range_ratio).pow(2) / (4.0 * np.log(2.0))

        short_variance = range_variance.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        long_variance = range_variance.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        acceleration = np.log((short_variance + 1e-12) / (long_variance + 1e-12))
        acceleration = acceleration.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        zscore = _sector_acceleration_zscore(acceleration, eligible, data["sector"])
        attenuation = zscore.clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0) / 2.0
        signal = revision_score * (1.0 - attenuation)

        valid_signal = eligible & revision_score.notna() & zscore.notna()
        return signal.where(valid_signal, 0.0).fillna(0.0).reindex(
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )

Instead, idiosyncratic range-variance acceleration is treated as a price-discovery and adverse-selection warning: when a stock has already experienced unusually rapid volatility acceleration relative to its sector, the information motivating a subsequent consensus change may already be reflected in price and implementation costs are likely elevated. The factor therefore seeks late-quarter estimate revisions only where sector-adjusted variance acceleration is subdued, consistent with slower diffusion of public analyst information into constrained institutional portfolios over the subsequent six sessions.
programs.description: At each close t, reset the reporting clock to age 0 whenever either epsActual or revenueActual is finite and differs from its immediately preceding available daily value; if both update on the same date, this is one reset with no field priority required. Report age is the number of daily bars since the most recent reset, and names are eligible only for ages 35 through 65 inclusive. Compute 21-bar estimate changes for both epsEstimate and revenueEstimate as (x_t - x_t-21) / max(abs(x_t-21), 0.01 times the cross-sectional median of abs(x_t-21) among valid names); require both estimates to be valid at t and t-21. Convert each normalized change to its same-date cross-sectional percentile rank among eligible names, map each rank to [-1,1], and define the signed revision score as 0.60 times the EPS score plus 0.40 times the revenue score. For volatility, define daily Parkinson range variance v_t = ln(high_t/low_t)^2 / (4 ln(2)), requiring positive high and low. Define q_i,t = ln((mean(v_i,t-4:t) + 1e-12) / (mean(v_i,t-19:t) + 1e-12)). Within each sector on each date, subtract the sector median q and divide by 1.4826 times the sector median absolute deviation plus 1e-12; if a sector has fewer than five valid names, use the full eligible-universe median and MAD instead. Let a_i,t = min(max(z_i,t, 0), 2) / 2, where z is this sector-adjusted acceleration score. The final factor is revision_score_i,t times (1 - a_i,t): positive revisions with low idiosyncratic acceleration are long signals and negative revisions with low acceleration are short signals, while high-acceleration names are continuously downweighted rather than treated as stronger information signals. Signals use only data available by the close of t and are executed at the next session's open; performance is measured over the fixed subsequent six daily bars.

programs.code:
"""Late-clock estimate revisions confirmed by absorption-state transitions.

A late-quarter estimate change is traded only when its direction agrees with a
causal price-volume transition markout and range-variance acceleration is not
signalling that discovery and adverse selection have already completed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _report_age(reset: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows, cols = reset.shape
    positions = pd.DataFrame(
        np.broadcast_to(np.arange(rows, dtype=float)[:, None], (rows, cols)),
        index=reset.index,
        columns=reset.columns,
    )
    return positions - positions.where(reset).ffill()


def _update_flag(x: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    prior = x.ffill().shift(1)
    valid = x.notna() & ~x.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    return valid & prior.notna() & x.ne(prior)


def _revision(x: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame, lag: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    prior = x.shift(lag)
    valid = eligible & x.notna() & prior.notna()
    scale = prior.abs().where(valid)
    floor = 0.01 * scale.median(axis=1)
    denom = prior.abs().where(
        prior.abs().ge(floor, axis=0), floor, axis=0
    ).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return ((x - prior) / denom).where(valid).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _sector_zscore(
    value: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    valid = value.where(eligible)
    universe_median = valid.median(axis=1)
    universe_mad = valid.sub(universe_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
    labels = sector.ffill().iloc[-1].astype(object).fillna("__UNKNOWN__")
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=value.index, columns=value.columns)

    for _, members in labels.groupby(labels).groups.items():
        group = valid.loc[:, members]
        count = group.notna().sum(axis=1)
        med = group.median(axis=1)
        mad = group.sub(med, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        use_group = count.ge(5)
        location = med.where(use_group, universe_median)
        dispersion = mad.where(use_group, universe_mad)
        out.loc[:, members] = group.sub(location, axis=0).div(
            1.4826 * dispersion + 1e-12, axis=0
        )
    return out.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _quadratic_curvature(y: pd.DataFrame, z: pd.DataFrame, window: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Trailing OLS coefficient on z squared in y = a + b*z + c*z^2."""
    z2 = z * z
    z3 = z2 * z
    z4 = z2 * z2
    n = y.rolling(window, min_periods=window).count()
    sx = z.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sx2 = z2.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sx3 = z3.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sx4 = z4.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sy = y.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sxy = (z * y).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sx2y = (z2 * y).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()

    det = (
        n * (sx2 * sx4 - sx3 * sx3)
        - sx * (sx * sx4 - sx2 * sx3)
        + sx2 * (sx * sx3 - sx2 * sx2)
    )
    det_c = (
        n * (sx2 * sx2y - sxy * sx3)
        - sx * (sx * sx2y - sxy * sx2)
        + sy * (sx * sx3 - sx2 * sxy)
    )
    return det_c / det.replace(0.0, np.nan)


def _transition_markout(state: pd.DataFrame, ret_sign: pd.DataFrame, window: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal smoothed continuation-minus-reversal estimate by prior state."""
    prior_state = state.shift(1)
    prior_sign = ret_sign.shift(1)
    nonflat = ret_sign.abs().eq(1.0)
    out = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=state.index, columns=state.columns)

    for code in range(12):
        eligible = prior_state.eq(float(code)) & nonflat
        continuation = eligible & ret_sign.eq(prior_sign)
        reversal = eligible & ret_sign.eq(-prior_sign)
        count = eligible.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum()
        cont = continuation.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum()
        rev = reversal.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum()
        edge = (cont - rev) / (count + 4.0)
        confidence = count / (count + 8.0)
        estimate = (edge * confidence).where(count.ge(6.0), 0.0)
        out = out.mask(state.eq(float(code)), estimate)
    return out


@register_factor
class LateClockRevisionTransitionAbsorptionGate(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "late_clock_revision_transition_absorption_gate"
    name = "Late-Clock Revision Absorption Transition"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Late-quarter EPS and revenue revisions are retained only when a "
        "state-conditioned nonlinear impact transition forecast agrees with "
        "their direction and sector-relative variance acceleration is subdued."
    )
    window_length = 90
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "volume",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "sector",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        if close.empty:
            return close.astype(float)

        reset = _update_flag(data["epsActual"]) | _update_flag(data["revenueActual"])
        age = _report_age(reset)
        late_clock = age.ge(35.0) & age.le(65.0)

        eps_rev = _revision(data["epsEstimate"], late_clock, 21)
        rev_rev = _revision(data["revenueEstimate"], late_clock, 21)
        fundamental = (
            0.60 * (2.0 * eps_rev.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0)
            + 0.40 * (2.0 * rev_rev.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0)
        )

        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        valid_price = (
            close.gt(0.0) & prior_close.gt(0.0) & high.gt(0.0) & low.gt(0.0)
            & high.ge(low)
        )
        ret = np.log(close / prior_close).where(valid_price)
        bar_range = ((high - low) / prior_close).where(valid_price)

        range_var = (np.log(high / low).pow(2) / (4.0 * np.log(2.0))).where(valid_price)
        short_var = range_var.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        long_var = range_var.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        variance_accel = np.log((short_var + 1e-12) / (long_var + 1e-12))
        variance_z = _sector_zscore(variance_accel, late_clock, data["sector"])
        calm_weight = 1.0 - variance_z.clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0) / 2.0

        median_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).median()
        median_range = bar_range.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).median()
        rel_volume = volume / median_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan))
        impact_y = (ret.abs() / median_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(
            valid_price & median_range.gt(0.0) & median_volume.gt(0.0)
        )
        impact_z = (close_location.abs() * rel_volume).where(impact_y.notna())
        curvature = _quadratic_curvature(impact_y, impact_z, 15)
        accelerating = curvature.sub(curvature.shift(10)).gt(0.0)
        curvature_valid = curvature.notna() & curvature.shift(10).notna()

        ret_vol = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=12).std()
        active = ret.abs().ge(0.35 * ret_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        ret_sign = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        ret_sign = ret_sign.mask(active & ret.gt(0.0), 1.0)
        ret_sign = ret_sign.mask(active & ret.lt(0.0), -1.0)

        volume_code = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        volume_code = volume_code.mask(rel_volume.le(0.75), 0.0)
        volume_code = volume_code.mask(rel_volume.gt(0.75) & rel_volume.lt(1.5), 1.0)
        volume_code = volume_code.mask(rel_volume.ge(1.5), 2.0)
        base_state = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        for code in range(3):
            base_state = base_state.mask(ret_sign.eq(-1.0) & volume_code.eq(float(code)), float(code))
            base_state = base_state.mask(ret_sign.eq(1.0) & volume_code.eq(float(code)), float(code + 3))
        state = (base_state + 6.0 * accelerating.astype(float)).where(curvature_valid)

        advantage = _transition_markout(state, ret_sign, 75)
        impulse = ret_sign * close_location * rel_volume.clip(lower=0.5, upper=3.0)
        execution_forecast = impulse * advantage
        alignment = (np.sign(fundamental) * execution_forecast).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        raw = fundamental * calm_weight * alignment

        eligible = late_clock & state.notna() & fundamental.notna() & variance_z.notna()
        scored = rank(raw.where(eligible))
        return scored.where(eligible, 0.0).fillna(0.0).astype(float).reindex(
            index=close.index, columns=close.columns
        )

programs.trading_idea: Late-quarter analyst revisions have delayed diffusion only when the contemporaneous execution state indicates that informed flow is being absorbed rather than mechanically exhausted. The child retains Parent A's sector-relative volatility-acceleration screen, but admits a revision only when Parent B's causal transition markout predicts that the current signed price-volume impulse will carry in the same direction as the revision. Neither parent has this interaction alone: revisions without execution confirmation can already be priced, while flow-transition evidence without a fundamental catalyst cannot distinguish informed absorption from transient inventory pressure.

programs.code:
"""A broad industry move can coincide with one-day, stock-specific liquidity-demand imbalances: an extreme residual move accompanied by unusually high participation, an unusually large intraday range, and a close near that residual move's directional extreme is treated as a temporary price-pressure signature rather than as a generic disagreement signal. The strategy explicitly bets on reversal only for these pressure-signature residuals, going long negative residual receivers and short positive residual receivers after a material, broad, and unusually dispersed industry shock. The mechanism fails when the residual move reflects durable firm-specific information that is incorporated rapidly rather than temporary order imbalance."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _industry_leave_one_out_metrics(
    ret: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Compute causal same-day leave-one-out shocks, breadth, and dispersion."""
    shock = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    breadth = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    dispersion = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)

    # Industry is static by contract. Reading the first row avoids using any
    # time-varying future classification information if a feed is sparse later.
    labels = industry.iloc[0]
    grouped = labels.groupby(labels).groups

    for _, members in grouped.items():
        if len(members) < 9:
            continue

        group_ret = ret.loc[:, members]
        values = group_ret.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        valid = np.isfinite(values)
        counts = valid.sum(axis=1)
        eligible = counts >= 9

        # Sorting valid observations permits an exact leave-one-out median for
        # every constituent without constructing a three-dimensional panel.
        filled = np.where(valid, values, np.inf)
        sorted_values = np.sort(filled, axis=1)
        order = np.argsort(filled, axis=1)
        inverse_order = np.empty_like(order)
        row_index = np.arange(values.shape[0])[:, None]
        inverse_order[row_index, order] = np.arange(values.shape[1])[None, :]

        peer_count = counts - 1
        lower_position = (peer_count - 1) // 2
        upper_position = peer_count // 2
        lower_original = lower_position[:, None] + (
            inverse_order <= lower_position[:, None]
        )
        upper_original = upper_position[:, None] + (
            inverse_order <= upper_position[:, None]
        )
        lower = np.take_along_axis(sorted_values, lower_original, axis=1)
        upper = np.take_along_axis(sorted_values, upper_original, axis=1)
        loo_median = (lower + upper) / 2.0
        loo_median = np.where(valid & eligible[:, None], loo_median, np.nan)

        positive = (values > 0.0) & valid
        negative = (values < 0.0) & valid
        positive_count = positive.sum(axis=1)[:, None] - positive.astype(int)
        negative_count = negative.sum(axis=1)[:, None] - negative.astype(int)
        matching_count = np.where(loo_median > 0.0, positive_count, negative_count)
        group_breadth = matching_count / np.where(peer_count[:, None] > 0, peer_count[:, None], np.nan)
        group_breadth = np.where(valid & eligible[:, None], group_breadth, np.nan)

        residual = values - loo_median
        residual_frame = pd.DataFrame(residual, index=ret.index, columns=members)
        residual_frame = residual_frame.where(valid & eligible[:, None])
        residual_median = residual_frame.median(axis=1)
        group_dispersion = residual_frame.sub(residual_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        group_dispersion = group_dispersion.where(eligible)

        shock.loc[:, members] = loo_median
        breadth.loc[:, members] = group_breadth
        dispersion.loc[:, members] = np.repeat(
            group_dispersion.to_numpy()[:, None], len(members), axis=1
        )

    return shock, breadth, dispersion


@register_factor
class CommonShockAbsorptionDispersion(BaseFactor):
    """Reversal alpha for liquidity-pressure residuals following broad industry shocks."""

    factor_id = "common_shock_absorption_dispersion"
    name = "Industry Shock Liquidity-Pressure Reversal"
    category = "mean_reversion"
    description = (
        "Reverses stock-specific residual moves only when a broad, material, "
        "high-dispersion industry shock coincides with abnormal volume, range, "
        "and a directional close-location liquidity-pressure signature."
    )
    window_length = 61
    inputs = ["close", "open", "high", "low", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        return_valid = (
            close.notna()
            & previous_close.notna()
            & (close > 0.0)
            & (previous_close > 0.0)
        )
        ret = (close / previous_close - 1.0).where(return_valid)

        shock, breadth, dispersion = _industry_leave_one_out_metrics(
            ret, data["industry"]
        )
        peer_ok = shock.notna() & (shock != 0.0)

        available_shock = shock.abs().where(peer_ok)
        shock_threshold = available_shock.shift(1).rolling(
            60, min_periods=40
        ).quantile(0.80)
        material_shock = available_shock >= shock_threshold

        dispersion_threshold = dispersion.shift(1).rolling(
            60, min_periods=40
        ).quantile(0.80)
        abnormal_dispersion = (
            dispersion.notna()
            & (dispersion > 0.0)
            & (dispersion >= dispersion_threshold)
        )

        valid_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
        prior_volume_count = valid_volume.notna().astype(float).shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=20
        ).sum()
        prior_volume_median = valid_volume.shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=15
        ).median()
        volume_pressure = (
            (volume > 0.0)
            & (prior_volume_count >= 15.0)
            & prior_volume_median.notna()
            & (prior_volume_median != 0.0)
            & (volume / prior_volume_median >= 1.50)
        )

        positive_hlc = (high > 0.0) & (low > 0.0) & (close > 0.0)
        high_low = high - low
        valid_range = positive_hlc & (high_low > 0.0)
        intraday_range = ((high_low / close) - 1.0).where(valid_range)
        prior_range_count = intraday_range.notna().astype(float).shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=20
        ).sum()
        prior_range_median = intraday_range.shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=15
        ).median()
        range_pressure = (
            valid_range
            & (prior_range_count >= 15.0)
            & prior_range_median.notna()
            & (prior_range_median != 0.0)
            & (intraday_range / prior_range_median >= 1.50)
        )

        close_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / high_low - 1.0).where(valid_range)
        residual = ret - shock
        directional_close = residual.notna() & (
            np.sign(residual) * close_location >= 0.80
        )

        liquidity_valid = (
            (open_ > 0.0)
            & (high > 0.0)
            & (low > 0.0)
            & (close > 0.0)
            & (volume > 0.0)
            & (high_low > 0.0)
        )
        z_score = residual / (1.4826 * dispersion).replace(0.0, np.nan)

        qualifies = (
            return_valid
            & peer_ok
            & (breadth >= 0.70)
            & material_shock
            & abnormal_dispersion
            & liquidity_valid
            & volume_pressure
            & range_pressure
            & directional_close
            & (z_score.abs() >= 1.50)
        )
        return (-z_score).where(qualifies, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)

The strategy explicitly bets on reversal only for these pressure-signature residuals, going long negative residual receivers and short positive residual receivers after a material, broad, and unusually dispersed industry shock. The mechanism fails when the residual move reflects durable firm-specific information that is incorporated rapidly rather than temporary order imbalance.
programs.description: At the close of day t, compute each valid stock's one-day close-to-close return r_i,t = close_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1. A stock is invalid on t if either close is missing or nonpositive; it receives score 0. Industries use the static data['industry'] label. For stock i, require at least 8 other valid same-industry peers on t, and define its leave-one-out industry shock s_i,t as the median return of those peers. Define peer breadth b_i,t as the fraction of those peers whose nonzero return has the same sign as s_i,t; require b_i,t >= 0.70 and s_i,t != 0. Require the absolute shock to be material: |s_i,t| must be at least the 80th percentile of the previous 60 bars' available |s_i,u| values, with at least 40 prior valid observations. Define the residual e_i,t = r_i,t - s_i,t. For each industry-day with at least 9 valid stocks, compute robust residual dispersion D_g,t = median_i(|e_i,t - median_j(e_j,t)|). The industry is in the abnormal-dispersion regime only when D_g,t is at least the 80th percentile of its own previous 60 available daily D_g,u values, with at least 40 prior observations and D_g,t > 0. For liquidity-pressure confirmation, require valid positive open, high, low, close, and volume; volume_t / median(volume over the prior 20 bars) >= 1.50 using at least 15 valid prior volumes; range_t = (high_t-low_t)/close_t-1 and range_t / median(range over the prior 20 bars) >= 1.50 using at least 15 valid prior ranges; and directional close location sign(e_i,t) * (2*(close_t-low_t)/(high_t-low_t)-1) >= 0.80. A zero or negative high-low range, missing observation, zero median denominator, halted zero-volume bar, or failed history requirement produces score 0. Let z_i,t = e_i,t / (1.4826*D_g,t). The deterministic alpha score is A_i,t = -z_i,t only when all common-shock, breadth, dispersion, liquidity-pressure conditions hold and |z_i,t| >= 1.50; otherwise A_i,t = 0. No fundamental or earnings controls are used. Form the signal after the t close and execute no earlier than the t+1 open. Rebalance daily: within each qualifying industry, equal-weight the A>0 names on the long side and the A<0 names on the short side, with equal dollar long and short exposure for that industry; allocate equal gross exposure across qualifying industries. Each daily vintage is held for 6 bars, so the live portfolio is the equal-weight combination of the six overlapping daily vintages.

programs.code:
"""A large sector-wide move can initially transmit through baskets and correlated risk repricing before investors fully differentiate firms by their capacity to absorb the implied operating or financing stress. Conditional on an objectively large sector move, resilient firms whose five-day return has lagged their sector should outperform weaker or relative-overresponding peers after a positive shock; after a negative shock, resilient firms with relatively smaller declines should outperform fragile firms with disproportionately large declines. The hypothesis is specifically incremental: the interaction must predict six-day returns after controlling for both sector-relative reversal and the standalone resilience composite."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _cross_sectional_winsorize(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Clip each date's cross-section at its trailing-date 1st/99th percentiles."""
    clean = frame.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    lower = clean.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = clean.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    return clean.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)


def _sector_shock_scores(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
    gross_margin: pd.DataFrame,
    sga_to_revenue: pd.DataFrame,
    current_ratio: pd.DataFrame,
    debt_to_equity: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Implement contemporaneous sector shock sorting using only date-t data."""
    safe_close = close.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    five_day_return = safe_close / safe_close.shift(5) - 1.0
    five_day_return = five_day_return.where((safe_close > 0.0) & (safe_close.shift(5) > 0.0))

    gross_margin = _cross_sectional_winsorize(gross_margin)
    sga_to_revenue = _cross_sectional_winsorize(sga_to_revenue)
    current_ratio = _cross_sectional_winsorize(current_ratio)
    debt_to_equity = _cross_sectional_winsorize(debt_to_equity)

    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=close.index, columns=close.columns, dtype=float)

    for row_number in range(len(close.index)):
        labels = sector.iloc[row_number]
        stock_return = five_day_return.iloc[row_number]
        gm = gross_margin.iloc[row_number]
        sga = sga_to_revenue.iloc[row_number]
        liquidity = current_ratio.iloc[row_number]
        leverage = debt_to_equity.iloc[row_number]

        valid_return = stock_return.notna() & labels.notna()
        resilience_eligible = (
            labels.notna()
            & gm.notna()
            & sga.notna()
            & liquidity.notna()
            & leverage.notna()
        )

        score = pd.Series(np.nan, index=close.columns, dtype=float)
        score.loc[valid_return & resilience_eligible] = 0.0

        if not valid_return.any():
            output.iloc[row_number] = score
            continue

        sector_observations = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "sector": labels.loc[valid_return],
                "stock_return": stock_return.loc[valid_return],
            }
        )
        sector_summary = sector_observations.groupby("sector", sort=False)["stock_return"].agg(
            ["mean", "count"]
        )
        eligible_sector_return = sector_summary.loc[
            sector_summary["count"] >= 5, "mean"
        ]

        if eligible_sector_return.empty:
            output.iloc[row_number] = score
            continue

        sector_abs_rank = eligible_sector_return.abs().rank(pct=True)
        shocked_sector_return = eligible_sector_return.loc[sector_abs_rank >= (2.0 / 3.0)]

        if shocked_sector_return.empty:
            output.iloc[row_number] = score
            continue

        sector_return_by_stock = labels.map(eligible_sector_return)
        abnormal_response = stock_return - sector_return_by_stock
        abnormal_rank = abnormal_response.groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True) - 0.5

        ranked_gm = gm.where(resilience_eligible).groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True) - 0.5
        ranked_sga = -(sga.where(resilience_eligible))
        ranked_sga = ranked_sga.groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True) - 0.5
        ranked_liquidity = (
            liquidity.where(resilience_eligible).groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True) - 0.5
        )
        ranked_leverage = -(leverage.where(resilience_eligible))
        ranked_leverage = ranked_leverage.groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True) - 0.5

        resilience = (ranked_gm + ranked_sga + ranked_liquidity + ranked_leverage) / 4.0
        shock_direction = labels.map(np.sign(shocked_sector_return))
        shocked_stock = labels.isin(shocked_sector_return.index)
        active = shocked_stock & resilience_eligible & abnormal_rank.notna()

        score.loc[active] = resilience.loc[active] - (
            shock_direction.loc[active] * abnormal_rank.loc[active]
        )
        output.iloc[row_number] = score

    return output


@register_factor
class SectorShockCostAbsorptionSort(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks resilient firms by their relative response to large sector shocks."""

    factor_id = "sector_shock_cost_absorption_sort"
    name = "Sector Shock Resilience Response"
    category = "other"
    description = (
        "Within objectively shocked sectors, favors high-resilience firms that "
        "lag positive sector shocks or avoid disproportionate declines in negative shocks."
    )
    window_length = 5
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "sector",
        "grossMargin",
        "sgaToRevenue",
        "currentRatio",
        "debtToEquity",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return _sector_shock_scores(
            data["close"],
            data["sector"],
            data["grossMargin"],
            data["sgaToRevenue"],
            data["currentRatio"],
            data["debtToEquity"],
        )
programs.name: Sector Shock Resilience Response
programs.trading_idea: A large sector-wide move can initially transmit through baskets and correlated risk repricing before investors fully differentiate firms by their capacity to absorb the implied operating or financing stress. Conditional on an objectively large sector move, resilient firms whose five-day return has lagged their sector should outperform weaker or relative-overresponding peers after a positive shock; after a negative shock, resilient firms with relatively smaller declines should outperform fragile firms with disproportionately large declines. The hypothesis is specifically incremental: the interaction must predict six-day returns after controlling for both sector-relative reversal and the standalone resilience composite.
programs.description: At each rebalance date t, form five-day simple returns r_i = close_t / close_{t-5} - 1 for stocks with valid positive closes at t and t-5. For each sector with at least five eligible stocks, compute the equal-weighted sector return R_s as the mean of r_i. Rank absolute sector returns across eligible sectors using percentile ranks and define a sector as shocked when its absolute-return percentile rank is at least 2/3; define shock direction S_s = sign(R_s). Stocks in unshocked sectors receive no signal. For each stock in a shocked sector, calculate abnormal response A_i = r_i - R_s, then convert A_i to a within-sector percentile rank and center it to a [-0.5, 0.5] scale. Construct a point-in-time resilience score Q_i from grossMargin, sgaToRevenue, currentRatio, and debtToEquity. Winsorize each component cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles on date t; within each sector convert grossMargin and currentRatio to ascending percentile ranks, and sgaToRevenue and debtToEquity to descending percentile ranks, then center each rank to [-0.5, 0.5]. Q_i is the equal-weighted average of the four centered component ranks. A stock is eligible only if all four resilience fields are available at t; missing values produce NaN rather than an imputed signal. The signed factor is Score_i = Q_i - S_s * A_i. Thus, after a positive shock, the score is highest for resilient sector laggards and lowest for fragile relative overresponders; after a negative shock, it is highest for resilient stocks with relatively small declines and lowest for fragile stocks with disproportionately negative abnormal responses. Test a sector-neutral implementation that, within each shocked sector, buys the highest-score quintile and shorts the lowest-score quintile with equal gross sector weights.

programs.code:
"""Revision drift released after transient downside-pressure extinction.

Mechanism: a positive analyst revision has the strongest near-term continuation
when its price has not yet caught up and an earlier downside shock has cooled in
both range and participation, consistent with exhausted inventory pressure.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _relative_change(values: pd.DataFrame, lag: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal estimate revision scaled by the prior public estimate."""
    prior = values.shift(lag)
    valid = values.notna() & prior.notna() & np.isfinite(values) & np.isfinite(prior)
    denominator = prior.abs().where(prior.abs().gt(1e-8))
    return ((values - prior) / denominator).where(valid).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _industry_residual(values: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Same-date industry demeaning with an all-universe fallback."""
    if values.empty:
        return values.astype(float)
    labels = industry.ffill().iloc[-1].reindex(values.columns).astype(object)
    labels = labels.where(labels.notna(), "__UNKNOWN__")
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns, dtype=float)
    universe = values.median(axis=1)
    for _, members in labels.groupby(labels, sort=False).groups.items():
        group = values.loc[:, members]
        group_median = group.median(axis=1)
        sufficient = group.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(4)
        location = group_median.where(sufficient, universe)
        result.loc[:, members] = group.sub(location, axis=0)
    return result


@register_factor
class RevisionExtinguishedDownsideResponseGap(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "revision_extinguished_downside_response_gap"
    name = "Revision Extinction Response Gap"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Positive consensus revisions with incomplete price assimilation, weighted "
        "by an extinguishing industry-relative downside-liquidity shock."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "epsEstimate", "revenueEstimate", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data["high"].astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data["low"].astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        eps_revision = _relative_change(data["epsEstimate"].astype(float), 20)
        revenue_revision = _relative_change(data["revenueEstimate"].astype(float), 20)
        eps_score = 2.0 * eps_revision.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        revenue_score = 2.0 * revenue_revision.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        available = 0.65 * eps_score.notna().astype(float) + 0.35 * revenue_score.notna().astype(float)
        revision = (0.65 * eps_score.fillna(0.0) + 0.35 * revenue_score.fillna(0.0)).div(
            available.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        positive_revision = revision.clip(lower=0.0)

        valid_close = close.where(close.gt(0.0))
        log_return = np.log(valid_close / valid_close.shift(1))
        downside = log_return.pow(2).where(log_return.lt(0.0), 0.0).where(log_return.notna())
        shock_recent = downside.shift(5).rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        shock_base = downside.shift(10).rolling(40, min_periods=30).mean()
        shock = np.log((shock_recent + 1e-10) / (shock_base + 1e-10))

        valid_range = high.gt(0.0) & low.gt(0.0) & high.ge(low) & valid_close.notna()
        bar_range = ((high - low) / valid_close).where(valid_range)
        recent_range = bar_range.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        prior_range = bar_range.shift(5).rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        range_cooling = -np.log((recent_range + 1e-10) / (prior_range + 1e-10))

        valid_volume = volume.where(volume.ge(0.0))
        recent_volume = valid_volume.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        prior_volume = valid_volume.shift(5).rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        volume_cooling = -np.log((recent_volume + 1e-10) / (prior_volume + 1e-10))

        shock_residual = _industry_residual(shock, data["industry"])
        cooling_residual = _industry_residual(0.5 * (range_cooling + volume_cooling), data["industry"])
        extinction = rank(shock_residual) * rank(cooling_residual)

        price_response = np.log(valid_close / valid_close.shift(10))
        price_score = 2.0 * price_response.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        response_deficit = (positive_revision - price_score).clip(lower=0.0)

        valid = positive_revision.notna() & response_deficit.notna() & extinction.notna()
        signal = positive_revision * response_deficit * (0.25 + 0.75 * extinction)
        return rank(signal.where(valid)).fillna(0.0).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).astype(float)
programs.name: Revision Extinction Response Gap
programs.trading_idea: Positive estimate revisions are most likely to retain a six-bar drift when their price response is still incomplete but a preceding downside-liquidity episode has visibly extinguished. The revision supplies directional fundamental information from Parent A, while Parent B identifies that recent selling was more likely transient inventory pressure because range and participation have cooled after the shock. Neither condition alone is sufficient: an unpriced upgrade can be stale or ignored, while a cooling selloff can simply be a technical bounce; their interaction identifies fundamentally supported demand released from a temporary adverse-selection state.
programs.description: Ranks positive EPS and revenue estimate revisions by their residual price-response deficit, then weights them by an industry-relative downside-semivariance shock whose range and volume have subsequently normalized. The signal is zero when estimates are unavailable or the revision is non-positive.

programs.code:
"""A broad industry-consensus revision is treated as a candidate common-information event only when the leave-one-out peer basket has already moved in the same direction. Conditional on that confirmation and the absence of a newly released contradictory firm-specific earnings surprise or own-consensus revision, stocks whose five-day response is weak relative to their historically estimated industry-return sensitivity should subsequently outperform their industry peers. The mechanism is delayed cross-sectional incorporation of a confirmed common shock, rather than an unconditional inference that analyst revision breadth itself is new fundamental information."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _leave_one_out_median(
    values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series, minimum_peers: int
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Exact row-wise leave-one-out group medians with a peer-count gate."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)
    valid_labels = labels.dropna()

    for group in pd.unique(valid_labels):
        columns = labels.index[labels == group]
        if len(columns) <= minimum_peers:
            continue

        array = values.loc[:, columns].to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
        valid = np.isfinite(array)
        counts = valid.sum(axis=1)
        group_result = np.full(array.shape, np.nan, dtype=float)

        for column_number in range(array.shape[1]):
            peer_count = counts - valid[:, column_number].astype(int)
            eligible_rows = peer_count >= minimum_peers
            if not eligible_rows.any():
                continue

            peer_values = array[eligible_rows].copy()
            peer_values[:, column_number] = np.nan
            group_result[eligible_rows, column_number] = np.nanmedian(
                peer_values, axis=1
            )

        result.loc[:, columns] = group_result

    return result


def _leave_one_out_mean(
    values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series, minimum_peers: int
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Row-wise leave-one-out equal-weighted group means with a peer-count gate."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)
    valid_labels = labels.dropna()

    for group in pd.unique(valid_labels):
        columns = labels.index[labels == group]
        if len(columns) <= minimum_peers:
            continue

        array = values.loc[:, columns].to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
        valid = np.isfinite(array)
        clean = np.where(valid, array, 0.0)
        total = clean.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        counts = valid.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        peer_counts = counts - valid.astype(int)
        peer_sums = total - clean

        group_result = np.divide(
            peer_sums,
            peer_counts,
            out=np.full(array.shape, np.nan, dtype=float),
            where=peer_counts >= minimum_peers,
        )
        result.loc[:, columns] = group_result

    return result


def _lagged_rolling_beta(
    stock_return: pd.DataFrame,
    peer_return: pd.DataFrame,
    window: int,
    lag: int,
    minimum_pairs: int,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal beta over t-window-lag+1 through t-lag using paired observations."""
    y = stock_return.shift(lag)
    x = peer_return.shift(lag)
    paired = y.notna() & x.notna()

    x_clean = x.where(paired, 0.0)
    y_clean = y.where(paired, 0.0)
    count = paired.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sum_x = x_clean.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sum_y = y_clean.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sum_xx = (x_clean * x_clean).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sum_xy = (x_clean * y_clean).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()

    covariance_numerator = sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / count
    variance_numerator = sum_xx - (sum_x * sum_x) / count
    beta = covariance_numerator / variance_numerator.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return beta.where((count >= minimum_pairs) & (variance_numerator != 0.0))


def _industry_neutral_equal_gross_weights(
    deficit: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Demean within-industry percentile ranks and equalize gross exposure by industry."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=deficit.index, columns=deficit.columns)
    included_industries = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=deficit.index, columns=["count"])
    normalized_by_group: list[pd.DataFrame] = []

    for group in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        columns = labels.index[labels == group]
        group_deficit = deficit.loc[:, columns].where(eligible.loc[:, columns])
        eligible_count = group_deficit.notna().sum(axis=1)
        group_valid = eligible_count >= 4

        percentile = group_deficit.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        demeaned = percentile.sub(percentile.mean(axis=1), axis=0).where(
            group_valid, 0.0
        )
        gross = demeaned.abs().sum(axis=1)
        normalized = demeaned.div(gross.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0).fillna(0.0)
        normalized_by_group.append(normalized)
        included_industries["count"] += (gross > 0.0).astype(float)

    group_count = included_industries["count"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    for normalized in normalized_by_group:
        output.loc[:, normalized.columns] = normalized.div(group_count, axis=0).fillna(0.0)

    return output


@register_factor
class IndustryRevisionCovarianceMaskedCatchup(BaseFactor):
    """Industry-neutral catch-up after confirmed common estimate-revision shocks."""

    factor_id = "industry_revision_covariance_masked_catchup"
    name = "Confirmed Revision-Response Catch-Up"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "Industry-neutral long-short catch-up signal for stocks whose five-day "
        "return underreacted to a confirmed leave-one-out industry EPS-consensus "
        "revision and peer-basket move, excluding contradictory fresh earnings news."
    )
    window_length = 86
    inputs = ["close", "epsEstimate", "epsSurprise", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        estimate = data["epsEstimate"]
        surprise = data["epsSurprise"]
        industry = data["industry"]

        labels = industry.iloc[0].copy()
        labels = labels.where(labels.notna(), np.nan)

        prior_estimate = estimate.shift(21)
        valid_revision = (
            estimate.notna()
            & prior_estimate.notna()
            & close.notna()
            & (close > 0.0)
        )
        revision = ((estimate - prior_estimate) / close).where(valid_revision)

        breadth = _leave_one_out_median(revision, labels, 10)

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        daily_return = (close / prior_close - 1.0).where(
            close.notna() & prior_close.notna() & (prior_close > 0.0)
        )
        peer_return = _leave_one_out_mean(daily_return, labels, 10)

        beta = _lagged_rolling_beta(
            daily_return, peer_return, window=60, lag=6, minimum_pairs=40
        )

        stock_response = (close / close.shift(5) - 1.0).where(
            close.notna() & close.shift(5).notna() & (close.shift(5) > 0.0)
        )
        peer_response = (
            (1.0 + peer_return).rolling(5, min_periods=5).apply(np.prod, raw=True)
            - 1.0
        )
        deficit = beta * peer_response - stock_response

        previous_surprise = surprise.shift(1)
        new_surprise = surprise.notna() & (
            previous_surprise.isna() | surprise.ne(previous_surprise)
        )
        positive_event = (new_surprise & (surprise > 0.0)).astype(float)
        negative_event = (new_surprise & (surprise < 0.0)).astype(float)
        recent_positive = positive_event.rolling(21, min_periods=1).max() > 0.0
        recent_negative = negative_event.rolling(21, min_periods=1).max() > 0.0

        contradictory_surprise = ((breadth > 0.0) & recent_negative) | (
            (breadth < 0.0) & recent_positive
        )
        opposite_own_revision = (revision * breadth) < 0.0
        confirmed = (peer_response * breadth) > 0.0

        eligible = (
            revision.notna()
            & breadth.notna()
            & (breadth != 0.0)
            & beta.notna()
            & stock_response.notna()
            & peer_response.notna()
            & confirmed
            & ~opposite_own_revision
            & ~contradictory_surprise
            & deficit.notna()
        )

        return _industry_neutral_equal_gross_weights(deficit, eligible, labels)
