programs.trading_idea: A broad industry move can coincide with one-day, stock-specific liquidity-demand imbalances: an extreme residual move accompanied by unusually high participation, an unusually large intraday range, and a close near that residual move's directional extreme is treated as a temporary price-pressure signature rather than as a generic disagreement signal. The strategy explicitly bets on reversal only for these pressure-signature residuals, going long negative residual receivers and short positive residual receivers after a material, broad, and unusually dispersed industry shock. The mechanism fails when the residual move reflects durable firm-specific information that is incorporated rapidly rather than temporary order imbalance.
programs.description: At the close of day t, compute each valid stock's one-day close-to-close return r_i,t = close_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1. A stock is invalid on t if either close is missing or nonpositive; it receives score 0. Industries use the static data['industry'] label. For stock i, require at least 8 other valid same-industry peers on t, and define its leave-one-out industry shock s_i,t as the median return of those peers. Define peer breadth b_i,t as the fraction of those peers whose nonzero return has the same sign as s_i,t; require b_i,t >= 0.70 and s_i,t != 0. Require the absolute shock to be material: |s_i,t| must be at least the 80th percentile of the previous 60 bars' available |s_i,u| values, with at least 40 prior valid observations. Define the residual e_i,t = r_i,t - s_i,t. For each industry-day with at least 9 valid stocks, compute robust residual dispersion D_g,t = median_i(|e_i,t - median_j(e_j,t)|). The industry is in the abnormal-dispersion regime only when D_g,t is at least the 80th percentile of its own previous 60 available daily D_g,u values, with at least 40 prior observations and D_g,t > 0. For liquidity-pressure confirmation, require valid positive open, high, low, close, and volume; volume_t / median(volume over the prior 20 bars) >= 1.50 using at least 15 valid prior volumes; range_t = (high_t-low_t)/close_t-1 and range_t / median(range over the prior 20 bars) >= 1.50 using at least 15 valid prior ranges; and directional close location sign(e_i,t) * (2*(close_t-low_t)/(high_t-low_t)-1) >= 0.80. A zero or negative high-low range, missing observation, zero median denominator, halted zero-volume bar, or failed history requirement produces score 0. Let z_i,t = e_i,t / (1.4826*D_g,t). The deterministic alpha score is A_i,t = -z_i,t only when all common-shock, breadth, dispersion, liquidity-pressure conditions hold and |z_i,t| >= 1.50; otherwise A_i,t = 0. No fundamental or earnings controls are used. Form the signal after the t close and execute no earlier than the t+1 open. Rebalance daily: within each qualifying industry, equal-weight the A>0 names on the long side and the A<0 names on the short side, with equal dollar long and short exposure for that industry; allocate equal gross exposure across qualifying industries. Each daily vintage is held for 6 bars, so the live portfolio is the equal-weight combination of the six overlapping daily vintages.

"""Resilience-conditioned differentiation after common-shock liquidity pressure.

A broad industry shock may be transmitted through basket demand, while an extreme
name-level residual with abnormal participation and range indicates temporary
liquidity pressure.  Fundamental resilience determines which pressured relative
responses are likely to resolve into post-shock differentiation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _industry_state(ret: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causal same-bar leave-one-out industry shock, breadth, and dispersion."""
    shock = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    breadth = shock.copy()
    dispersion = shock.copy()
    labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(ret.columns)
    valid_labels = labels.dropna()
    groups = valid_labels.groupby(valid_labels, sort=False).groups
    for members in groups.values():
        if len(members) < 6:
            continue
        group_ret = ret.loc[:, members]
        valid = group_ret.notna()
        count = valid.sum(axis=1)
        peer_count = count - 1
        eligible = peer_count >= 5
        total = group_ret.sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
        loo = total.to_frame().sub(group_ret).div(peer_count.replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
        loo = loo.where(valid & eligible.to_numpy()[:, None])
        positive = ((group_ret > 0.0) & valid).sum(axis=1)
        negative = ((group_ret < 0.0) & valid).sum(axis=1)
        peer_positive = positive.to_frame().sub(((group_ret > 0.0) & valid).astype(float))
        peer_negative = negative.to_frame().sub(((group_ret < 0.0) & valid).astype(float))
        same_direction = peer_positive.where(loo > 0.0, peer_negative)
        group_breadth = same_direction.div(peer_count.replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
        group_breadth = group_breadth.where(valid & eligible.to_numpy()[:, None])
        residual = group_ret - loo
        median_residual = residual.median(axis=1)
        group_dispersion = residual.sub(median_residual, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        group_dispersion = group_dispersion.where(eligible)
        shock.loc[:, members] = loo
        breadth.loc[:, members] = group_breadth
        dispersion.loc[:, members] = np.repeat(group_dispersion.to_numpy()[:, None], len(members), axis=1)
    return (shock, breadth, dispersion)

def _within_industry_rank(frame: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectional percentile rank within static industries on each date."""
    labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(frame.columns)
    return frame.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True).T

@register_factor
class ResilientIndustryPressureDifferentiation(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = 'resilient_industry_pressure_differentiation_j_j'
    name = 'Resilient Industry Pressure Differentiation'
    category = 'statistical_arbitrage'
    description = 'During broad dispersed industry shocks, sorts only abnormal-volume, wide-range directional residual-pressure events by financial resilience and shock-direction-adjusted relative response.'
    window_length = 60
    inputs = ['close', 'high', 'low', 'volume', 'industry', 'grossMargin', 'sgaToRevenue', 'currentRatio', 'debtToEquity']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data['close']
        high = data['high']
        low = data['low']
        volume = data['volume']
        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        valid_return = close.notna() & previous_close.notna() & (close > 0.0) & (previous_close > 0.0)
        ret = (close / previous_close - 1.0).where(valid_return)
        shock, breadth, dispersion = _industry_state(ret, data['industry'])
        residual = ret - shock
        residual_rank = _within_industry_rank(residual, data['industry']) - 0.5
        shock_threshold = shock.abs().shift(1).rolling(57, min_periods=35).quantile(0.75)
        dispersion_threshold = dispersion.shift(1).rolling(63, min_periods=35).quantile(0.75)
        broad_material_shock = shock.notna() & (shock.abs() >= shock_threshold) & (breadth >= 0.65) & (dispersion >= dispersion_threshold)
        prior_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0).shift(1).rolling(18, min_periods=12).median()
        volume_multiple = volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        raw_range = high - low
        valid_range = (high > 0.0) & (low > 0.0) & (close > 0.0) & (raw_range > 0.0)
        normalized_range = (raw_range / close).where(valid_range)
        prior_range = normalized_range.shift(1).rolling(23, min_periods=12).median()
        range_multiple = normalized_range / prior_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / raw_range - 1.0).where(valid_range)
        directional_endpoint = np.sign(residual) * close_location >= 0.65
        pressure_event = valid_range & (volume_multiple >= 1.3) & (range_multiple >= 1.25) & directional_endpoint
        gm = data['grossMargin']
        sga = data['sgaToRevenue']
        liquidity = data['currentRatio']
        leverage = data['debtToEquity']
        fundamental_valid = gm.notna() & sga.notna() & liquidity.notna() & leverage.notna()
        resilience = (_within_industry_rank(gm.where(fundamental_valid), data['industry']) - 0.5 + (0.5 - _within_industry_rank(sga.where(fundamental_valid), data['industry'])) + (_within_industry_rank(liquidity.where(fundamental_valid), data['industry']) - 0.5) + (0.5 - _within_industry_rank(leverage.where(fundamental_valid), data['industry']))) / 4.0
        differentiation = resilience - np.sign(shock) * residual_rank
        active = broad_material_shock & pressure_event & fundamental_valid & residual_rank.notna()
        return differentiation.where(active, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)

programs.trading_idea: Broad industry shocks initially move correlated baskets, but unusually high-volume, wide-range residual moves ending at the directional extreme identify names where the common shock is being expressed through temporary liquidity demand rather than clean firm-specific information. The child then applies the resilience state variable to this pressure subset: after positive industry shocks it favors resilient forced laggards, while after negative shocks it favors resilient relative defenders over fragile disproportionate decliners. Parent A alone reverses all pressure residuals and can fade genuine differentiation, while Parent B alone cannot distinguish slow fundamental sorting from transient order-flow displacement; their interaction isolates the subset where balance-sheet capacity determines which pressure-induced relative moves repair over the six-day horizon.

"""The revised mechanism does not interpret elevated pre-report volatility as evidence that a public estimate revision contains superior private information. Instead, idiosyncratic range-variance acceleration is treated as a price-discovery and adverse-selection warning: when a stock has already experienced unusually rapid volatility acceleration relative to its sector, the information motivating a subsequent consensus change may already be reflected in price and implementation costs are likely elevated. The factor therefore seeks late-quarter estimate revisions only where sector-adjusted variance acceleration is subdued, consistent with slower diffusion of public analyst information into constrained institutional portfolios over the subsequent six sessions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _report_age(reset: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return bars elapsed since the latest point-in-time report reset."""
    n_rows, n_cols = reset.shape
    positions = pd.DataFrame(
        np.broadcast_to(np.arange(n_rows, dtype=float)[:, None], (n_rows, n_cols)),
        index=reset.index,
        columns=reset.columns,
    )
    latest_reset = positions.where(reset).ffill()
    return positions - latest_reset


def _finite_change_reset(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Identify actual-value updates relative to the preceding available value."""
    prior_available = actual.ffill().shift(1)
    current_valid = actual.notna() & ~actual.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    prior_valid = prior_available.notna() & ~prior_available.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    return current_valid & prior_valid & actual.ne(prior_available)


def _normalized_revision(
    estimate: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    lag: int,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute a lagged estimate revision with a causal cross-sectional floor."""
    prior = estimate.shift(lag)
    valid = (
        eligible
        & estimate.notna()
        & prior.notna()
        & ~estimate.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
        & ~prior.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    )
    prior_abs = prior.abs().where(valid)
    cross_sectional_floor = 0.01 * prior_abs.median(axis=1)
    denominator = prior.abs().where(
        prior.abs().ge(cross_sectional_floor, axis=0),
        cross_sectional_floor,
        axis=0,
    ).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    revision = ((estimate - prior) / denominator).where(valid)
    return revision.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _sector_acceleration_zscore(
    q: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Calculate sector robust z-scores, falling back to the eligible universe."""
    q_valid = q.where(eligible)
    universe_median = q_valid.median(axis=1)
    universe_mad = q_valid.sub(universe_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)

    labels = sector.ffill().iloc[-1].astype(object)
    labels = labels.where(labels.notna(), "__UNKNOWN_SECTOR__")
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=q.index, columns=q.columns, dtype=float)

    for _, members in labels.groupby(labels).groups.items():
        group_q = q_valid.loc[:, members]
        group_count = group_q.notna().sum(axis=1)
        group_median = group_q.median(axis=1)
        group_mad = group_q.sub(group_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        use_group = group_count.ge(5)
        location = group_median.where(use_group, universe_median)
        dispersion = group_mad.where(use_group, universe_mad)
        output.loc[:, members] = group_q.sub(location, axis=0).div(
            1.4826 * dispersion + 1e-12,
            axis=0,
        )

    return output.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


@register_factor
class ReportClockVarianceAccelerationRevision(BaseFactor):
    """Late-quarter revisions screened for sector-relative range-variance acceleration."""

    factor_id = "report_clock_variance_acceleration_revision"
    name = "Late-Clock Revision Diffusion with Variance-Completion Screen"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Ranks late-quarter EPS and revenue consensus revisions, then attenuates "
        "them when Parkinson range variance has accelerated unusually rapidly "
        "relative to the stock's sector."
    )
    window_length = 90
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "sector",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        if close.empty:
            return close.astype(float)

        eps_actual = data["epsActual"]
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"]
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"]
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"]

        reset = _finite_change_reset(eps_actual) | _finite_change_reset(revenue_actual)
        age = _report_age(reset)
        eligible = age.ge(35) & age.le(65)

        eps_revision = _normalized_revision(eps_estimate, eligible, 21)
        revenue_revision = _normalized_revision(revenue_estimate, eligible, 21)

        eps_score = 2.0 * eps_revision.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        revenue_score = 2.0 * revenue_revision.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        revision_score = 0.60 * eps_score + 0.40 * revenue_score

        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        valid_range = high.gt(0.0) & low.gt(0.0)
        range_ratio = high.where(valid_range) / low.where(valid_range)
        range_variance = np.log(range_ratio).pow(2) / (4.0 * np.log(2.0))

        short_variance = range_variance.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        long_variance = range_variance.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        acceleration = np.log((short_variance + 1e-12) / (long_variance + 1e-12))
        acceleration = acceleration.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        zscore = _sector_acceleration_zscore(acceleration, eligible, data["sector"])
        attenuation = zscore.clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0) / 2.0
        signal = revision_score * (1.0 - attenuation)

        valid_signal = eligible & revision_score.notna() & zscore.notna()
        return signal.where(valid_signal, 0.0).fillna(0.0).reindex(
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )

programs.trading_idea: The revised mechanism does not interpret elevated pre-report volatility as evidence that a public estimate revision contains superior private information. Instead, idiosyncratic range-variance acceleration is treated as a price-discovery and adverse-selection warning: when a stock has already experienced unusually rapid volatility acceleration relative to its sector, the information motivating a subsequent consensus change may already be reflected in price and implementation costs are likely elevated. The factor therefore seeks late-quarter estimate revisions only where sector-adjusted variance acceleration is subdued, consistent with slower diffusion of public analyst information into constrained institutional portfolios over the subsequent six sessions.
programs.description: At each close t, reset the reporting clock to age 0 whenever either epsActual or revenueActual is finite and differs from its immediately preceding available daily value; if both update on the same date, this is one reset with no field priority required. Report age is the number of daily bars since the most recent reset, and names are eligible only for ages 35 through 65 inclusive. Compute 21-bar estimate changes for both epsEstimate and revenueEstimate as (x_t - x_t-21) / max(abs(x_t-21), 0.01 times the cross-sectional median of abs(x_t-21) among valid names); require both estimates to be valid at t and t-21. Convert each normalized change to its same-date cross-sectional percentile rank among eligible names, map each rank to [-1,1], and define the signed revision score as 0.60 times the EPS score plus 0.40 times the revenue score. For volatility, define daily Parkinson range variance v_t = ln(high_t/low_t)^2 / (4 ln(2)), requiring positive high and low. Define q_i,t = ln((mean(v_i,t-4:t) + 1e-12) / (mean(v_i,t-19:t) + 1e-12)). Within each sector on each date, subtract the sector median q and divide by 1.4826 times the sector median absolute deviation plus 1e-12; if a sector has fewer than five valid names, use the full eligible-universe median and MAD instead. Let a_i,t = min(max(z_i,t, 0), 2) / 2, where z is this sector-adjusted acceleration score. The final factor is revision_score_i,t times (1 - a_i,t): positive revisions with low idiosyncratic acceleration are long signals and negative revisions with low acceleration are short signals, while high-acceleration names are continuously downweighted rather than treated as stronger information signals. Signals use only data available by the close of t and are executed at the next session's open; performance is measured over the fixed subsequent six daily bars.

"""Cash-quality conflict resolved by quiet post-report estimate revisions.

Mechanism: headline investors initially overweight reported EPS and revenue surprises
while underweighting whether the report is supported by cash conversion.  A later
consensus revision has more information when it confirms the cash-quality side of
that disagreement, provided price discovery has not already accelerated through an
unusually volatile sector-relative trading state.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _update_mask(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causally identify a newly available point-in-time fundamental update."""
    previous = df.shift(1)
    finite = df.notna() & ~df.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    return finite & previous.notna() & ~previous.isin([np.inf, -np.inf]) & df.ne(previous)


def _report_age(reset: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Bars elapsed since the latest report reset, using only current/past rows."""
    n_rows, n_cols = reset.shape
    positions = pd.DataFrame(
        np.broadcast_to(np.arange(n_rows, dtype=float)[:, None], (n_rows, n_cols)),
        index=reset.index,
        columns=reset.columns,
    )
    latest = positions.where(reset).ffill()
    return positions - latest


def _row_zscore(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Robust contemporaneous standardization with a standard-deviation fallback."""
    median = df.median(axis=1)
    centered = df.sub(median, axis=0)
    mad = centered.abs().median(axis=1) * 1.4826
    fallback = df.std(axis=1)
    scale = mad.where(mad.gt(1.0e-12), fallback).where(lambda x: x.gt(1.0e-12))
    return centered.div(scale, axis=0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _normalized_revision(estimate: pd.DataFrame, lag: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Lagged relative estimate change with a causal cross-sectional denominator floor."""
    prior = estimate.shift(lag)
    valid = estimate.notna() & prior.notna() & ~estimate.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    valid = valid & ~prior.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    prior_abs = prior.abs().where(valid)
    floor = 0.01 * prior_abs.median(axis=1)
    denominator = prior_abs.where(prior_abs.ge(floor, axis=0), floor, axis=0)
    return ((estimate - prior) / denominator.replace(0.0, np.nan)).replace(
        [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
    )


def _sector_acceleration_zscore(
    acceleration: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Sector-relative robust z-score, with an all-universe fallback for sparse sectors."""
    universe_median = acceleration.median(axis=1)
    universe_mad = acceleration.sub(universe_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
    labels = sector.ffill().iloc[-1].astype(object).fillna("__UNKNOWN_SECTOR__")
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=acceleration.index, columns=acceleration.columns)

    for label in pd.unique(labels):
        members = labels.index[labels.eq(label)]
        group = acceleration.loc[:, members]
        count = group.notna().sum(axis=1)
        group_median = group.median(axis=1)
        group_mad = group.sub(group_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        location = group_median.where(count.ge(5), universe_median)
        dispersion = group_mad.where(count.ge(5), universe_mad)
        output.loc[:, members] = group.sub(location, axis=0).div(
            1.4826 * dispersion + 1.0e-12, axis=0
        )

    return output.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


@register_factor
class CashConflictQuietRevisionResolution(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "cash_conflict_quiet_revision_resolution"
    name = "Quiet Cash-Conflict Revision Resolution"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Trades middle-of-clock EPS and revenue revisions only when they align with "
        "the latest report's cash-quality versus headline conflict, attenuating "
        "rapid sector-relative range-variance acceleration."
    )
    window_length = 90
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "cashConversionCycle",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "sector",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        if close.empty:
            return close.astype(float)

        report_reset = _update_mask(data["epsActual"]) | _update_mask(data["revenueActual"])
        age = _report_age(report_reset)
        middle_clock = age.ge(20) & age.le(55)

        eps_headline = _row_zscore(data["epsSurprise"])
        revenue_headline = _row_zscore(data["revenueSurprise"])
        headline_count = eps_headline.notna().astype(float) + revenue_headline.notna().astype(float)
        headline = (eps_headline.fillna(0.0) + revenue_headline.fillna(0.0)).div(
            headline_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )

        cash_improvement = -data["cashConversionCycle"].diff()
        ocf_improvement = data["operatingCashFlow"].diff()
        quality = 0.5 * _row_zscore(cash_improvement) + 0.5 * _row_zscore(ocf_improvement)
        opposed = headline.mul(quality).lt(0.0)

        # At every report the state is explicitly reset: no conflict means no carried signal.
        event_direction = np.sign(quality).where(opposed & quality.notna(), 0.0)
        conflict_state = event_direction.where(report_reset).ffill().fillna(0.0)

        eps_revision = _normalized_revision(data["epsEstimate"], 21)
        revenue_revision = _normalized_revision(data["revenueEstimate"], 21)
        revision_count = eps_revision.notna().astype(float) + revenue_revision.notna().astype(float)
        revision_raw = (eps_revision.fillna(0.0) + revenue_revision.fillna(0.0)).div(
            revision_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        revision = 2.0 * revision_raw.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0

        valid_range = data["high"].gt(0.0) & data["low"].gt(0.0)
        range_ratio = data["high"].where(valid_range) / data["low"].where(valid_range)
        range_variance = np.log(range_ratio).pow(2) / (4.0 * np.log(2.0))
        short_variance = range_variance.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        long_variance = range_variance.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        acceleration = np.log((short_variance + 1.0e-12) / (long_variance + 1.0e-12))
        acceleration_z = _sector_acceleration_zscore(
            acceleration.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan), data["sector"]
        )
        quietness = np.exp(-acceleration_z.clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0))

        # Revisions must move toward the economically credible cash-quality resolution.
        agreement = revision.mul(conflict_state)
        signal = conflict_state * agreement.clip(lower=0.0) * quietness
        active = middle_clock & conflict_state.ne(0.0) & revision.notna() & quietness.notna()
        return signal.where(active, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0).reindex(
            index=close.index, columns=close.columns
        )
programs.name: Quiet Cash-Conflict Revision Resolution
programs.trading_idea: A negative earnings headline paired with improving cash conversion, or a positive headline paired with deteriorating cash conversion, creates a latent fundamental disagreement that fast headline traders initially misprice. The child waits until the post-report interval, then trades only estimate revisions that resolve that disagreement in the cash-quality direction, while requiring subdued sector-relative range-variance acceleration so the revision is not already being rapidly incorporated through adverse-selection-driven price discovery. Neither parent alone identifies this three-way state: cash conflict supplies the economically credible direction, revisions supply the delayed public-information catalyst, and quiet volatility identifies the names where diffusion remains incomplete over the next six sessions.
programs.description: Carries forward the signed cash-quality/headline conflict from the latest report, selects post-report EPS and revenue revisions aligned with that conflict, and attenuates names with elevated sector-relative Parkinson variance acceleration. The signal is active only in the middle of the reporting clock after a genuine report update.

programs.code:
"""A broad industry repricing can create a predictable residual only when a stock's realized response is materially below its own ex-ante, historically estimated exposure to that industry's contemporaneous shock. Unlike a raw low-volume or low-participation lead-lag trade, this signal isolates the loading-implied response shortfall after removing the cross-sectional component explained by the industry return, stock liquidity participation, and industry breadth. The position is entered only on the following tradable bar, treating the shock-close calculation as information available after the bar rather than executable at that close."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _industry_leave_one_out_statistics(
    ret: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Compute causal same-bar leave-one-out industry returns and breadth."""
    loo_return = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    industry_breadth = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    member_count = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        columns = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(columns) == 0:
            continue

        group_ret = ret.loc[:, columns]
        valid = group_ret.notna()
        count = valid.sum(axis=1).astype(float)
        total = group_ret.sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
        mean_return = total / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        own_loo = group_ret.rsub(total, axis=0).div((count - 1.0).replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
        same_direction = group_ret.mul(mean_return, axis=0).gt(0.0).sum(axis=1)
        breadth = same_direction / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        loo_return.loc[:, columns] = own_loo
        industry_breadth.loc[:, columns] = pd.DataFrame(
            np.repeat(breadth.to_numpy()[:, None], len(columns), axis=1),
            index=ret.index,
            columns=columns,
        )
        member_count.loc[:, columns] = pd.DataFrame(
            np.repeat(count.to_numpy()[:, None], len(columns), axis=1),
            index=ret.index,
            columns=columns,
        )

    return loo_return, industry_breadth, member_count


def _cross_sectional_residual(
    response: pd.DataFrame,
    predictors: list[pd.DataFrame],
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Residualize each row with a masked contemporaneous OLS and intercept."""
    y = response.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    predictor_values = [item.to_numpy(dtype=float) for item in predictors]
    x = np.stack([np.ones_like(y)] + predictor_values, axis=2)

    finite = np.isfinite(y) & np.isfinite(x).all(axis=2) & eligible.to_numpy(dtype=bool)
    weights = finite.astype(float)
    safe_x = np.where(np.isfinite(x), x, 0.0)
    safe_y = np.where(np.isfinite(y), y, 0.0)

    xtx = np.einsum("tni,tnj,tn->tij", safe_x, safe_x, weights)
    xty = np.einsum("tni,tn,tn->ti", safe_x, safe_y, weights)
    coefficients = np.einsum("tij,tj->ti", np.linalg.pinv(xtx), xty)
    fitted = np.einsum("tni,ti->tn", safe_x, coefficients)

    enough_observations = weights.sum(axis=1) >= (x.shape[2] + 1)
    residual = np.where(finite & enough_observations[:, None], y - fitted, np.nan)
    return pd.DataFrame(residual, index=response.index, columns=response.columns)


@register_factor
class IndustryLoadingParticipationDeficitCatchup(BaseFactor):
    """Industry-loading residual shortfall among temporarily under-participating names."""

    factor_id = "industry_loading_participation_deficit_catchup"
    name = "Pre-Estimated Industry-Loading Residual Catch-Up"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "Ranks next-bar tradable positions in stocks whose response to a broad, "
        "high-breadth industry shock falls below a loading estimated strictly "
        "before the shock, conditional on low volume participation."
    )
    window_length = 61
    inputs = ["close", "open", "high", "low", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_price = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
        ret = ret.where(close.gt(0.0) & close.shift(1).gt(0.0))

        # Industry is static in this feed.  The first supplied label is used so
        # grouping itself cannot be altered by later market observations.
        industry_labels = data["industry"].iloc[0]
        loo_industry_return, breadth, member_count = _industry_leave_one_out_statistics(
            ret, industry_labels
        )

        prior_ret = ret.shift(1)
        prior_industry_return = loo_industry_return.shift(1)
        covariance = prior_ret.rolling(60, min_periods=40).cov(prior_industry_return)
        industry_variance = prior_industry_return.rolling(60, min_periods=40).var()
        beta = covariance / industry_variance.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        mean_volume = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        volume_ratio = volume / mean_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        intraday_range = (high - low) / open_price.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        shock = loo_industry_return.abs().gt(0.015)
        eligible = (
            member_count.ge(10.0)
            & shock
            & breadth.ge(0.65)
            & beta.notna()
            & volume.notna()
            & mean_volume.gt(0.0)
            & volume_ratio.lt(0.75)
            & ret.abs().le(0.08)
            & open_price.gt(0.0)
            & intraday_range.notna()
            & intraday_range.le(0.10)
        )

        direction = np.sign(loo_industry_return)
        signed_gap = direction * (beta * loo_industry_return - ret)
        residual = _cross_sectional_residual(
            signed_gap,
            [loo_industry_return, volume_ratio, breadth],
            eligible,
        )

        residual_rank = residual.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        long_mask = residual_rank.ge(0.90)
        short_mask = residual_rank.le(0.10)

        long_count = long_mask.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan)
        short_count = short_mask.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan)
        long_weights = long_mask.div(long_count, axis=0).fillna(0.0)
        short_weights = short_mask.div(short_count, axis=0).fillna(0.0)

        # The close-to-close shock is observed only after this bar has ended.
        return (long_weights - short_weights).shift(1).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Pre-Estimated Industry-Loading Residual Catch-Up
programs.trading_idea: A broad industry repricing can create a predictable residual only when a stock's realized response is materially below its own ex-ante, historically estimated exposure to that industry's contemporaneous shock. Unlike a raw low-volume or low-participation lead-lag trade, this signal isolates the loading-implied response shortfall after removing the cross-sectional component explained by the industry return, stock liquidity participation, and industry breadth. The position is entered only on the following tradable bar, treating the shock-close calculation as information available after the bar rather than executable at that close.
programs.description: At each daily close t, compute stock returns and a leave-one-out equal-weight industry return using constituents with valid closes; require at least 10 eligible industry members. Estimate each stock's industry loading before t only, as the 60-trading-day rolling covariance of its daily return with its leave-one-out industry return divided by the rolling industry-return variance, using observations ending at t-1 and requiring at least 40 valid observations. Define an industry shock as an absolute leave-one-out industry return above 1.5%, with directional breadth of at least 65% of valid industry constituents having same-signed returns. For eligible names, compute the signed loading-implied response gap as sign(industry shock) times (beta times industry shock minus realized stock return). Require own volume at t to be below 75% of its trailing 20-day mean volume, absolute stock return no greater than 8%, and intraday range (high-low)/open no greater than 10%, excluding zero or invalid opens. To differentiate this from raw industry-liquidity/breadth shock factors, cross-sectionally residualize the signed loading-implied gap against the contemporaneous signed industry return, the stock's volume-to-20-day-average-volume ratio, and the industry directional-breadth measure; rank the residual only within eligible stocks. Go long the highest residual-decile names and short the lowest residual-decile names, equal weighted within sides, with positions formed no earlier than the next tradable bar and evaluated over the fixed six-bar horizon.

"""Resilience-conditioned differentiation after common-shock liquidity pressure.

A broad industry shock may be transmitted through basket demand, while an extreme
name-level residual with abnormal participation and range indicates temporary
liquidity pressure.  Fundamental resilience determines which pressured relative
responses are likely to resolve into post-shock differentiation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _industry_state(
    ret: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causal same-bar leave-one-out industry shock, breadth, and dispersion."""
    shock = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    breadth = shock.copy()
    dispersion = shock.copy()

    labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(ret.columns)
    valid_labels = labels.dropna()
    groups = valid_labels.groupby(valid_labels, sort=False).groups

    for members in groups.values():
        if len(members) < 6:
            continue
        group_ret = ret.loc[:, members]
        valid = group_ret.notna()
        count = valid.sum(axis=1)
        peer_count = count - 1
        eligible = peer_count >= 5

        total = group_ret.sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
        loo = total.to_frame().sub(group_ret).div(peer_count.replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
        loo = loo.where(valid & eligible.to_numpy()[:, None])

        positive = ((group_ret > 0.0) & valid).sum(axis=1)
        negative = ((group_ret < 0.0) & valid).sum(axis=1)
        peer_positive = positive.to_frame().sub(((group_ret > 0.0) & valid).astype(float))
        peer_negative = negative.to_frame().sub(((group_ret < 0.0) & valid).astype(float))
        same_direction = peer_positive.where(loo > 0.0, peer_negative)
        group_breadth = same_direction.div(peer_count.replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
        group_breadth = group_breadth.where(valid & eligible.to_numpy()[:, None])

        residual = group_ret - loo
        median_residual = residual.median(axis=1)
        group_dispersion = residual.sub(median_residual, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        group_dispersion = group_dispersion.where(eligible)

        shock.loc[:, members] = loo
        breadth.loc[:, members] = group_breadth
        dispersion.loc[:, members] = np.repeat(
            group_dispersion.to_numpy()[:, None], len(members), axis=1
        )

    return shock, breadth, dispersion


def _within_industry_rank(frame: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectional percentile rank within static industries on each date."""
    labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(frame.columns)
    return frame.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True).T


@register_factor
class ResilientIndustryPressureDifferentiation(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "resilient_industry_pressure_differentiation"
    name = "Resilient Industry Pressure Differentiation"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "During broad dispersed industry shocks, sorts only abnormal-volume, "
        "wide-range directional residual-pressure events by financial resilience "
        "and shock-direction-adjusted relative response."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "volume",
        "industry",
        "grossMargin",
        "sgaToRevenue",
        "currentRatio",
        "debtToEquity",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        valid_return = (
            close.notna()
            & previous_close.notna()
            & (close > 0.0)
            & (previous_close > 0.0)
        )
        ret = (close / previous_close - 1.0).where(valid_return)

        shock, breadth, dispersion = _industry_state(ret, data["industry"])
        residual = ret - shock
        residual_rank = _within_industry_rank(residual, data["industry"]) - 0.5

        shock_threshold = shock.abs().shift(1).rolling(60, min_periods=35).quantile(0.75)
        dispersion_threshold = dispersion.shift(1).rolling(60, min_periods=35).quantile(0.75)
        broad_material_shock = (
            shock.notna()
            & (shock.abs() >= shock_threshold)
            & (breadth >= 0.65)
            & (dispersion >= dispersion_threshold)
        )

        prior_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0).shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).median()
        volume_multiple = volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        raw_range = high - low
        valid_range = (high > 0.0) & (low > 0.0) & (close > 0.0) & (raw_range > 0.0)
        normalized_range = (raw_range / close).where(valid_range)
        prior_range = normalized_range.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).median()
        range_multiple = normalized_range / prior_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / raw_range - 1.0).where(valid_range)
        directional_endpoint = np.sign(residual) * close_location >= 0.65

        pressure_event = (
            valid_range
            & (volume_multiple >= 1.30)
            & (range_multiple >= 1.25)
            & directional_endpoint
        )

        gm = data["grossMargin"]
        sga = data["sgaToRevenue"]
        liquidity = data["currentRatio"]
        leverage = data["debtToEquity"]
        fundamental_valid = gm.notna() & sga.notna() & liquidity.notna() & leverage.notna()

        resilience = (
            (_within_industry_rank(gm.where(fundamental_valid), data["industry"]) - 0.5)
            + (0.5 - _within_industry_rank(sga.where(fundamental_valid), data["industry"]))
            + (_within_industry_rank(liquidity.where(fundamental_valid), data["industry"]) - 0.5)
            + (0.5 - _within_industry_rank(leverage.where(fundamental_valid), data["industry"]))
        ) / 4.0

        differentiation = resilience - np.sign(shock) * residual_rank
        active = broad_material_shock & pressure_event & fundamental_valid & residual_rank.notna()
        return differentiation.where(active, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Resilient Industry Pressure Differentiation
programs.trading_idea: Broad industry shocks initially move correlated baskets, but unusually high-volume, wide-range residual moves ending at the directional extreme identify names where the common shock is being expressed through temporary liquidity demand rather than clean firm-specific information. The child then applies the resilience state variable to this pressure subset: after positive industry shocks it favors resilient forced laggards, while after negative shocks it favors resilient relative defenders over fragile disproportionate decliners. Parent A alone reverses all pressure residuals and can fade genuine differentiation, while Parent B alone cannot distinguish slow fundamental sorting from transient order-flow displacement; their interaction isolates the subset where balance-sheet capacity determines which pressure-induced relative moves repair over the six-day horizon.
programs.description: Within broad, high-dispersion industry shocks, the factor activates only for abnormal volume, range, and close-location residual-pressure events. It ranks firms by an industry-relative resilience composite minus their shock-direction-adjusted residual-return rank.

programs.code:
"""Resilient revision diffusion after common-shock liquidity pressure.

Late-quarter estimate changes diffuse most cleanly when industry-level basket flow
creates a temporary relative-price displacement, but idiosyncratic variance has not
already signalled completed price discovery.  Financial resilience determines whether
that pressure displacement can repair in the direction of the revision.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _change_reset(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Identify a newly available reported value using only prior observations."""
    prior = actual.ffill().shift(1)
    valid = actual.notna() & prior.notna()
    return valid & actual.ne(prior)


def _report_age(reset: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Bars elapsed since the latest report update, with no forward-looking reset."""
    rows, cols = reset.shape
    positions = pd.DataFrame(
        np.broadcast_to(np.arange(rows, dtype=float)[:, None], (rows, cols)),
        index=reset.index,
        columns=reset.columns,
    )
    return positions - positions.where(reset).ffill()


def _revision(estimate: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame, lag: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causally normalised consensus revision with a daily cross-sectional floor."""
    prior = estimate.shift(lag)
    valid = eligible & estimate.notna() & prior.notna()
    prior_abs = prior.abs().where(valid)
    floor = 0.01 * prior_abs.median(axis=1)
    denom = prior.abs().where(prior.abs().ge(floor, axis=0), floor, axis=0)
    return ((estimate - prior) / denom.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(valid)


def _group_rank(frame: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectional percentile rank within static industry labels."""
    label = labels.iloc[0].reindex(frame.columns)
    return frame.T.groupby(label, sort=False).rank(pct=True).T


def _industry_shock(
    ret: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Leave-one-out industry return, directional breadth, and residual dispersion."""
    shock = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    breadth = shock.copy()
    dispersion = shock.copy()
    labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(ret.columns)

    for members in labels.dropna().groupby(labels.dropna(), sort=False).groups.values():
        if len(members) < 6:
            continue
        group_ret = ret.loc[:, members]
        valid = group_ret.notna()
        count = valid.sum(axis=1)
        peer_count = count - 1
        eligible = peer_count.ge(5)
        total = group_ret.sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
        loo = total.to_frame().sub(group_ret).div(peer_count.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
        loo = loo.where(valid & eligible.to_numpy()[:, None])

        positive = ((group_ret > 0.0) & valid).sum(axis=1)
        negative = ((group_ret < 0.0) & valid).sum(axis=1)
        peer_positive = positive.to_frame().sub(((group_ret > 0.0) & valid).astype(float))
        peer_negative = negative.to_frame().sub(((group_ret < 0.0) & valid).astype(float))
        same_way = peer_positive.where(loo > 0.0, peer_negative)
        group_breadth = same_way.div(peer_count.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)

        residual = group_ret - loo
        med = residual.median(axis=1)
        mad = residual.sub(med, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1).where(eligible)

        shock.loc[:, members] = loo
        breadth.loc[:, members] = group_breadth.where(valid & eligible.to_numpy()[:, None])
        dispersion.loc[:, members] = np.repeat(mad.to_numpy()[:, None], len(members), axis=1)

    return shock, breadth, dispersion


def _sector_zscore(frame: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Robust sector-relative z-score, using the full cross-section as fallback."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=frame.index, columns=frame.columns)
    labels = sector.iloc[0].reindex(frame.columns).fillna("__UNKNOWN__")
    universe_med = frame.median(axis=1)
    universe_mad = frame.sub(universe_med, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)

    for members in labels.groupby(labels, sort=False).groups.values():
        subset = frame.loc[:, members]
        med = subset.median(axis=1)
        mad = subset.sub(med, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        enough = subset.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(5)
        loc = med.where(enough, universe_med)
        scale = mad.where(enough, universe_mad)
        output.loc[:, members] = subset.sub(loc, axis=0).div(1.4826 * scale + 1e-12, axis=0)
    return output


@register_factor
class RevisionPressureResilienceDiffusion(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "revision_pressure_resilience_diffusion"
    name = "Resilient Revision Pressure Diffusion"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Late-quarter estimate revisions are traded only in broad industry pressure "
        "states, with low variance-completion risk and resilience-aligned relative repair."
    )
    window_length = 90
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "volume",
        "industry",
        "sector",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "grossMargin",
        "sgaToRevenue",
        "currentRatio",
        "debtToEquity",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        if close.empty:
            return close.astype(float)

        reset = _change_reset(data["epsActual"]) | _change_reset(data["revenueActual"])
        age = _report_age(reset)
        late_clock = age.ge(35) & age.le(65)

        eps_rev = _revision(data["epsEstimate"], late_clock, 21)
        revenue_rev = _revision(data["revenueEstimate"], late_clock, 21)
        revision = 0.60 * (2.0 * eps_rev.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0)
        revision = revision + 0.40 * (2.0 * revenue_rev.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0)

        valid_range = (data["high"] > 0.0) & (data["low"] > 0.0)
        rv = (np.log(data["high"].where(valid_range) / data["low"].where(valid_range)).pow(2)
              / (4.0 * np.log(2.0)))
        short_rv = rv.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        long_rv = rv.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        acceleration = np.log((short_rv + 1e-12) / (long_rv + 1e-12))
        variance_z = _sector_zscore(acceleration, data["sector"])
        completion_discount = 1.0 - variance_z.clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0) / 2.0

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        ret = (close / prior_close - 1.0).where((close > 0.0) & (prior_close > 0.0))
        shock, breadth, dispersion = _industry_shock(ret, data["industry"])
        residual = ret - shock
        residual_rank = _group_rank(residual, data["industry"]) - 0.5

        shock_cutoff = shock.abs().shift(1).rolling(60, min_periods=35).quantile(0.75)
        dispersion_cutoff = dispersion.shift(1).rolling(60, min_periods=35).quantile(0.75)
        broad_shock = (shock.abs() >= shock_cutoff) & (breadth >= 0.65) & (dispersion >= dispersion_cutoff)

        prior_volume = data["volume"].where(data["volume"] > 0.0).shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).median()
        volume_multiple = data["volume"] / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        raw_range = data["high"] - data["low"]
        normalized_range = (raw_range / close).where(valid_range & (raw_range > 0.0) & (close > 0.0))
        prior_range = normalized_range.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).median()
        range_multiple = normalized_range / prior_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = (2.0 * (close - data["low"]) / raw_range - 1.0).where(raw_range > 0.0)
        endpoint = np.sign(residual) * close_location >= 0.65
        pressure = broad_shock & (volume_multiple >= 1.30) & (range_multiple >= 1.25) & endpoint

        fundamental_valid = (
            data["grossMargin"].notna() & data["sgaToRevenue"].notna()
            & data["currentRatio"].notna() & data["debtToEquity"].notna()
        )
        resilience = (
            (_group_rank(data["grossMargin"].where(fundamental_valid), data["industry"]) - 0.5)
            + (0.5 - _group_rank(data["sgaToRevenue"].where(fundamental_valid), data["industry"]))
            + (_group_rank(data["currentRatio"].where(fundamental_valid), data["industry"]) - 0.5)
            + (0.5 - _group_rank(data["debtToEquity"].where(fundamental_valid), data["industry"]))
        ) / 4.0

        repair = resilience - np.sign(shock) * residual_rank
        alignment = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh(3.0 * revision * repair)
        signal = revision * completion_discount * alignment
        active = late_clock & pressure & fundamental_valid & revision.notna() & variance_z.notna() & repair.notna()
        return signal.where(active, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).reindex(
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )
programs.name: Resilient Revision Pressure Diffusion
programs.trading_idea: Late-quarter analyst revisions are most actionable over six days when common industry-shock order flow has temporarily displaced the stock's relative price rather than already completing price discovery. The child uses Parent A's subdued sector-relative range-variance acceleration screen to avoid revisions already incorporated through adverse-selection trading, then conditions the revision on Parent B's broad-shock, abnormal-volume/range pressure state and balance-sheet resilience. The interaction carries edge because a revision alone cannot distinguish slow fundamental diffusion from already-priced news, while a pressure-reversal signal alone cannot determine the economically correct recovery direction; resilient names whose pressure-induced relative move is aligned with an unassimilated revision should repair in the revision direction.
programs.description: Ranks late-report-clock EPS and revenue estimate revisions, attenuates names with accelerated sector-relative range variance, and activates the signal during broad industry shocks with abnormal directional pressure. Revision strength is amplified when the pressured relative move and financial resilience imply a recovery in the same direction as the estimate change.

programs.code:
"""A broad, market-adjusted industry shock can be incorporated unevenly when sparse contemporaneous trading constrains price formation in individual stocks. Rather than conditioning on an earnings surprise, the factor identifies low-volume-participation stocks whose first completed-bar response is weak relative to a broad, volume-confirmed industry shock and expects their residual return to move in the shock direction over the next several sessions. This is a common-shock propagation and liquidity-diffusion signal, not a post-earnings-announcement-drift signal; it deliberately uses no disclosure, estimate, or surprise fields."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _trailing_market_industry_residual(
    ret: pd.DataFrame,
    market: pd.Series,
    industry_shock: pd.DataFrame,
    lookback: int = 60,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Return current residual and trailing OLS residual scale using t-60..t-1.

    The regression includes an intercept, market return, and each name's
    leave-one-out industry shock. All sufficient statistics are shifted before
    rolling, so neither fitted coefficients nor residual scale use bar t.
    """
    index = ret.index
    columns = ret.columns
    market_panel = pd.DataFrame(
        np.broadcast_to(market.to_numpy()[:, None], ret.shape).copy(),
        index=index,
        columns=columns,
    )

    valid = ret.notna() & market_panel.notna() & industry_shock.notna()
    valid_float = valid.astype(float)
    y = ret.where(valid, 0.0)
    x1 = market_panel.where(valid, 0.0)
    x2 = industry_shock.where(valid, 0.0)

    def trailing_sum(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return frame.shift(1).rolling(lookback, min_periods=1).sum()

    nobs = trailing_sum(valid_float)
    sx1 = trailing_sum(x1)
    sx2 = trailing_sum(x2)
    sy = trailing_sum(y)
    sx1x1 = trailing_sum(x1 * x1)
    sx1x2 = trailing_sum(x1 * x2)
    sx2x2 = trailing_sum(x2 * x2)
    sx1y = trailing_sum(x1 * y)
    sx2y = trailing_sum(x2 * y)
    syy = trailing_sum(y * y)

    # Determinants for X'X and the two slope coefficients.  The intercept is
    # recovered after solving for the slopes, avoiding per-ticker Python OLS.
    determinant = (
        nobs * (sx1x1 * sx2x2 - sx1x2 * sx1x2)
        - sx1 * (sx1 * sx2x2 - sx1x2 * sx2)
        + sx2 * (sx1 * sx1x2 - sx1x1 * sx2)
    )
    safe_determinant = determinant.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    beta_market = (
        nobs * (sx1y * sx2x2 - sx1x2 * sx2y)
        - sy * (sx1 * sx2x2 - sx1x2 * sx2)
        + sx2 * (sx1 * sx2y - sx1y * sx2)
    ) / safe_determinant
    beta_industry = (
        nobs * (sx1x1 * sx2y - sx1y * sx1x2)
        - sx1 * (sx1 * sx2y - sx1y * sx2)
        + sy * (sx1 * sx1x2 - sx1x1 * sx2)
    ) / safe_determinant
    intercept = (sy - beta_market * sx1 - beta_industry * sx2) / nobs.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    enough_history = nobs >= 40.0
    beta_market = beta_market.where(enough_history)
    beta_industry = beta_industry.where(enough_history)
    intercept = intercept.where(enough_history)

    fitted_now = intercept + beta_market * market_panel + beta_industry * industry_shock
    residual_now = (ret - fitted_now).where(valid & enough_history)

    # OLS training residual variance, computed from the same trailing design
    # matrix. This is the standard deviation of regression residuals over the
    # pre-t fitting window, with three fitted parameters.
    sse = syy - intercept * sy - beta_market * sx1y - beta_industry * sx2y
    residual_scale = np.sqrt(sse.clip(lower=0.0) / (nobs - 3.0).replace(0.0, np.nan))
    residual_scale = residual_scale.where(enough_history)

    return residual_now, residual_scale


@register_factor
class CommonShockLiquidityDiffusionLag(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks weakly participating stocks that lag a broad industry liquidity shock."""

    factor_id = "common_shock_liquidity_diffusion_lag"
    name = "Common-Shock Liquidity Diffusion Lag"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "Cross-sectional rank of market-and-industry residual underreaction to "
        "a broad, volume-confirmed leave-one-out industry shock, restricted to "
        "stocks with unusually weak current participation but adequate normal liquidity."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = ["close", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        industry = data["industry"]

        result_template = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        if close.empty or close.shape[0] == 0:
            return result_template

        # Industry is static by contract; using its first panel row avoids any
        # dependence on later bar values. Missing labels are deliberately excluded.
        labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(close.columns)
        valid_label = labels.notna()
        if not valid_label.any():
            return result_template

        safe_close = close.where(close > 0.0)
        ret = safe_close.pct_change()
        ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        market = ret.mean(axis=1, skipna=True)

        prior_volume_median = volume.where(volume > 0.0).shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        participation = volume.where(volume > 0.0) / prior_volume_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        dollar_volume = (safe_close * volume.where(volume > 0.0)).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        normal_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        universe_dollar_cutoff = normal_dollar_volume.quantile(0.20, axis=1)

        industry_shock = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        active = pd.DataFrame(False, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        industry_participation_median = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        group_columns: dict[object, list[object]] = {}
        for column in close.columns:
            label = labels.loc[column]
            if pd.notna(label):
                group_columns.setdefault(label, []).append(column)

        industry_level_shocks = pd.DataFrame(index=close.index)
        consensus_by_group: dict[object, pd.Series] = {}
        volume_median_by_group: dict[object, pd.Series] = {}
        eligible_by_group: dict[object, pd.Series] = {}

        for label, columns in group_columns.items():
            group_ret = ret[columns]
            eligible = group_ret.notna()
            count = eligible.sum(axis=1)
            group_sum = group_ret.sum(axis=1, skipna=True)
            group_mean = group_sum / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            group_shock = (group_mean - market).where(count >= 5)
            industry_level_shocks[label] = group_shock
            eligible_by_group[label] = count >= 5

            leave_one_out = group_sum.to_frame().sub(group_ret).div(
                count.sub(1).replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0
            ).sub(market, axis=0)
            leave_one_out = leave_one_out.where(eligible & count.ge(5), np.nan)
            industry_shock.loc[:, columns] = leave_one_out

            market_adjusted = group_ret.sub(market, axis=0)
            positive_fraction = market_adjusted.gt(0.0).sum(axis=1) / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            negative_fraction = market_adjusted.lt(0.0).sum(axis=1) / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            same_sign_fraction = leave_one_out.gt(0.0).mul(positive_fraction, axis=0)
            same_sign_fraction = same_sign_fraction + leave_one_out.lt(0.0).mul(negative_fraction, axis=0)
            consensus_by_group[label] = same_sign_fraction.ge(2.0 / 3.0).all(axis=1)

            group_participation_median = participation[columns].median(axis=1, skipna=True)
            volume_median_by_group[label] = group_participation_median
            industry_participation_median.loc[:, columns] = pd.DataFrame(
                np.broadcast_to(group_participation_median.to_numpy()[:, None], (len(close.index), len(columns))).copy(),
                index=close.index,
                columns=columns,
            )

        top_quartile = industry_level_shocks.abs().rank(axis=1, pct=True).ge(0.75)
        for label, columns in group_columns.items():
            group_is_active = (
                eligible_by_group[label]
                & consensus_by_group[label]
                & top_quartile[label]
                & volume_median_by_group[label].gt(1.0)
            )
            active.loc[:, columns] = pd.DataFrame(
                np.broadcast_to(group_is_active.to_numpy()[:, None], (len(close.index), len(columns))).copy(),
                index=close.index,
                columns=columns,
            )

        residual, residual_scale = _trailing_market_industry_residual(ret, market, industry_shock, 60)
        standardized_response = residual / residual_scale.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        score = -np.sign(industry_shock) * standardized_response

        sufficiently_liquid = normal_dollar_volume.gt(universe_dollar_cutoff, axis=0)
        weak_participation = participation.lt(industry_participation_median)
        retained = active & weak_participation & sufficiently_liquid & valid_label

        ranked = rank(score.where(retained))
        return ranked.where(retained, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Common-Shock Liquidity Diffusion Lag
programs.trading_idea: A broad, market-adjusted industry shock can be incorporated unevenly when sparse contemporaneous trading constrains price formation in individual stocks. Rather than conditioning on an earnings surprise, the factor identifies low-volume-participation stocks whose first completed-bar response is weak relative to a broad, volume-confirmed industry shock and expects their residual return to move in the shock direction over the next several sessions. This is a common-shock propagation and liquidity-diffusion signal, not a post-earnings-announcement-drift signal; it deliberately uses no disclosure, estimate, or surprise fields.
programs.description: At each completed daily bar t, define each stock's close-to-close return r_i,t and the equal-weighted market return M_t over stocks with valid prices. Use the static industry field only; exclude missing-industry names and industries with fewer than five eligible peers. For stock i, define its leave-one-out industry excess shock J_i,t as the equal-weighted mean of peer returns minus M_t. An industry is active only if (i) at least two-thirds of its eligible members have market-adjusted returns with the same sign as J_i,t, (ii) |J_i,t| is in the top quartile of absolute leave-one-out industry shocks across eligible industries on t, and (iii) the median peer volume divided by its own trailing 20-completed-bar median volume exceeds 1, confirming that the move reflects broad trading rather than a single stale print. Estimate each stock's normal market-and-industry exposure using an OLS regression of r_i on M and its leave-one-out industry excess shock over bars t-60 through t-1, requiring at least 40 valid observations; the residual from applying those pre-t coefficients to t is the contemporaneous idiosyncratic response epsilon_i,t. Retain stocks whose own volume/20-bar-median-volume ratio is below their active industry's median, but whose 20-bar median dollar-volume proxy (close times volume) is above the universe 20th percentile, so the signal targets unusually weak participation without selecting structurally untradable names. Score each retained stock as -sign(J_i,t) times epsilon_i,t divided by the trailing 60-bar standard deviation of regression residuals. Cross-sectionally rank scores across all retained active-industry stocks: buy the highest-score names, which lag the signed common shock, and short the lowest-score names, which overshoot it. Compute the signal after the close of t, enter at the next bar's open, rebalance daily, and evaluate the position over the fixed next six daily bars.
