"""Solvent, concentrated earnings deliveries produce forecast-reset drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _fresh_release(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """True only on the first bar at which a reported field changes."""
    previous = actual.shift(1)
    return actual.notna() & (previous.isna() | actual.ne(previous))


def _pre_event_transition_entropy(
    ret: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal entropy of four return-volume states ending before the event bar."""
    volume_reference = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
    valid = ret.notna() & volume.gt(0.0) & volume_reference.gt(0.0)
    up = ret.gt(0.0)
    high_volume = volume.ge(volume_reference)
    state = pd.DataFrame(
        np.where(
            up.to_numpy(),
            np.where(high_volume.to_numpy(), 0.0, 1.0),
            np.where(high_volume.to_numpy(), 2.0, 3.0),
        ),
        index=ret.index,
        columns=ret.columns,
    ).where(valid)

    transition = state.shift(1) * 4.0 + state.shift(2)
    count_valid = transition.notna().rolling(15, min_periods=15).sum()
    entropy = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    for code in range(16):
        count = transition.eq(float(code)).rolling(15, min_periods=15).sum()
        probability = count / count_valid.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        safe_probability = probability.where(probability.gt(0.0), 1.0)
        entropy = entropy - safe_probability * np.log(safe_probability)
    return (entropy / np.log(16.0)).where(count_valid.ge(15.0))


def _six_bar_entry_hold(event_signal: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Enter on the next bar and retain a report signal for six daily bars."""
    entered = event_signal.shift(1)
    return entered.ffill(limit=5).fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class SolventEntropyGatedDeliveryDrift(BaseFactor):
    """Forecast-reset drift when credible delivery meets concentrated prior flow."""

    factor_id = "solvent_entropy_gated_delivery_drift"
    name = "Solvent Entropy-Gated Delivery Drift"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Ranks corroborated residual EPS and revenue delivery only when the report "
        "arrives after concentrated low-entropy participation and the issuer has "
        "strong balance-sheet capacity, then holds the next-bar signal for six bars."
    )
    window_length = 45
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "operatingMargin",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "cashRatio",
        "currentRatio",
        "debtToEquity",
        "netDebtToEbitda",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        ret = close.pct_change(fill_method=None)

        eps_actual = data["epsActual"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        operating_margin = data["operatingMargin"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        operating_cash_flow = data["operatingCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        fresh = _fresh_release(eps_actual) | _fresh_release(revenue_actual)

        eps_prior = eps_estimate.shift(1)
        eps_old = eps_estimate.shift(22)
        revenue_prior = revenue_estimate.shift(1)
        revenue_old = revenue_estimate.shift(22)

        eps_valid = (
            eps_actual.notna()
            & eps_prior.notna()
            & eps_old.notna()
            & eps_prior.abs().gt(0.0)
            & eps_old.abs().gt(0.0)
        )
        revenue_valid = (
            revenue_actual.notna()
            & revenue_prior.notna()
            & revenue_old.notna()
            & revenue_prior.abs().gt(0.0)
            & revenue_old.abs().gt(0.0)
        )

        eps_delivery = (eps_actual - eps_prior) / eps_prior.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        eps_revision = (eps_prior - eps_old) / eps_old.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        revenue_delivery = (revenue_actual - revenue_prior) / revenue_prior.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        revenue_revision = (revenue_prior - revenue_old) / revenue_old.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        eps_residual = (eps_delivery - eps_revision).where(eps_valid)
        revenue_residual = (revenue_delivery - revenue_revision).where(revenue_valid)

        complete_delivery = eps_residual.notna() & revenue_residual.notna()
        raw_delivery = (0.5 * eps_residual + 0.5 * revenue_residual).where(complete_delivery)
        delivery_score = (2.0 * raw_delivery.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0).where(complete_delivery)

        margin_change = operating_margin - operating_margin.shift(1)
        cash_change = operating_cash_flow - operating_cash_flow.shift(1)
        positive_confirmation = raw_delivery.gt(0.0) & margin_change.gt(0.0) & cash_change.gt(0.0)
        negative_confirmation = raw_delivery.lt(0.0) & margin_change.lt(0.0) & cash_change.lt(0.0)
        confirmed = positive_confirmation | negative_confirmation

        cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        current_ratio = data["currentRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        debt_to_equity = data["debtToEquity"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        net_debt_to_ebitda = data["netDebtToEbitda"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        buffer_valid = (
            cash_ratio.notna()
            & current_ratio.notna()
            & debt_to_equity.notna()
            & net_debt_to_ebitda.notna()
            & debt_to_equity.ge(0.0)
        )
        buffer_score = (
            0.30 * cash_ratio.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(buffer_valid).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
            + 0.25 * current_ratio.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(buffer_valid).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
            + 0.25 * (1.0 - debt_to_equity.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(buffer_valid).rank(axis=1, pct=True))
            + 0.20 * (1.0 - net_debt_to_ebitda.clip(-5.0, 15.0).where(buffer_valid).rank(axis=1, pct=True))
        ).where(buffer_valid)
        solvent_strength = ((buffer_score - 0.55) / 0.45).clip(0.0, 1.0)

        volume_base = volume.shift(1).rolling(30, min_periods=30).median()
        impact_base = ret.abs().shift(1).rolling(30, min_periods=30).quantile(0.90)
        entropy = _pre_event_transition_entropy(ret, volume)
        low_entropy_strength = ((0.65 - entropy) / 0.65).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        impact_strength = (ret.abs() / impact_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 3.0)
        participation_strength = np.sqrt((volume / volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 4.0))

        aligned_reaction = ret.ne(0.0) & np.sign(ret).eq(np.sign(raw_delivery))
        valid_market_state = (
            close.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & volume_base.gt(0.0)
            & impact_base.gt(0.0)
            & entropy.notna()
        )
        event_mask = (
            fresh
            & complete_delivery
            & confirmed
            & buffer_valid
            & solvent_strength.gt(0.0)
            & aligned_reaction
            & valid_market_state
            & ret.abs().ge(impact_base)
            & volume.ge(volume_base)
            & low_entropy_strength.gt(0.0)
        )

        event_signal = (
            delivery_score
            * solvent_strength
            * low_entropy_strength
            * impact_strength
            * participation_strength
        ).where(event_mask)
        return _six_bar_entry_hold(event_signal).reindex_like(close).replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
        ).fillna(0.0)

programs.trading_idea: A corroborated residual earnings delivery is most likely to generate a six-day forecast-reset drift when it arrives after a low-entropy return-volume state: concentrated pre-event participation indicates that the announcement resolves an already forming information channel rather than a diffuse noisy reaction. Financially strong issuers make that delivery more credible and more investable for incremental risk-bearing capital, so the initial aligned move is reinforced rather than mechanically faded; this revises Parent A's absorption interpretation in light of its realized opposite sign. Parent B alone cannot distinguish credible latent-information releases from ordinary report noise, while Parent A's concentrated-flow state has ambiguous direction without a fundamental delivery residual and operating/cash confirmation.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _cs_zscore(values: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal same-date robust cross-sectional standardization."""
    clean = values.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    lo = clean.quantile(0.02, axis=1)
    hi = clean.quantile(0.98, axis=1)
    clipped = clean.clip(lower=lo, upper=hi, axis=0)
    scale = clipped.std(axis=1, ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return clipped.sub(clipped.mean(axis=1), axis=0).div(scale, axis=0)


def _update_event(values: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Detect a newly available point-in-time fundamental observation."""
    prior = values.shift(1)
    return values.notna() & (prior.isna() | values.ne(prior))


def _sector_skipped_momentum(
    skipped_return: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
    minimum_names: int,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Within-sector percentile residual of a lagged, skip-period return."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(
        np.nan, index=skipped_return.index, columns=skipped_return.columns, dtype=float
    )
    for timestamp in skipped_return.index:
        values = skipped_return.loc[timestamp]
        labels = sector.loc[timestamp]
        eligible = values.notna() & labels.notna()
        if not eligible.any():
            continue
        value_slice = values.loc[eligible]
        label_slice = labels.loc[eligible]
        counts = label_slice.groupby(label_slice, sort=False).transform("size")
        broad = counts.ge(minimum_names)
        if not broad.any():
            continue
        selected_values = value_slice.loc[broad]
        selected_labels = label_slice.loc[broad]
        median = selected_values.groupby(selected_labels, sort=False).transform("median")
        residual = selected_values.sub(median)
        percentile = residual.groupby(selected_labels, sort=False).rank(
            pct=True, method="average"
        )
        output.loc[timestamp, percentile.index] = 2.0 * percentile - 1.0
    return output


def _directional_pressure_acceleration(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Fast-minus-slow standardized signed return-volume pressure, trailing only."""
    clean_close = close.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    clean_volume = volume.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    ret = clean_close.pct_change(fill_method=None)

    prior_volume = clean_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    prior_volatility = ret.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()
    valid = (
        ret.notna()
        & clean_volume.gt(0.0)
        & prior_volume.gt(0.0)
        & prior_volatility.gt(0.0)
    )
    relative_volume = clean_volume.div(prior_volume).clip(0.0, 3.0)
    standardized_return = ret.div(prior_volatility).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
    pressure = standardized_return.mul(relative_volume).where(valid)

    fast_alpha = 1.0 - 2.0 ** (-1.0 / 3.0)
    slow_alpha = 1.0 - 2.0 ** (-1.0 / 15.0)
    fast = pressure.ewm(
        alpha=fast_alpha, adjust=False, ignore_na=True, min_periods=30
    ).mean()
    slow = pressure.ewm(
        alpha=slow_alpha, adjust=False, ignore_na=True, min_periods=30
    ).mean()
    scale = pressure.abs().ewm(
        alpha=slow_alpha, adjust=False, ignore_na=True, min_periods=30
    ).mean()
    return fast.sub(slow).div(scale.clip(lower=0.000001)).clip(-3.0, 3.0).where(valid)


@register_factor
class ConversionVerifiedSectorPhasePolarity(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "conversion_verified_sector_phase_polarity"
    name = "Conversion-Verified Sector Phase Polarity"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "Uses cash-conversion-verified earnings and revenue delivery to decide whether "
        "an active sector-relative momentum phase is informational continuation or a "
        "buffer-dependent crowded-flow reversal."
    )
    window_length = 90
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "sector",
        "epsSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "cashConversionCycle",
        "cashRatio",
        "currentRatio",
        "debtToEquity",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        lag_6 = close.shift(6)
        lag_26 = close.shift(26)
        valid_prices = lag_6.gt(0.0) & lag_26.gt(0.0)
        skipped_return = np.log(lag_6.div(lag_26)).where(valid_prices)
        momentum = _sector_skipped_momentum(skipped_return, data["sector"], 10)
        acceleration = _directional_pressure_acceleration(close, volume)
        active_phase = momentum.mul(acceleration).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)

        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_surprise = data["revenueSurprise"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        ccc = data["cashConversionCycle"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        eps_delivery = _cs_zscore(
            eps_surprise.div(eps_estimate.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))
        )
        revenue_delivery = _cs_zscore(
            revenue_surprise.div(revenue_estimate.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))
        )
        headline_weight = (
            0.60 * eps_delivery.notna().astype(float)
            + 0.40 * revenue_delivery.notna().astype(float)
        )
        headline = (
            0.60 * eps_delivery.fillna(0.0) + 0.40 * revenue_delivery.fillna(0.0)
        ).div(headline_weight.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(headline_weight.ge(0.60))

        ccc_change = ccc.sub(ccc.shift(63))
        conversion = -_cs_zscore(ccc_change)
        headline_event = _update_event(eps_surprise) | _update_event(revenue_surprise)
        active_headline = headline.where(headline_event).ffill(limit=10)
        active_conversion = conversion.where(_update_event(ccc)).ffill(limit=42)

        delivery_agreement = np.sign(active_headline).eq(np.sign(active_conversion))
        verified_strength = np.minimum(
            active_headline.abs(), active_conversion.abs()
        ).clip(0.0, 2.0).where(delivery_agreement)
        verified_direction = np.sign(active_headline).where(verified_strength.notna())
        momentum_aligned = np.sign(momentum).eq(verified_direction)
        continuation = verified_strength.div(2.0).clip(0.0, 1.0).where(momentum_aligned)

        cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        current_ratio = data["currentRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        debt_to_equity = data["debtToEquity"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eligible_buffer = (
            cash_ratio.notna() & current_ratio.notna() & debt_to_equity.ge(0.0)
        )
        buffer = (
            0.40 * rank(cash_ratio.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(eligible_buffer))
            + 0.35 * rank(current_ratio.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(eligible_buffer))
            + 0.25 * (1.0 - rank(debt_to_equity.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(eligible_buffer)))
        ).where(eligible_buffer)

        continuation_weight = continuation.fillna(0.0)
        reversal_weight = buffer.mul(1.0 - continuation_weight)
        polarity = continuation_weight.sub(reversal_weight)
        raw = momentum.mul(active_phase).mul(polarity).where(
            momentum.notna() & acceleration.notna() & buffer.notna()
        )
        return rank(raw).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0).reindex(
            index=close.index, columns=close.columns
        ).astype(float)

The interaction carries edge because delivery confirmation supplies an economic truth signal for Parent A's phase state, while the phase state distinguishes whether Parent B's slow-moving fundamental update is being actively repriced now.

"""Daily return-volume activity acceleration is treated as a causal proxy for unusually concentrated directional trading activity, not as identified signed order flow or a Hawkes branching process. The hypothesis is that accelerated directional activity in financially weak firms is more likely to persist over the next six trading days because financing constraints can limit risk-bearing capacity and amplify pressure-driven repricing. In well-buffered firms, the same activity burst is more likely to be absorbed by liquidity providers and fundamental buyers, so the expected payoff is reversal; the final signal therefore trades only this buffer-conditioned interaction, not the standalone activity or balance-sheet effects."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _activity_acceleration(close: pd.DataFrame, volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute the causal, volume-weighted fast-minus-slow activity signal."""
    close_clean = close.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    volume_clean = volume.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    ret = close_clean.pct_change(fill_method=None)
    prior_close_count = close_clean.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).count()
    prior_volume_count = volume_clean.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).count()
    prior_volume_mean = volume_clean.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    prior_return_std = ret.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()

    valid = (
        (prior_close_count == 20)
        & (prior_volume_count == 20)
        & prior_volume_mean.gt(0.0)
        & prior_return_std.gt(0.0)
        & volume_clean.notna()
        & ret.notna()
    )

    relative_volume = (volume_clean / prior_volume_mean).clip(0.0, 3.0)
    standardized_return = (ret / prior_return_std).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
    activity = (standardized_return * relative_volume).where(valid)

    alpha_fast = 1.0 - 2.0 ** (-1.0 / 3.0)
    alpha_slow = 1.0 - 2.0 ** (-1.0 / 15.0)

    fast = activity.ewm(
        alpha=alpha_fast, adjust=False, ignore_na=True, min_periods=60
    ).mean()
    slow = activity.ewm(
        alpha=alpha_slow, adjust=False, ignore_na=True, min_periods=60
    ).mean()
    magnitude = activity.abs().ewm(
        alpha=alpha_slow, adjust=False, ignore_na=True, min_periods=60
    ).mean()

    acceleration = ((fast - slow) / magnitude.clip(lower=0.000001)).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
    return acceleration.where(valid)


def _five_bar_rebalanced_targets(target: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Hold cross-sectional target ranks between global five-bar rebalance dates."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=target.index, columns=target.columns, dtype=float)
    rebalance_rows = np.zeros(len(target.index), dtype=bool)
    rebalance_rows[::5] = True

    previous = pd.Series(np.nan, index=target.columns, dtype=float)
    for position in range(len(target.index)):
        if rebalance_rows[position]:
            previous = target.iloc[position].copy()
        result.iloc[position] = previous

    return result


@register_factor
class CashBufferTradeIntensityBranching(BaseFactor):
    """Cash-buffer-conditioned reversal or continuation from activity acceleration."""

    factor_id = "cash_buffer_trade_intensity_branching"
    name = "Cash-Buffer Conditioned Activity Acceleration"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks the interaction of causal return-volume activity acceleration and "
        "a same-day cash/liquidity buffer score. Directional activity in weak "
        "balance sheets is traded as continuation, while the same activity in "
        "strongly buffered firms is traded as reversal; targets rebalance every "
        "five trading bars."
    )
    window_length = 80
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "cashRatio",
        "currentRatio",
        "debtToEquity",
        "netDebtToEbitda",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        acceleration = _activity_acceleration(close, volume)

        cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        current_ratio = data["currentRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        debt_to_equity = data["debtToEquity"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        net_debt_to_ebitda = data["netDebtToEbitda"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        eligible = (
            cash_ratio.notna()
            & current_ratio.notna()
            & debt_to_equity.notna()
            & net_debt_to_ebitda.notna()
            & debt_to_equity.ge(0.0)
        )

        cash_input = cash_ratio.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(eligible)
        current_input = current_ratio.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(eligible)
        debt_input = debt_to_equity.clip(0.0, 10.0).where(eligible)
        net_debt_input = net_debt_to_ebitda.clip(-5.0, 10.0).where(eligible)

        p_cash = rank(cash_input)
        p_current = rank(current_input)
        p_debt = rank(debt_input)
        p_net_debt = rank(net_debt_input)

        buffer_score = 2.0 * (
            0.30 * p_cash
            + 0.25 * p_current
            + 0.25 * (1.0 - p_debt)
            + 0.20 * (1.0 - p_net_debt)
            - 0.5
        )
        buffer_score = buffer_score.clip(-1.0, 1.0).where(eligible)

        interaction = (-acceleration * buffer_score).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
        valid_target = interaction.where(eligible & acceleration.notna())
        target_rank = rank(valid_target)

        return _five_bar_rebalanced_targets(target_rank)

programs.description: At each close t, define r_t = close_t / close_(t-1) - 1. Require 20 prior non-missing daily close and volume observations, positive prior 20-day mean volume, and positive prior 20-day sample standard deviation of returns. Define relative volume RV_t = clip(volume_t / mean(volume_(t-20)...volume_(t-1)), 0, 3), standardized return SR_t = clip(r_t / sd(r_(t-20)...r_(t-1)), -3, 3), and signed activity x_t = SR_t * RV_t. Compute causal exponentially weighted means recursively including x_t: F_t = alpha_3*x_t + (1-alpha_3)*F_(t-1), S_t = alpha_15*x_t + (1-alpha_15)*S_(t-1), and G_t = alpha_15*abs(x_t) + (1-alpha_15)*G_(t-1), where alpha_h = 1 - 2^(-1/h), giving fixed fast and slow half-lives of 3 and 15 daily bars. After at least 60 valid activity observations, define activity acceleration A_t = clip((F_t - S_t) / max(G_t, 0.000001), -3, 3); otherwise it is unavailable. Fundamental eligibility requires non-missing cashRatio, currentRatio, debtToEquity, and netDebtToEbitda, plus debtToEquity >= 0; no fundamental values are imputed, and feed-provided NaNs from stale-report gaps make the name ineligible. For eligible names, clip cashRatio and currentRatio to [0,10], debtToEquity to [0,10], and netDebtToEbitda to [-5,10], then calculate same-day cross-sectional percentile ranks p_cash, p_current, p_debt, and p_netdebt over eligible names. Define the directionally signed buffer score B_t = 2*(0.30*p_cash + 0.25*p_current + 0.25*(1-p_debt) + 0.20*(1-p_netdebt) - 0.5), clipped to [-1,1]; higher B means stronger cash/liquidity coverage and lower leverage. The sole portfolio signal is Q_t = -A_t*B_t, clipped to [-3,3], with no activity or buffer main effects included. Thus, positive activity acceleration with weak buffers (A>0, B<0) maps to Q>0 and a continuation long; negative acceleration with weak buffers maps to a continuation short; the signs reverse for strongly buffered firms, representing an expected reversal. To reduce turnover and implementation exposure, calculate target ranks and rebalance only every fifth trading bar, carrying the most recent valid target score forward between rebalance dates; names that become ineligible receive no new target and are excluded at the next rebalance.

"""The revised mechanism is not that event volume or low entropy alone proves uninformed liquidity demand. Instead, it targets announcements with only a moderate standardized fundamental surprise but an unusually large, surprise-aligned close-to-close reaction during a pre-existing low-transition-entropy return-volume state. This combination is interpreted as an event accelerating an already coordinated order-flow regime, where feedback trading and constrained liquidity can produce a reaction disproportionate to the measured information increment; the predicted reversal is explicitly an empirical implication rather than an identified dealer-inventory trade."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _fresh_release(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Identify a newly available or revised reported fundamental value."""
    return actual.notna() & actual.ne(actual.shift(1))


def _event_cross_sectional_zscore(
    surprise: pd.DataFrame,
    estimate: pd.DataFrame,
    fresh_event: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Winsorize and standardize surprises among valid same-day releases only."""
    denominator = estimate.abs()
    raw = surprise.div(denominator.where(denominator.gt(0.0)))
    raw = raw.where(np.isfinite(raw))

    valid = fresh_event & raw.notna()
    event_raw = raw.where(valid)
    count = event_raw.count(axis=1)
    sufficient = count.ge(20)

    lower = event_raw.quantile(0.05, axis=1)
    upper = event_raw.quantile(0.95, axis=1)
    winsorized = event_raw.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)

    mean = winsorized.mean(axis=1)
    std = winsorized.std(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    zscore = winsorized.sub(mean, axis=0).div(std, axis=0)
    return zscore.where(valid).where(sufficient, axis=0)


def _transition_entropy(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal 16-pair return-volume transition entropy through the prior bar."""
    previous_close = close.shift(1)
    ret = close.div(previous_close).sub(1.0)
    ret = ret.where(close.gt(0.0) & previous_close.gt(0.0))

    prior_volume_mean = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    valid_state = (
        ret.notna()
        & volume.notna()
        & prior_volume_mean.notna()
        & np.isfinite(volume)
        & np.isfinite(prior_volume_mean)
        & volume.ge(0.0)
    )

    # State encoding: down/low=0, down/high=1, up/low=2, up/high=3.
    up = ret.ge(0.0)
    high = volume.gt(prior_volume_mean)
    state = (up.astype(float) * 2.0 + high.astype(float)).where(valid_state)
    transition = state.shift(1) * 4.0 + state

    # At t, these windows contain pair observations t-39 through t-1.
    entropy = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
    for code in range(16):
        indicator = transition.eq(float(code)).astype(float)
        count = indicator.shift(1).rolling(39, min_periods=39).sum()
        probability = count / 39.0
        entropy = entropy - probability * np.log(probability.where(probability.gt(0.0), 1.0))

    entropy = entropy / np.log(16.0)
    # The 40 state observations t-40 through t-1 must all be valid.
    complete_states = valid_state.astype(float).shift(1).rolling(40, min_periods=40).sum().eq(40.0)
    return entropy.where(complete_states)


@register_factor
class PreExistingFlowAccelerationReversal(BaseFactor):
    """Fade disproportionate surprise-aligned reactions in synchronized flow regimes."""

    factor_id = "surprise_synchrony_completion_reversal"
    name = "Pre-Existing Flow Acceleration Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fades moderate standardized earnings or revenue surprises whose aligned "
        "event-day reaction and volume are extreme within a low return-volume "
        "transition-entropy regime."
    )
    window_length = 81
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "revenueEstimate",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        eps_event = _fresh_release(data["epsActual"])
        revenue_event = _fresh_release(data["revenueActual"])

        eps_z = _event_cross_sectional_zscore(
            data["epsSurprise"], data["epsEstimate"], eps_event
        )
        revenue_z = _event_cross_sectional_zscore(
            data["revenueSurprise"], data["revenueEstimate"], revenue_event
        )

        component_count = eps_z.notna().astype(float) + revenue_z.notna().astype(float)
        composite = (
            eps_z.fillna(0.0).add(revenue_z.fillna(0.0)).div(component_count.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        )
        composite = composite.where(component_count.gt(0.0))
        fresh_event = eps_event | revenue_event

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        reaction = close.div(previous_close).sub(1.0)
        reaction = reaction.where(close.gt(0.0) & previous_close.gt(0.0))

        trailing_volatility = reaction.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        standardized_reaction = reaction.abs().div(trailing_volatility.where(trailing_volatility.gt(0.0)))

        prior_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(60, min_periods=40).mean()
        abnormal_volume = volume.div(prior_volume.where(prior_volume.gt(0.0)))

        entropy = _transition_entropy(close, volume)

        moderate_surprise = composite.abs().ge(0.50) & composite.abs().le(1.50)
        aligned_reaction = np.sign(reaction).eq(np.sign(composite))
        extreme_reaction = standardized_reaction.ge(2.0)
        extreme_volume = abnormal_volume.ge(2.0)
        synchronized_state = entropy.le(0.55)

        gate = (
            fresh_event
            & moderate_surprise
            & aligned_reaction
            & extreme_reaction
            & extreme_volume
            & synchronized_state
        )
        signal = -np.sign(composite)
        return signal.where(gate, 0.0).fillna(0.0)

A fresh event exists if either release occurs. For fresh EPS events, compute raw EPS surprise as epsSurprise / abs(epsEstimate), requiring abs(epsEstimate) > 0; for fresh revenue events compute revenueSurprise / abs(revenueEstimate), requiring abs(revenueEstimate) > 0. On each date and separately for EPS and revenue releases, winsorize the valid raw surprise ratios at the cross-sectional 5th and 95th percentiles among fresh same-day releases, then z-score using that same event-only cross section; require at least 20 valid same-day observations for each component. If both EPS and revenue releases occur and both standardized components are available, the composite surprise S is their arithmetic mean; if only one valid component is available, use that component; otherwise the signal is zero. Require 0.50 <= abs(S) <= 1.50. Define the event-day reaction r_t = close_t / close_{t-1} - 1 and require sign(r_t) = sign(S). Compute trailing daily return volatility sigma_t as the sample standard deviation of close-to-close returns from t-20 through t-1, requiring at least 15 observations, and require abs(r_t) / sigma_t >= 2.0. Compute abnormal volume AV_t = volume_t divided by mean(volume from t-60 through t-1), requiring at least 40 valid prior observations, and require AV_t >= 2.0. For every prior day u, define a four-state return-volume label using the close-to-close return sign (down if return_u < 0, up otherwise) and volume state (high if volume_u exceeds its strictly prior 20-bar mean, low otherwise). Using the 40 valid states ending at t-1 only, estimate the empirical probabilities of the 39 consecutive transitions among the 16 possible state pairs and calculate normalized transition entropy H_t = -sum(p*log(p))/log(16), omitting zero-probability terms; require all 40 states valid and H_t <= 0.55. The raw factor is -sign(S) when every gate passes and 0 otherwise, so a positive factor predicts a positive subsequent return. All surprise, reaction, volume, volatility, and entropy calculations use information available only after the event bar closes; orders may execute no earlier than the next executable bar. Missing inputs, insufficient lookbacks, nonpositive denominators, failed cross-sectional minimums, or failed gates produce zero exposure. The factor is not residualized inside calc against the existing earnings_revenue_surprise_drift, entropy_conditioned_surprise_polarity, or event-burst factors because their scores are not fields in the supplied data dict. Incrementality must be assessed in the harness by daily cross-sectional spanning/residual-return tests against those factor scores, with sector and log-market-cap controls, rather than by claiming independent identification.

"""This is a reduced-form temporary-price-pressure signal, not a claim that signed order flow, dealer inventory, or Hawkes excitation is directly observed. A surprise-aligned earnings reaction is more likely to reverse when the event-day move is simultaneously an extreme return, occurs on unusually high participation, and is unusually large even after scaling by that participation; the low pre-event return-volume transition entropy gate identifies names whose recent trading activity was already concentrated rather than broadly mixed. The signal therefore takes the opposite side of only these jointly extreme, causally observable event shocks, while leaving ordinary earnings reactions inactive."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _fresh_release(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Detect point-in-time report changes without treating carried values as releases."""
    previous = actual.shift(1)
    return actual.notna() & (previous.isna() | actual.ne(previous))


def _transition_entropy(
    ret: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
    volume_base: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal normalized conditional entropy of the prior 20 return-volume states."""
    n_rows, n_cols = ret.shape
    states = np.full((n_rows, n_cols, 20), -1, dtype=np.int8)
    base_values = volume_base.to_numpy(dtype=float)

    # Chronological state order is t-20, ..., t-1.  State coding is:
    # 0 Up-High, 1 Up-Low, 2 Down-High, 3 Down-Low.
    for position, lag in enumerate(range(20, 0, -1)):
        prior_ret = ret.shift(lag).to_numpy(dtype=float)
        prior_volume = volume.shift(lag).to_numpy(dtype=float)
        valid = (
            np.isfinite(prior_ret)
            & np.isfinite(prior_volume)
            & (prior_volume > 0.0)
            & np.isfinite(base_values)
            & (base_values > 0.0)
        )
        up = prior_ret > 0.0
        high = prior_volume >= base_values
        code = np.where(up, np.where(high, 0, 1), np.where(high, 2, 3))
        states[:, :, position] = np.where(valid, code, -1).astype(np.int8)

    counts = np.zeros((n_rows, n_cols, 16), dtype=np.uint8)
    for position in range(19):
        left = states[:, :, position]
        right = states[:, :, position + 1]
        transition = left.astype(np.int16) * 4 + right.astype(np.int16)
        for code in range(16):
            counts[:, :, code] += (transition == code).astype(np.uint8)

    entropy = np.zeros((n_rows, n_cols), dtype=float)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        for origin in range(4):
            origin_count = counts[:, :, origin * 4 : (origin + 1) * 4].sum(axis=2)
            for destination in range(4):
                joint_count = counts[:, :, origin * 4 + destination].astype(float)
                joint_probability = joint_count / 19.0
                conditional_probability = joint_count / origin_count
                term = np.where(
                    joint_count > 0.0,
                    -joint_probability * np.log(conditional_probability),
                    0.0,
                )
                entropy += term

    entropy /= np.log(4.0)
    return pd.DataFrame(entropy, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)


@register_factor
class EventBurstCompletionImpactReversal(BaseFactor):
    """Fade surprise-aligned, high-participation earnings-release impact bursts."""

    factor_id = "event_burst_completion_impact_reversal"
    name = "Fresh-Release Impact Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Opposite exposure to fresh, surprise-aligned earnings-release shocks "
        "whose return, volume, participation-scaled impact, and low pre-event "
        "return-volume transition entropy indicate completed temporary pressure."
    )
    window_length = 22
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        eps_actual = data["epsActual"]
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"]
        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"]
        revenue_surprise = data["revenueSurprise"]
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"]
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"]

        ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
        volume_base = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        return_base = ret.abs().shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()

        # Scaling pre-event impact by the event's Vbase is algebraically
        # equivalent to taking Vbase times the pre-event quantile of |r| / V.
        pre_impact_unit = ret.abs() / volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        q90_return = ret.abs().shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).quantile(0.90)
        q90_impact = (
            pre_impact_unit.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).quantile(0.90)
            * volume_base
        )
        event_impact = ret.abs() * volume_base / volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        entropy = _transition_entropy(ret, volume, volume_base)

        fresh_eps = _fresh_release(eps_actual)
        fresh_revenue = _fresh_release(revenue_actual)
        prior_eps_free = fresh_eps.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum().eq(0.0)
        prior_revenue_free = fresh_revenue.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum().eq(0.0)

        eps_valid = (
            eps_surprise.notna()
            & eps_estimate.notna()
            & eps_estimate.ne(0.0)
        )
        revenue_valid = (
            revenue_surprise.notna()
            & revenue_estimate.notna()
            & revenue_estimate.ne(0.0)
        )
        eps_component = (eps_surprise / eps_estimate.abs()).where(eps_valid)
        revenue_component = (revenue_surprise / revenue_estimate.abs()).where(revenue_valid)
        component_count = eps_valid.astype(float) + revenue_valid.astype(float)
        signed_surprise = (
            eps_component.fillna(0.0) + revenue_component.fillna(0.0)
        ) / component_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        # The 22-close check covers close[t-21] through close[t], while the
        # 21-volume check covers volume[t-20] through volume[t].
        valid_closes = close.gt(0.0).rolling(22, min_periods=22).min().eq(1.0)
        valid_volumes = volume.gt(0.0).rolling(21, min_periods=21).min().eq(1.0)
        valid_history = valid_closes & valid_volumes & return_base.notna()

        fresh_event = fresh_eps | fresh_revenue
        event_field_available = eps_valid | revenue_valid
        surprise_aligned = (
            ret.ne(0.0)
            & np.sign(ret).eq(np.sign(signed_surprise))
            & signed_surprise.abs().ge(0.02)
        )

        active = (
            fresh_event
            & event_field_available
            & prior_eps_free
            & prior_revenue_free
            & valid_history
            & surprise_aligned
            & q90_return.gt(0.0)
            & q90_impact.notna()
            & ret.abs().ge(q90_return)
            & volume.ge(2.0 * volume_base)
            & event_impact.ge(q90_impact)
            & entropy.le(0.50)
        )

        raw_score = np.sign(ret) * (ret.abs() / q90_return).clip(upper=3.0)
        # Positive shocks are shorted and negative shocks are bought.
        return (-raw_score.where(active, 0.0)).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

A surprise-aligned earnings reaction is more likely to reverse when the event-day move is simultaneously an extreme return, occurs on unusually high participation, and is unusually large even after scaling by that participation; the low pre-event return-volume transition entropy gate identifies names whose recent trading activity was already concentrated rather than broadly mixed. programs.description: Let t be a daily bar. A fresh EPS release occurs at t when epsActual[t] is finite and either epsActual[t-1] is missing or epsActual[t] differs from epsActual[t-1]. Define a fresh revenue release analogously using revenueActual. A stock is an eligible event at t if at least one such fresh actual-release condition holds, the corresponding epsSurprise or revenueSurprise is finite with a finite nonzero corresponding estimate, and no fresh EPS or revenue release was detected for that stock during bars t-20 through t-1. This uses the point-in-time field-change timestamp as the release timestamp; an unchanged reported value is not treated as a new event. The event-session return is r_t = close[t]/close[t-1]-1 and event-session volume is V_t = volume[t]. All baselines use only the 20 bars t-20 through t-1, with close[t-21] used solely to form the first pre-event return. Require finite positive closes for t-21 through t and finite strictly positive volumes for t-20 through t; otherwise the event is ineligible. Define Vbase as the median volume over t-20 through t-1 and Rbase as the median absolute daily return over those same 20 pre-event bars. For each pre-event bar j in t-20,...,t-1, define a four-state return-volume state: Up-High if r_j > 0 and volume[j] >= Vbase; Up-Low if r_j > 0 and volume[j] < Vbase; Down-High if r_j <= 0 and volume[j] >= Vbase; and Down-Low if r_j <= 0 and volume[j] < Vbase. A zero return is assigned to the Down state deterministically. Missing or zero-price/zero-volume observations have no state and invalidate the candidate rather than being imputed. From the 19 adjacent state transitions in this pre-event sequence, calculate the plug-in conditional transition entropy H = -sum_a sum_b p(a,b) log(p(b|a))/log(4), with terms having zero joint count defined as zero. Thus H is in [0,1] and is computed entirely before the event session. Define the signed surprise s as the arithmetic mean of all available components among epsSurprise[t]/abs(epsEstimate[t]) and revenueSurprise[t]/abs(revenueEstimate[t]); require at least one component and abs(s) >= 0.02. The reaction is surprise-aligned only when sign(r_t) = sign(s) and r_t is nonzero. Define event impact I_t = abs(r_t)/(V_t/Vbase). For every pre-event bar j, define I_j = abs(r_j)/(volume[j]/Vbase), and let Q90R and Q90I be the empirical 90th percentiles of {abs(r_j)} and {I_j}, respectively, over t-20 through t-1. The completed-burst proxy is active only if all of the following are true at the close of t: surprise alignment; abs(r_t) >= Q90R; V_t >= 2.0*Vbase; I_t >= Q90I; and H <= 0.50. These thresholds are fixed except for the explicitly causal trailing empirical quantiles. The raw factor score is S_t = sign(r_t) * min(abs(r_t)/Q90R, 3) when the proxy is active and S_t = 0 otherwise. Positive scores denote an extreme positive-surprise/up-reaction shock and negative scores denote an extreme negative-surprise/down-reaction shock; the trade takes the opposite exposure, i.e. short positive scores and long negative scores. The signal is known after the close of event bar t, entered at open[t+1], and evaluated as the six-bar holding return from open[t+1] to close[t+6]. No bar after t is used for event classification, entropy, baselines, thresholds, or entry.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _fresh_release(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    previous = actual.shift(1)
    return actual.notna() & (previous.isna() | actual.ne(previous))


def _event_zscore(
    surprise: pd.DataFrame,
    estimate: pd.DataFrame,
    event: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    raw = surprise.div(estimate.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))
    raw = raw.where(np.isfinite(raw))
    observed = raw.where(event)
    count = observed.count(axis=1)
    lower = observed.quantile(0.05, axis=1)
    upper = observed.quantile(0.95, axis=1)
    clipped = observed.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)
    mean = clipped.mean(axis=1)
    std = clipped.std(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    zscore = clipped.sub(mean, axis=0).div(std, axis=0)
    return zscore.where(event).where(count.ge(20), axis=0)


def _pre_event_transition_entropy(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
    window: int,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    ret = close.div(close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)).sub(1.0)
    volume_base = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
    relative_volume = volume.div(volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    valid = ret.notna() & relative_volume.notna() & np.isfinite(ret) & np.isfinite(relative_volume)

    state = pd.DataFrame(
        np.where(
            ret.ge(0.0),
            np.where(relative_volume.ge(1.0), 0.0, 1.0),
            np.where(relative_volume.ge(1.0), 2.0, 3.0),
        ),
        index=close.index,
        columns=close.columns,
    ).where(valid)

    previous = state.shift(2)
    current = state.shift(1)
    transition = previous * 4.0 + current
    complete = transition.notna().astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum().eq(float(window))

    entropy = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
    for code in range(16):
        probability = transition.eq(float(code)).astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
        entropy = entropy - probability * np.log(probability.where(probability.gt(0.0), 1.0))
    return (entropy / np.log(16.0)).where(complete)


@register_factor
class ModerateSurpriseEntropyCoolingRetentionFade(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "moderate_surprise_entropy_cooling_retention_fade"
    name = "Entropy-Cooled Surprise Retention Fade"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fades retained, moderate-surprise event displacements after an extreme "
        "low-entropy participation burst cools one or two bars later."
    )
    window_length = 63
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        ret = close.div(close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)).sub(1.0)

        eps_event = _fresh_release(data["epsActual"])
        revenue_event = _fresh_release(data["revenueActual"])
        eps_z = _event_zscore(data["epsSurprise"], data["epsEstimate"], eps_event)
        revenue_z = _event_zscore(
            data["revenueSurprise"], data["revenueEstimate"], revenue_event
        )
        component_count = eps_z.notna().astype(float) + revenue_z.notna().astype(float)
        surprise = eps_z.fillna(0.0).add(revenue_z.fillna(0.0)).div(
            component_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        fresh_event = eps_event | revenue_event

        volume_base = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        relative_volume = volume.div(volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        volatility = ret.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        standardized_reaction = ret.abs().div(volatility)
        entropy = _pre_event_transition_entropy(close, volume, 30)

        moderate = surprise.abs().ge(0.50) & surprise.abs().le(1.50)
        aligned = ret.ne(0.0) & np.sign(ret).eq(np.sign(surprise))
        marked_burst = (
            fresh_event
            & moderate
            & aligned
            & standardized_reaction.ge(2.0)
            & relative_volume.ge(2.0)
            & entropy.le(0.55)
        )
        burst = (
            np.sign(ret)
            * standardized_reaction.clip(lower=2.0, upper=4.0)
            * relative_volume.clip(lower=1.0, upper=3.0)
        ).where(marked_burst, 0.0)

        one_bar_base = close.shift(2).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        two_bar_base = close.shift(3).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        one_bar_total = close.div(one_bar_base).sub(1.0)
        two_bar_total = close.div(two_bar_base).sub(1.0)

        prior_burst = burst.shift(1)
        older_burst = burst.shift(2)
        retained_one = (
            prior_burst.ne(0.0)
            & np.sign(one_bar_total).eq(np.sign(prior_burst))
            & one_bar_total.abs().ge(0.50 * ret.shift(1).abs())
            & one_bar_total.abs().le(1.35 * ret.shift(1).abs())
        )
        retained_two = (
            older_burst.ne(0.0)
            & np.sign(two_bar_total).eq(np.sign(older_burst))
            & two_bar_total.abs().ge(0.50 * ret.shift(2).abs())
            & two_bar_total.abs().le(1.35 * ret.shift(2).abs())
        )

        cooled = relative_volume.le(1.10) & relative_volume.notna()
        completion = prior_burst.where(retained_one, 0.0).add(
            0.60 * older_burst.where(retained_two, 0.0)
        )
        score = (-completion).where(cooled, 0.0)
        return score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
