programs.description: Compute the signal after the close of day t only, using data through t, and enter no earlier than the next executable session. Universe eligibility at t requires close_t > 5 USD, marketCap_t >= 500,000,000 USD, and at least 50 valid observations in the prior 60 trading days for close and volume; require 60 valid prior-day observations for all rolling medians and standard deviations below. Define dollar-volume liquidity as median(close_{t-k} * volume_{t-k}, k=1,...,60) >= 5,000,000 USD. Define the raw overnight return g_i,t = log(open_i,t / close_i,t-1). On each day, calculate the equal-weight cross-sectional median overnight return among liquid eligible stocks, g_M,t, and the equal-weight median among liquid eligible stocks in stock i's sector, g_S(i),t. The sector-adjusted idiosyncratic gap is G_i,t = g_i,t - [g_M,t + (g_S(i),t - g_M,t)] = g_i,t - g_S(i),t. Estimate sigmaG_i,t as the sample standard deviation of G_i over days t-60 through t-1, requiring at least 50 valid values; define ZG_i,t = winsorize(G_i,t / sigmaG_i,t, -5, 5). Define intraday repair R_i,t = winsorize((close_i,t - open_i,t) / max(abs(open_i,t - close_i,t-1), 0.001 * close_i,t-1), -2, 2), and close location CL_i,t = (close_i,t - low_i,t) / max(high_i,t - low_i,t, 0.001 * close_i,t-1). Define normalized range NR_i,t = (high_i,t - low_i,t) / close_i,t-1 and normal range BR_i,t as the median of NR_i over t-60 through t-1. Define range impact IR_i,t = NR_i,t / BR_i,t, winsorized to [0, 5]. Define volume abnormality VA_i,t = volume_i,t / median(volume_i,t-60,...,volume_i,t-1), winsorized to [0, 10]. A report-update flag U_i,t equals 1 when at least one of epsActual, revenueActual, epsSurprise, or revenueSurprise is finite at t and differs from its value at t-1; otherwise it equals 0. For report-update names, define normalized EPS surprise ES_i,t = epsSurprise_i,t / max(abs(epsEstimate_i,t), 0.01), and normalized revenue surprise RS_i,t = revenueSurprise_i,t / max(abs(revenueEstimate_i,t), 1,000,000). Winsorize ES and RS cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles. Require both normalized surprises to be available and define the bad-news score BN_i,t as the average of their cross-sectional percentile ranks, where lower values are worse news. A stock is a candidate only if U_i,t = 1, BN_i,t <= 0.30, ZG_i,t <= -1.50, IR_i,t >= 1.25, VA_i,t >= 1.50, R_i,t <= 0.25, and CL_i,t <= 0.35. Among candidates, calculate Q_i,t as the equally weighted average of: the cross-sectional percentile rank of -ZG, the percentile rank of IR, the percentile rank of VA, the percentile rank of -R, the percentile rank of 1-CL, and the percentile rank of 1-BN. Percentile ranks are calculated among liquid eligible names on day t, with missing inputs excluded. The factor value is -Q_i,t for candidates and 0 otherwise; more-negative values imply a stronger expected subsequent decline. For a tradable portfolio, within each sector having at least five candidates, short the highest-Q decile, rounded up to at least one stock, equally weighted within sector and with equal gross capital assigned to each represented sector. Hold for six bars unless the normal portfolio rebalancing process replaces the position. The intended exposure is confirmed bad-news continuation, not an unconfirmed oversold-gap reversal. Before allocation, evaluate incremental alpha by residualizing this score or portfolio return against idio_downside_pressure_confirmation, downside_tail_absorption_reversal, idio_opening_sell_rejection_recovery, open_gap_refill_participation_clock, auction_gap_invalidation_continuation, idiosyncratic_capacity_recovery_relative_impact, and phase_space_impact_hysteresis_endpoint; those signals are not production inputs to this factor.

programs.code:
"""A concentrated downside-variance burst followed by declining incremental downside variance is interpreted as exhaustion of urgent sell pressure rather than a generic volatility forecast. Financially resilient issuers should be more likely to rebound because cash, coverage, free-cash-flow generation, and low leverage reduce the probability that the initial liquidation reflects an unresolved refinancing or solvency problem; financially fragile issuers should remain relatively weak as the same shock is more plausibly a repricing of persistent distress. The hypothesized counterparty is a liquidity-motivated seller whose urgency and inventory constraint can temporarily depress prices, while arbitrage is limited by elevated volatility, turnover, implementation costs, and borrow constraints during the shock period."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _normalized_rank(values: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Rank a cross section onto [0, 1], preserving NaNs."""
    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=values.index, dtype=float)
    valid = values.dropna()
    count = len(valid)
    if count == 1:
        out.loc[valid.index] = 0.5
    elif count > 1:
        out.loc[valid.index] = (valid.rank(method="average") - 1.0) / (count - 1.0)
    return out


def _sector_resilience(
    cash_ratio: pd.DataFrame,
    interest_coverage: pd.DataFrame,
    fcf_yield: pd.DataFrame,
    debt_to_capital: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Sector-winsorized resilience score and valid-universe mask."""
    index = cash_ratio.index
    columns = cash_ratio.columns
    resilience = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=index, columns=columns, dtype=float)
    eligible = pd.DataFrame(False, index=index, columns=columns)

    components = (cash_ratio, interest_coverage, fcf_yield, -debt_to_capital)
    for timestamp in index:
        labels = sector.loc[timestamp]
        raw = pd.concat(
            [component.loc[timestamp] for component in components], axis=1
        )
        raw.columns = ["cash", "coverage", "fcf", "leverage"]
        raw = raw.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        valid_all = raw.notna().all(axis=1)

        for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
            members = labels.index[labels == label]
            valid_members = raw.index[raw.index.isin(members) & valid_all]
            if len(valid_members) < 10:
                continue

            group = raw.loc[valid_members]
            ranked_components = []
            for column in group.columns:
                values = group[column]
                lower = values.quantile(0.05)
                upper = values.quantile(0.95)
                winsorized = values.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper)
                ranked_components.append(_normalized_rank(winsorized))

            score = pd.concat(ranked_components, axis=1).mean(axis=1)
            resilience.loc[timestamp, valid_members] = score.to_numpy(dtype=float)
            eligible.loc[timestamp, valid_members] = True

    return resilience, eligible


def _sector_median_return(
    return_3d: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal same-date sector median of already trailing three-day returns."""
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=return_3d.index, columns=return_3d.columns, dtype=float)
    for timestamp in return_3d.index:
        labels = sector.loc[timestamp]
        values = return_3d.loc[timestamp].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
            members = labels.index[labels == label]
            median = values.loc[members].median(skipna=True)
            if pd.notna(median):
                out.loc[timestamp, members] = float(median)
    return out


def _residual_rank(
    response: pd.DataFrame,
    controls: list[pd.DataFrame],
    universe: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Daily cross-sectional OLS residual ranks, with a trailing-data-only design."""
    out = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=response.index, columns=response.columns, dtype=float)
    for timestamp in response.index:
        y = response.loc[timestamp].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        x_parts = [control.loc[timestamp].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) for control in controls]
        design = pd.concat(x_parts, axis=1)
        valid = universe.loc[timestamp] & y.notna() & design.notna().all(axis=1)
        names = y.index[valid]
        if len(names) < 8:
            continue

        x = design.loc[names].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        matrix = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(names)), x])
        y_values = y.loc[names].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        try:
            beta = np.linalg.lstsq(matrix, y_values, rcond=None)[0]
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            continue

        residuals = pd.Series(y_values - matrix @ beta, index=names)
        ranked = _normalized_rank(residuals)
        out.loc[timestamp, names] = 2.0 * ranked.to_numpy(dtype=float) - 1.0
    return out


@register_factor
class FundamentalBufferedVarianceRelaxation(BaseFactor):
    """Residualized resilience-conditioned downside-variance exhaustion signal."""

    factor_id = "fundamental_buffered_variance_relaxation"
    name = "Buffered Downside-Variance Exhaustion"
    category = "volatility"
    description = (
        "Identifies decelerating concentrated downside-variance shocks and "
        "ranks financially resilient issuers after residualizing standard "
        "reversal, drawdown, volatility, and sector-shock exposures."
    )
    window_length = 12
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "cashRatio",
        "interestCoverage",
        "freeCashFlowYield",
        "debtToCapital",
        "sector",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        interest_coverage = data["interestCoverage"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        fcf_yield = data["freeCashFlowYield"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        debt_to_capital = data["debtToCapital"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        sector = data["sector"]

        ret = close / close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        downside_sq = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2)
        ds3 = downside_sq.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum()
        ds12 = downside_sq.rolling(12, min_periods=12).sum()
        buffer3 = 0.25 * ds12
        excess = ds3 / buffer3.where(buffer3 > 0.0)
        excess = excess - 1.0
        deceleration = ds3 - ds3.shift(3)
        return_3d = close / close.shift(3).replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        drawdown12 = close / close.rolling(12, min_periods=12).max().replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0

        resilience, resilience_eligible = _sector_resilience(
            cash_ratio, interest_coverage, fcf_yield, debt_to_capital, sector
        )
        base_eligible = (
            resilience_eligible
            & excess.notna()
            & deceleration.notna()
            & return_3d.notna()
            & ds12.notna()
            & ret.notna()
            & drawdown12.notna()
        )

        threshold = excess.where(base_eligible).quantile(0.80, axis=1)
        shock_gate = (
            excess.gt(threshold, axis=0)
            & (deceleration < 0.0)
            & (return_3d < 0.0)
            & base_eligible
        )
        pre_residual = (shock_gate.astype(float) * (resilience - 0.5)).where(base_eligible)

        sector_return = _sector_median_return(return_3d, sector)
        rank_ret = ret.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        rank_drawdown = drawdown12.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        rank_ds12 = ds12.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        rank_sector_return = sector_return.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

        regression_universe = (
            base_eligible
            & sector_return.notna()
            & rank_ret.notna()
            & rank_drawdown.notna()
            & rank_ds12.notna()
            & rank_sector_return.notna()
        )
        pre_residual = pre_residual.where(regression_universe)

        return _residual_rank(
            pre_residual,
            [rank_ret, rank_drawdown, rank_ds12, rank_sector_return],
            regression_universe,
        )
programs.name: Buffered Downside-Variance Exhaustion
programs.trading_idea: A concentrated downside-variance burst followed by declining incremental downside variance is interpreted as exhaustion of urgent sell pressure rather than a generic volatility forecast. Financially resilient issuers should be more likely to rebound because cash, coverage, free-cash-flow generation, and low leverage reduce the probability that the initial liquidation reflects an unresolved refinancing or solvency problem; financially fragile issuers should remain relatively weak as the same shock is more plausibly a repricing of persistent distress. The hypothesized counterparty is a liquidity-motivated seller whose urgency and inventory constraint can temporarily depress prices, while arbitrage is limited by elevated volatility, turnover, implementation costs, and borrow constraints during the shock period.
programs.description: At date t, define daily close return r_t = close_t / close_{t-1} - 1 and downside squared return d_t = min(r_t, 0)^2. Every return and variance window ends at t. Define cumulative short downside variance DS3_t = d_t + d_{t-1} + d_{t-2}, medium downside variance DS12_t = sum(d_{t-i}, i=0,...,11), and the linear 3-day extrapolation B3_t = (3/12) times DS12_t. Define superlinear excess downside variance U_t = DS3_t / B3_t - 1, requiring B3_t > 0. Define variance deceleration D_t = DS3_t - DS3_{t-3}; deceleration requires D_t < 0. An event gate G_t equals one only when (i) U_t is above the 80th percentile of U among eligible stocks on t, (ii) D_t < 0, and (iii) the cumulative 3-day close return close_t / close_{t-3} - 1 is negative; otherwise G_t is zero. Financial resilience is computed only for names with finite point-in-time values for cashRatio, interestCoverage, freeCashFlowYield, and debtToCapital. Within each sector on each date, winsorize each raw component at its 5th and 95th percentiles, convert it to a percentile rank from zero to one, and form R_t = 0.25 times [rank(cashRatio) + rank(interestCoverage) + rank(freeCashFlowYield) + rank(-debtToCapital)]. Sectors with fewer than 10 valid names receive no signal. The pre-residual score is A_t = G_t times (R_t - 0.5), so high-resilience shock-exhaustion names receive positive scores and fragile names negative scores. To remove canonical reversal and common shock exposure, cross-sectionally regress A_t each date on a constant, the percentile ranks of one-day return r_t, 12-day drawdown close_t / rolling_max(close over t-11 through t) - 1, DS12_t, and the sector median 3-day return; the factor score is the residual percentile rank transformed to [-1, 1]. Go long the top decile and short the bottom decile of this residual score among eligible names, equal weighted within each side. All prices used in signal formation are known at t close; positions are entered no earlier than the next executable bar, using t+1 open where available, and evaluated over the fixed six-bar horizon. Testing must retain the same reversal, drawdown, sector-shock, and baseline-volatility controls and apply the harness transaction-cost, liquidity, turnover, and borrow treatment.

programs.code:
"""This is a reduced-form temporary-price-pressure hypothesis, not an identified dealer-inventory claim. Persistent extreme close location on unusually high-volume days with below-normal intraday range indicates directional trading that has not produced proportionate daily price displacement; if that pressure is execution-related and subsequently completes, the six-bar return should reverse its direction. The hypothesis is explicitly conditional and can fail when the muted displacement instead reflects informed demand or supply that later breaks through available liquidity."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _persistent_absorbed_pressure(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute the causal 20-bar normalized, three-day absorbed-pressure proxy."""
    finite_daily = (
        np.isfinite(open_)
        & np.isfinite(high)
        & np.isfinite(low)
        & np.isfinite(close)
        & np.isfinite(volume)
    )
    daily_valid = (
        finite_daily
        & (close > 0.0)
        & (high > low)
        & (volume > 0.0)
    )

    proportional_range = ((high - low) / close).where(daily_valid)
    range_valid = proportional_range > 0.0
    history_valid = daily_valid & range_valid

    valid_count = history_valid.astype(float).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    full_history = valid_count == 20.0

    median_volume = volume.where(history_valid).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
    median_range = proportional_range.where(history_valid).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()

    relative_volume = (volume / median_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(upper=3.0)
    relative_range = proportional_range / median_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    compression = (1.0 - relative_range).clip(lower=0.0)
    close_location = (2.0 * close - high - low) / (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan)

    absorbed = (close_location * relative_volume * compression).where(full_history)
    persistent = absorbed.rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()
    return persistent.where(absorbed.notna().rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum() == 3.0)


def _sector_centered_rank(
    signal: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Average-tie percentile rank within sectors with at least five names."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=signal.index, columns=signal.columns, dtype=float)

    for timestamp in signal.index:
        values = signal.loc[timestamp]
        groups = sector.loc[timestamp]
        eligible = values.notna() & groups.notna()
        if not eligible.any():
            continue

        eligible_values = values.loc[eligible]
        eligible_groups = groups.loc[eligible]
        group_sizes = eligible_groups.groupby(eligible_groups, sort=False).transform("size")
        sufficient = group_sizes >= 5
        if not sufficient.any():
            continue

        ranked = eligible_values.loc[sufficient].groupby(
            eligible_groups.loc[sufficient], sort=False
        ).rank(method="average", pct=True)
        output.loc[timestamp, ranked.index] = ranked - 0.5

    return output


@register_factor
class CompressedRangeParticipationInventoryUnwind(BaseFactor):
    """Sector-relative persistent compressed-range participation pressure reversal."""

    factor_id = "compressed_range_participation_inventory_unwind"
    name = "Persistent Compressed-Range Pressure Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Sector-relative centered percentile rank of persistent three-day close-location "
        "pressure on high-participation, compressed-range days; extreme directional "
        "pressure is a conditional temporary-price-pressure reversal signal."
    )
    window_length = 22
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]

programs.trading_idea: This is a reduced-form temporary-price-pressure hypothesis, not an identified dealer-inventory claim. Persistent extreme close location on unusually high-volume days with below-normal intraday range indicates directional trading that has not produced proportionate daily price displacement; if that pressure is execution-related and subsequently completes, the six-bar return should reverse its direction. The hypothesis is explicitly conditional and can fail when the muted displacement instead reflects informed demand or supply that later breaks through available liquidity.
programs.description: For ticker i on day t, define close-location pressure P(i,t) = (2*close(i,t)-high(i,t)-low(i,t))/(high(i,t)-low(i,t)). Define daily proportional range R(i,t) = (high(i,t)-low(i,t))/close(i,t). A day is valid only when open, high, low, close, and volume are finite; close>0; high>low; volume>0; and each of the 20 bars from t-19 through t has finite positive volume, positive proportional range, and positive close. Using only those bars through t, compute Vmed(i,t) as the median volume over t-19:t and Rmed(i,t) as the median proportional range over t-19:t. Set relative volume RV(i,t)=min(volume(i,t)/Vmed(i,t),3), relative range RR(i,t)=R(i,t)/Rmed(i,t), and compression C(i,t)=max(0,1-RR(i,t)). The bounded daily absorbed-pressure proxy is A(i,t)=P(i,t)*RV(i,t)*C(i,t). The persistent signal is S(i,t)=(A(i,t)+A(i,t-1)+A(i,t-2))/3, requiring all three daily A values to be valid under their respective trailing 20-bar calculations; otherwise S is NaN. On each date, the eligible cross-sectional universe is solely the feed tickers with finite S(i,t) and a non-null contemporaneous sector label; no future membership information is used. Within each sector containing at least five eligible tickers, assign S its average-tie percentile rank and center it by subtracting 0.5. The factor is this sector-relative centered rank: high values represent persistent buy-side close pressure with high participation and compressed range, and low values represent the symmetric sell-side condition.

programs.code:
"""A large open-to-close move that finishes near the daily range endpoint despite below-normal participation is treated as a reduced-form indicator of transitory price pressure or unusually weak same-day liquidity absorption, not as identified evidence of displayed-book cancellations or informed flow. With daily OHLCV, the economically coherent implication is partial reversal as liquidity provision and two-sided trading normalize, rather than continuation. The factor therefore fades unusually efficient, endpoint-closing intraday displacements only when volume is below the stock's own recent normal level."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _strict_trailing_volume_median(volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Median of valid volumes in t-20 through t-1, requiring 15 observations."""
    valid_volume = volume.where(np.isfinite(volume) & (volume > 0.0))
    prior_volume = valid_volume.shift(1)
    baseline = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
    valid_count = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).count()
    return baseline.where(valid_count >= 15)


def _sector_centered_percentile(
    raw_signal: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Average-tie sector ranks mapped to centered percentiles with n >= 5."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=raw_signal.index, columns=raw_signal.columns)

    for timestamp in raw_signal.index:
        values = raw_signal.loc[timestamp]
        groups = sector.loc[timestamp]
        valid = values.notna() & groups.notna()
        if not valid.any():
            continue

        valid_values = values.loc[valid]
        valid_groups = groups.loc[valid]
        counts = valid_values.groupby(valid_groups, sort=False).transform("count")
        ranks = valid_values.groupby(valid_groups, sort=False).rank(
            method="average", ascending=True
        )
        scores = 2.0 * ((ranks - 0.5) / counts) - 1.0
        result.loc[timestamp, scores.index] = scores.where(counts >= 5)

    return result


@register_factor
class ThinBookDirectionalDisplacementPersistence(BaseFactor):
    """Sector-neutral fade of endpoint-confirmed low-participation intraday displacement."""

    factor_id = "thin_book_directional_displacement_persistence"
    name = "Low-Participation Intraday Displacement Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fades open-to-close displacements that finish near a daily range endpoint "
        "while volume is below the stock's strictly trailing 20-day median, then "
        "sector-neutralizes the bounded raw signal using centered average-tie ranks."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"]

        valid_prices = (
            np.isfinite(open_)
            & np.isfinite(high)
            & np.isfinite(low)
            & np.isfinite(close)
            & (open_ > 0.0)
            & (high > 0.0)
            & (low > 0.0)
            & (close > 0.0)
            & (high >= low)
        )
        valid_volume = np.isfinite(volume) & (volume > 0.0)

        daily_range = high - low
        valid_range = daily_range >= (0.001 * open_)
        valid = valid_prices & valid_volume & valid_range

        safe_range = daily_range.where(valid)
        efficiency = ((close - open_) / safe_range).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        clv = (2.0 * (close - low) / safe_range - 1.0).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        displacement = efficiency * clv.abs()

        baseline = _strict_trailing_volume_median(volume)
        relative_volume = (volume / baseline).clip(0.25, 4.0)
        low_participation = (1.0 - relative_volume).clip(lower=0.0)

        raw_signal = (displacement * low_participation).where(valid & baseline.notna())
        sector_score = _sector_centered_percentile(raw_signal, sector)

        return (-sector_score).where(sector_score.notna())

programs.trading_idea: A large open-to-close move that finishes near the daily range endpoint despite below-normal participation is treated as a reduced-form indicator of transitory price pressure or unusually weak same-day liquidity absorption, not as identified evidence of displayed-book cancellations or informed flow. The factor therefore fades unusually efficient, endpoint-closing intraday displacements only when volume is below the stock's own recent normal level.
programs.description: At the close of day t, use only same-day OHLCV and strictly prior volume observations. Require finite, strictly positive open, high, low, close, and volume; require high >= low; and require the dollar range R_t = high_t - low_t to be at least 0.001 * open_t. Do not forward-fill or otherwise impute OHLCV inputs. Define the exact open-to-close return as rOC_t = (close_t / open_t) - 1. Define range-normalized intraday efficiency e_t = clip((close_t - open_t) / R_t, -1, 1). Define close-location value clv_t = clip(2 * (close_t - low_t) / R_t - 1, -1, 1), and define signed endpoint displacement d_t = e_t * abs(clv_t); this retains the open-to-close direction while requiring the close to be near either daily endpoint for a large magnitude. For volume normalization, let B_t be the median of the strictly trailing 20 daily volume observations from t-20 through t-1 after retaining only finite positive volumes. B_t is valid only with at least 15 such prior observations; it is not filled with same-day, future, cross-sectional, or stale values. Define vrel_t = clip(volume_t / B_t, 0.25, 4.0), where clipping prevents a single anomalous volume print from dominating the signal. Define the low-participation weight a_t = max(0, 1 - vrel_t), so it is zero at normal-or-higher volume and increases monotonically as volume falls below its trailing median, with a maximum of 0.75 after the defensive lower clip. The raw signal is x_t = d_t * a_t; no return-per-volume division is used. Within each nonmissing sector on date t, retain only stocks with valid x_t and compute average-tie rank rank_t from 1 through n. Require n >= 5 valid stocks in the sector; otherwise assign missing. Convert to a centered sector-neutral percentile score s_t = 2 * ((rank_t - 0.5) / n) - 1. Missing inputs, insufficient history, invalid ranges, missing sector labels, and undersized sector cross-sections produce missing factor values rather than zero-filled values. The factor is observed only after the close of t and may be traded no earlier than the next available executable bar, normally the open of t+1. Its distinguishing construction versus a return-per-volume continuation factor is that it does not interpret displacement per unit volume as concealed informed demand: it uses a bounded below-median-volume gate, an endpoint-confirmation transform, and explicitly forecasts reversal of transitory low-participation displacement.

"""Continuation after a regular idiosyncratic pressure state confirms in an escape.

Mechanism: compressed high-participation directional closes proxy for a gradual,
name-specific execution schedule.  A same-direction range expansion is followed
only when it emerges from that coherent state, where it is more likely to reflect
liquidity depletion and residual execution demand than a generic breakout.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _static_industry_labels(field: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Extract issuer labels; industry is static in the configured feed."""
    filled = field.ffill()
    labels = pd.Series(index=field.columns, dtype=object)
    for column in field.columns:
        observed = filled[column].dropna()
        if not observed.empty:
            labels.loc[column] = observed.iloc[-1]
    return labels


def _industry_residual(values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Demean only adequately populated industry groups on each date."""
    result = values.copy()
    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        columns = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(columns) >= 3:
            group = values.loc[:, columns]
            result.loc[:, columns] = group.sub(group.mean(axis=1), axis=0)
    return result


@register_factor
class RegularPressureConfirmedEscapeCarry(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "regular_pressure_confirmed_escape_carry"
    name = "Regular Pressure Confirmed Escape Carry"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks same-direction range escapes only when they follow coherent, "
        "industry-residualized elevated-volume and compressed-range pressure."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        valid = (
            close.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & high.gt(low)
            & high.notna()
            & low.notna()
        )
        bar_range = (high - low).where(valid)
        proportional_range = (bar_range / close.where(close.gt(0.0))).where(valid)

        volume_ref = volume.where(valid).rolling(15, min_periods=10).median().shift(1)
        range_ref = proportional_range.rolling(15, min_periods=10).median().shift(1)
        relative_volume = (volume / volume_ref.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(valid)
        range_ratio = (proportional_range / range_ref.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(valid)

        close_location = (
            (2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ).where(valid).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0)
        pressure = (
            close_location
            * np.log1p(relative_volume.clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0))
            / range_ratio.clip(lower=0.25, upper=4.0)
        ).where(valid)

        prior_pressure = pressure.shift(1)
        pressure_mean = prior_pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=4).mean()
        pressure_abs_mean = prior_pressure.abs().rolling(5, min_periods=4).mean()
        coherence = (
            pressure_mean.abs() / pressure_abs_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

        labels = _static_industry_labels(data["industry"])
        idio_pressure = _industry_residual(pressure_mean, labels)
        direction = np.sign(idio_pressure)

        prior_participation = relative_volume.shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=4).mean()
        prior_compression = range_ratio.shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=4).mean()
        regular_participation = (prior_participation - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)
        compressed_state = (1.0 - prior_compression).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.75)
        schedule_state = (
            idio_pressure.abs()
            * coherence
            * regular_participation
            * compressed_state
        )

        escape_strength = (range_ratio - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
        aligned_endpoint = (direction * close_location).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        score = direction * schedule_state * escape_strength * aligned_endpoint

        active = (
            valid
            & volume_ref.gt(0.0)
            & range_ref.gt(0.0)
            & schedule_state.gt(0.0)
            & escape_strength.gt(0.0)
            & aligned_endpoint.gt(0.0)
        )
        output = 2.0 * rank(score.where(active)) - 1.0
        return output.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

programs.trading_idea: Repeated high-participation, range-compressed directional closes define a regular, name-specific execution state rather than an isolated volume shock. The child only follows a same-direction range escape when it occurs after that coherent pressure state, distinguishing genuine liquidity depletion and residual metaorder impact from a generic breakout. Parent A supplies the schedule/coherence state variable, while Parent B supplies the escape confirmation; neither a pressure build-up without an escape nor an unconditioned range expansion reliably identifies unfinished directional demand.
programs.description: The signal forms an industry-residualized trailing close-location pressure measure from relative volume and relative range compression, then scores same-direction range expansions occurring after coherent elevated-participation pressure. It cross-sectionally ranks only active pressure-to-escape transitions.

programs.code:
"""Daily OHLCV cannot identify hidden liquidity replenishment, informed traders, or market-maker inventory directly. The testable reduced-form hypothesis is that repeated, unusually high-participation directional closes occurring in below-normal ranges can mark persistent directional demand or supply that has not yet produced a proportional price move; a subsequent same-direction range escape may therefore contain residual short-horizon price pressure. This is a conditional continuation signal rather than a claim that every qualifying pattern represents concealed metaorder execution."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _prior_median_and_validity(
    value: pd.DataFrame,
    valid: pd.DataFrame,
    window: int,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Return trailing medians and complete-window flags using observations before t."""
    clean_value = value.where(valid)
    reference = clean_value.rolling(window, min_periods=window).median().shift(1)
    valid_count = valid.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum().shift(1)
    complete = valid_count.eq(float(window))
    return reference, complete


def _sector_direction_percentile(
    strength: pd.DataFrame,
    direction: pd.DataFrame,
    qualifying: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Percentile-rank escape strength within date, sector, and direction groups."""
    scores = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=strength.index, columns=strength.columns)

    for date in strength.index:
        row_strength = strength.loc[date]
        row_direction = direction.loc[date]
        row_sector = sector.loc[date]
        row_qualifying = qualifying.loc[date]

        eligible = (
            row_qualifying.fillna(False)
            & row_strength.notna()
            & row_sector.notna()
            & row_direction.isin([1.0, -1.0])
        )
        if not bool(eligible.any()):
            continue

        eligible_columns = row_strength.index[eligible]
        keys = (
            row_sector.loc[eligible_columns].astype(str)
            + "|"
            + row_direction.loc[eligible_columns].astype(int).astype(str)
        )

        for _, member_columns in keys.groupby(keys).groups.items():
            member_columns = list(member_columns)
            if len(member_columns) >= 5:
                scores.loc[date, member_columns] = (
                    row_strength.loc[member_columns].rank(pct=True)
                )

    return scores


@register_factor
class AbsorptionToDepletionEscapeDrift(BaseFactor):
    """Directional continuation after compressed high-participation absorption escapes."""

    factor_id = "absorption_to_depletion_escape_drift"
    name = "Defined Absorption-Escape Drift"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Detects repeated directional, high-relative-volume closes in compressed "
        "ranges and scores subsequent same-direction range escapes within sector "
        "and direction cohorts."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = ["high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"]

        positive_close = close.gt(0.0)
        valid_range = positive_close & high.gt(low)
        proportional_range = ((high - low) / close).where(valid_range)
        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where(positive_close & volume.gt(0.0))

        valid_volume = volume.gt(0.0)
        valid_pr = proportional_range.gt(0.0)
        valid_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.gt(0.0)

        volume_ref, complete_volume = _prior_median_and_validity(
            volume, valid_volume, 20
        )
        pr_ref, complete_pr = _prior_median_and_validity(
            proportional_range, valid_pr, 20
        )
        dollar_volume_ref, complete_dollar_volume = _prior_median_and_validity(
            dollar_volume, valid_dollar_volume, 20
        )

        tradable = (
            complete_volume
            & complete_pr
            & complete_dollar_volume
            & volume_ref.gt(0.0)
            & pr_ref.gt(0.0)
            & dollar_volume_ref.ge(5_000_000.0)
            & sector.notna()
        )

        relative_volume = volume / volume_ref.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        range_compression = proportional_range / pr_ref.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = (
            2.0 * (close - low) / (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        ).where(valid_range)

        classified = (
            relative_volume.ge(1.5)
            & range_compression.le(0.75)
            & close_location.abs().ge(0.60)
        ).fillna(False)

        prior_classified = classified.astype(float).shift(1)
        classified_count = prior_classified.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()

        prior_classified_cl = close_location.where(classified, 0.0).shift(1)
        direction_sum = prior_classified_cl.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        direction = np.sign(direction_sum)

        positive_count = (
            (classified & close_location.gt(0.0)).astype(float).shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        )
        negative_count = (
            (classified & close_location.lt(0.0)).astype(float).shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        )
        agreeing_count = positive_count.where(direction.gt(0.0), negative_count)
        directional_agreement = agreeing_count / classified_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        absorbed_baseline_pr = (
            proportional_range.where(classified).shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).median()
        )

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        close_return = close / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        escape_strength = proportional_range / absorbed_baseline_pr.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        antecedent_ok = (
            classified_count.ge(3.0)
            & direction.ne(0.0)
            & directional_agreement.ge(0.80)
            & absorbed_baseline_pr.gt(0.0)
        )
        escape = (
            escape_strength.ge(1.5)
            & np.sign(close_location).eq(direction)
            & close_location.abs().ge(0.60)
            & (direction * close_return).ge(0.25 * absorbed_baseline_pr)
        )
        qualifying = tradable & antecedent_ok & escape

        current_valid = valid_range & prior_close.gt(0.0)
        score_rank = _sector_direction_percentile(
            escape_strength, direction, qualifying, sector
        )
        score = direction * score_rank

        return score.where(tradable & current_valid, np.nan).astype(float)

The testable reduced-form hypothesis is that repeated, unusually high-participation directional closes occurring in below-normal ranges can mark persistent directional demand or supply that has not yet produced a proportional price move; a subsequent same-direction range escape may therefore contain residual short-horizon price pressure. This is a conditional continuation signal rather than a claim that every qualifying pattern represents concealed metaorder execution.
programs.description: Compute proportional range PR_t=(high_t-low_t)/close_t only when close_t>0 and high_t>low_t; otherwise PR_t is invalid. Compute 20-prior-bar reference values using bars t-20 through t-1 only: RVref_t=median(volume), PRref_t=median(PR), and DVref_t=median(close*volume). A stock is tradable only when all 20 prior volume, PR, and dollar-volume observations are valid and positive, its prior-20-bar median dollar volume is at least USD 5,000,000, and sector is non-missing. Relative volume is RV_t=volume_t/RVref_t and range compression is CR_t=PR_t/PRref_t. For each antecedent bar j in t-5 through t-1, define close location CL_j=2*(close_j-low_j)/(high_j-low_j)-1 and classify it as an absorbed-direction observation only if RV_j>=1.5, CR_j<=0.75, and |CL_j|>=0.60. Require at least three classified antecedent observations. Define the absorbed baseline direction d as sign(sum(CL_j over classified observations)); require d!=0 and at least 80% of classified observations have sign(CL_j)=d. Define the absorbed baseline range BPR as the median PR_j across classified observations. The current bar t is an escape only when PR_t/BPR>=1.5, sign(CL_t)=d, |CL_t|>=0.60, and d*(close_t/close_{t-1}-1)>=0.25*BPR. This requires the expansion, close-location displacement, and close-to-close movement all to agree with the antecedent direction. For qualifying names, escape strength is ES_t=PR_t/BPR. Within each sector separately and separately for d=+1 and d=-1, percentile-rank ES_t among qualifying names; require at least five qualifying names for that sector-direction group. The delivered score is d times that percentile rank, with non-qualifiers assigned zero and invalid/tradability-failing observations assigned NaN. Compute the signal after the current daily close. Rebalance daily: enter at the next bar open, hold each signal sleeve for exactly six daily bars, and exit at the open of the seventh executable bar; overlapping daily sleeves are permitted. Performance should be assessed net of realistic costs and for incremental return after neutralizing the named compression/participation, signed-impact, and sector-residual factor exposures.

"""This is a constrained test of whether a fully or substantially repaired opening gap reflects temporary opening liquidity pressure rather than durable information. A downside opening gap that is repaired by the close is weighted more heavily for firms with stronger pre-existing balance-sheet resilience, where forced financing or distress news is less plausible; an upside gap repair is weighted more heavily for financially fragile firms, where an early upward move may be more vulnerable to liquidity withdrawal or short-covering reversal. The factor does not claim to observe auction imbalance, depth, cancellations, or informed order flow directly; it uses daily OHLCV as an indirect and explicitly conditional proxy for opening-price pressure."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _cross_sectional_winsorize(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Clip each date's cross-section at its finite 1st and 99th percentiles."""
    clean = df.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    lower = clean.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = clean.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    return clean.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)


def _resilience_percentile(data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Construct the available-component balance-sheet resilience percentile."""
    cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    debt_to_assets = data["debtToAssets"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    operating_cash_flow = data["operatingCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    market_cap = data["marketCap"].replace([0.0, np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    interest_coverage = data["interestCoverage"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    cash_rank = cash_ratio.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    debt_rank = (-debt_to_assets).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    ocf_yield_rank = (operating_cash_flow / market_cap).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    coverage_rank = interest_coverage.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

    components = pd.concat(
        [cash_rank, debt_rank, ocf_yield_rank, coverage_rank],
        axis=0,
        keys=["cash", "debt", "ocf", "coverage"],
    )
    component_count = components.notna().groupby(level=1).sum()
    component_mean = components.groupby(level=1).mean()

    eligible_mean = component_mean.where(component_count >= 2)
    return eligible_mean.rank(axis=1, pct=True)


@register_factor
class SolvencyBufferedOpeningGapRepair(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks high-volume opening-gap repairs conditional on balance-sheet resilience."""

    factor_id = "solvency_buffered_opening_gap_repair"
    name = "Asymmetric Solvency-Weighted Gap Repair"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Cross-sectional rank of repaired opening gaps, emphasizing repaired "
        "downside gaps in solvent firms and repaired upside gaps in fragile firms, "
        "with abnormal-volume confirmation."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = [
        "open",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "cashRatio",
        "debtToAssets",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "marketCap",
        "interestCoverage",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_price = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        previous_close = close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        safe_open = open_price.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        gap = open_price / previous_close - 1.0
        intraday_return = close / safe_open - 1.0
        gap_winsorized = _cross_sectional_winsorize(gap)

        repair_fraction = (-intraday_return / gap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        repair_fraction = repair_fraction.where(gap.ne(0.0), 0.0)

        prior_volume_median = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        abnormal_volume = volume / prior_volume_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        abnormal_volume = _cross_sectional_winsorize(abnormal_volume)
        abnormal_volume_percentile = abnormal_volume.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

        resilience = _resilience_percentile(data)
        valid = (
            gap.notna()
            & gap_winsorized.notna()
            & repair_fraction.notna()
            & abnormal_volume_percentile.notna()
            & resilience.notna()
        )

        downside = gap.lt(0.0)
        upside = gap.gt(0.0)
        raw = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=close.index, columns=close.columns, dtype=float)

        downside_signal = (
            gap_winsorized.abs()
            * repair_fraction
            * abnormal_volume_percentile
            * resilience
        )
        upside_signal = (
            -gap_winsorized.abs()
            * repair_fraction
            * abnormal_volume_percentile
            * (1.0 - resilience)
        )

        raw = raw.where(~downside, downside_signal)
        raw = raw.where(~upside, upside_signal)
        raw = raw.where(~gap.eq(0.0), 0.0)
        raw = raw.where(valid)

        percentile = raw.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        return (2.0 * percentile - 1.0).where(valid)

A downside opening gap that is repaired by the close is weighted more heavily for firms with stronger pre-existing balance-sheet resilience, where forced financing or distress news is less plausible; an upside gap repair is weighted more heavily for financially fragile firms, where an early upward move may be more vulnerable to liquidity withdrawal or short-covering reversal. programs.description: Compute only after the official close of day t. Let g_t = open_t / close_(t-1) - 1 and i_t = close_t / open_t - 1. Winsorize g_t cross-sectionally each day at the 1st and 99th percentiles, producing gW_t. Define repair fraction rho_t = min(1, max(0, -i_t / g_t)) when g_t is nonzero, and zero otherwise; rho is positive only when the intraday move opposes the opening gap. Define abnormal volume AV_t = volume_t / median(volume_(t-20), ..., volume_(t-1)); winsorize AV_t cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles and convert it to a cross-sectional percentile a_t in [0,1]. Construct a point-in-time resilience percentile q_t as the cross-sectional percentile rank of the equal-weighted mean of the available percentile ranks of cashRatio, negative debtToAssets, operatingCashFlow / marketCap, and interestCoverage; require at least two available components, otherwise leave q_t missing. The raw signal is +abs(gW_t) * rho_t * a_t * q_t for g_t < 0, -abs(gW_t) * rho_t * a_t * (1-q_t) for g_t > 0, and zero for g_t = 0. Finally, cross-sectionally rank the raw signal among valid names and map it to [-1, 1] using 2 * percentile_rank - 1. A positive factor value is long and a negative value is short. The signal is formed after day t close, entered no earlier than the next executable bar on day t+1, and evaluated using the six-bar return from that entry through the close of day t+6.

"""This is not a standalone claim that daily OHLCV identifies forced execution or intermediary inventory. Instead, it is an incremental endpoint-confirmation condition for an existing participation-taper signal: a prior multi-day price-volume imbalance is more likely exhausted when current participation contracts and the close finishes at the opposite end of the daily range. The predicted reversal is conditional on that same-day directional rejection; absent rejection, reduced volume may simply be a pause in informed or news-driven trading rather than completion."""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _earnings_release_day(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Flag a change from the prior causally available reported value."""
    available = actual.ffill()
    prior = available.shift(1)
    return available.notna() & prior.notna() & available.ne(prior)

def _cross_sectional_winsorize(values: pd.DataFrame, lower_q: float, upper_q: float) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Clip each date's eligible cross-section at causal same-date quantiles."""
    lower = values.quantile(lower_q, axis=1)
    upper = values.quantile(upper_q, axis=1)
    return values.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)

@register_factor
class ParticipationWithdrawalEndpointInventoryReve(BaseFactor):
    """Directional rejection after tapered participation confirms pressure exhaustion."""
    factor_id = 'participation_withdrawal_endpoint_inventory_reve_1'
    name = 'Directional Rejection Taper Confirmation'
    category = 'microstructure'
    description = 'Endpoint-confirmation interaction for a prior five-day signed price-participation imbalance: ranks reversal candidates only when participation withdraws and the current close rejects the prior direction at the opposite end of its daily range. Intended for incremental testing conditional on scheduled_participation_taper_reversal.'
    window_length = 26
    inputs = ['close', 'high', 'low', 'volume', 'epsActual', 'revenueActual']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data['close']
        high = data['high']
        low = data['low']
        volume = data['volume']
        prior_volume_median = volume.rolling(21, min_periods=15).median().shift(1)
        participation = volume / prior_volume_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        participation = participation.clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)
        returns = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
        signed_flow = returns * participation
        pressure = signed_flow.rolling(6, min_periods=5).sum().shift(1)
        prior_participation = participation.rolling(6, min_periods=5).mean().shift(1)
        abnormal_participation = (prior_participation - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)
        withdrawal = (prior_participation - participation).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)
        daily_range = (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = 2.0 * (close - low) / daily_range - 1.0
        close_location = close_location.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
        pressure_sign = np.sign(pressure)
        directional_rejection = (-pressure_sign * close_location).clip(lower=0.0)
        score = -pressure_sign * pressure.abs() * abnormal_participation * withdrawal * directional_rejection
        score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        dollar_volume = (close * volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        median_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.rolling(21, min_periods=15).median()
        dollar_volume_rank = median_dollar_volume.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        liquid = dollar_volume_rank.ge(0.3)
        eps_release = _earnings_release_day(data['epsActual'])
        revenue_release = _earnings_release_day(data['revenueActual'])
        eligible = liquid & ~(eps_release | revenue_release) & score.notna()
        eligible_score = score.where(eligible)
        winsorized = _cross_sectional_winsorize(eligible_score, 0.01, 0.99)
        scaled_rank = 2.0 * rank(winsorized) - 1.0
        return scaled_rank.where(eligible, 0.0).fillna(0.0)

Instead, it is an incremental endpoint-confirmation condition for an existing participation-taper signal: a prior multi-day price-volume imbalance is more likely exhausted when current participation contracts and the close finishes at the opposite end of the daily range. The predicted reversal is conditional on that same-day directional rejection; absent rejection, reduced volume may simply be a pause in informed or news-driven trading rather than completion.
programs.description: Form the signal at the close of day t and trade no earlier than the open of t+1. Let r_i = close_i / close_{i-1} - 1 and dv_i = close_i * volume_i. Define relative participation q_i = volume_i / median(volume_{i-20},...,volume_{i-1}), requiring at least 15 non-missing observations and clipping q_i to [0, 5]. Define prior five-day signed pressure P_t = sum_{i=t-5}^{t-1}(r_i * q_i). Define prior abnormal participation A_t = clip(mean(q_{t-5},...,q_{t-1}) - 1, 0, 2) and current participation withdrawal W_t = clip(mean(q_{t-5},...,q_{t-1}) - q_t, 0, 2). Define close-location rejection R_t = 2 * (close_t - low_t) / (high_t - low_t) - 1, setting R_t to 0 when high_t equals low_t. The raw endpoint-confirmation score is S_t = -sign(P_t) * abs(P_t) * A_t * W_t * max(0, -sign(P_t) * R_t): prior sell pressure contributes positively only when the current close is in the upper part of its range, while prior buy pressure contributes negatively only when the close is in the lower part of its range. Winsorize S_t cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles each day and convert it to a cross-sectional rank scaled to [-1, 1]. Restrict eligibility to stocks in the top 70% of the cross-section by trailing-20-day median dollar volume and exclude observations on a day when epsActual or revenueActual changes from the prior available value, to reduce earnings-release contamination. The candidate must be tested as an interaction/residualized increment over scheduled_participation_taper_reversal: evaluate its forward-return coefficient after controlling for that existing taper score, rather than treating the taper component as a distinct standalone alpha.

"""Terminal fade of a thin endpoint extension after participation pressure tapers.

Mechanism: a same-direction, low-participation endpoint move is treated as the
last residual displacement of a previously high-participation execution episode
only when the earlier signed pressure is now withdrawing.  This phase condition
separates a likely inventory-completion print from an isolated low-volume move.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _prior_volume_median(volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Strictly causal 20-bar volume reference ending at t-1."""
    clean = volume.where(np.isfinite(volume) & (volume > 0.0))
    prior = clean.shift(1)
    median = prior.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
    count = prior.rolling(20, min_periods=15).count()
    return median.where(count >= 15)


def _sector_centered_rank(
    values: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Centered within-sector percentile, requiring a usable peer set."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)
    for timestamp in values.index:
        row = values.loc[timestamp]
        groups = sector.loc[timestamp]
        valid = row.notna() & groups.notna()
        if not valid.any():
            continue
        x = row.loc[valid]
        g = groups.loc[valid]
        count = x.groupby(g, sort=False).transform("count")
        ranks = x.groupby(g, sort=False).rank(method="average", ascending=True)
        centered = 2.0 * ((ranks - 0.5) / count) - 1.0
        result.loc[timestamp, centered.index] = centered.where(count >= 5)
    return result


@register_factor
class TaperedPressureThinEndpointTerminalFade(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "tapered_pressure_thin_endpoint_terminal_fade"
    name = "Tapered Pressure Thin-Endpoint Fade"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fades a low-volume, endpoint-closing intraday extension only when it "
        "continues a prior high-participation signed pressure episode whose "
        "participation has subsequently withdrawn; ranks the signed fade within sector."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"]

        valid_prices = (
            np.isfinite(open_)
            & np.isfinite(high)
            & np.isfinite(low)
            & np.isfinite(close)
            & (open_ > 0.0)
            & (high >= low)
        )
        valid_volume = np.isfinite(volume) & (volume > 0.0)
        daily_range = high - low
        valid_range = daily_range >= 0.001 * open_
        valid = valid_prices & valid_volume & valid_range

        baseline = _prior_volume_median(volume)
        participation = (volume / baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 5.0)
        ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0

        # Both state variables deliberately end at t-1: the current bar is the
        # potential terminal extension, not part of the evidence for prior flow.
        signed_participation_flow = ret * participation
        pressure = signed_participation_flow.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum().shift(1)
        prior_participation = participation.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean().shift(1)
        abnormal_prior = (prior_participation - 1.0).clip(0.0, 2.0)
        withdrawal = (prior_participation - participation).clip(0.0, 2.0)

        relative_volume = (volume / baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.25, 4.0)
        thinness = (1.0 - relative_volume).clip(lower=0.0)

        safe_range = daily_range.where(valid)
        close_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / safe_range - 1.0).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        open_close_displacement = ((close - open_) / safe_range).clip(-1.0, 1.0)

        # A current extension is informative only when it continues, rather than
        # rejects, the earlier pressure direction.  Its endpoint location measures
        # how little two-sided liquidity was required to carry the final print.
        coherence = (
            np.sign(pressure) * open_close_displacement
        ).clip(lower=0.0)
        endpoint = close_location.abs()
        terminal_intensity = (
            pressure.abs().clip(upper=0.25)
            * abnormal_prior
            * withdrawal
            * thinness
            * coherence
            * endpoint
        )

        # Fade the final same-direction displacement: positive scores buy former
        # sell programs and sell former buy programs.
        raw_fade = (-np.sign(pressure) * terminal_intensity).replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
        )
        eligible = valid & baseline.notna() & pressure.notna() & (terminal_intensity > 0.0)
        sector_score = _sector_centered_rank(raw_fade.where(eligible), sector)
        return sector_score.where(sector_score.notna(), 0.0).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Tapered Pressure Thin-Endpoint Fade
programs.trading_idea: The child identifies a specific execution-completion phase: a prior multi-day, high-participation signed price-pressure episode has already begun to taper, yet the current bar extends in the same direction and closes near its endpoint on below-normal volume. Parent A supplies the state variable indicating that a participation-driven inventory program is decaying, while Parent B supplies the terminal low-depth displacement; together they distinguish a final residual print from either an ordinary rejection bar or an isolated thin-volume move. This interaction should reverse over six bars because the remaining directional liquidity demand has become small while the endpoint displacement reveals temporarily weak two-sided absorption.
programs.description: Sector-neutral cross-sectional ranking of the opposite of a same-direction endpoint extension, activated only after elevated five-day signed participation pressure has withdrawn and current volume is below its strictly trailing median. Positive values are long prior sell-pressure terminal extensions and short prior buy-pressure terminal extensions.

"""Idiosyncratic cadenced compressed-flow continuation.

Mechanism: compressed-range high-volume pressure is most likely to persist when
it arrives with a regular multi-day participation schedule and is distinct from
contemporaneous industry flow.  The factor therefore treats regularity as a
state variable that separates unfinished directional execution from isolated
inventory shocks.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _static_industry_labels(field: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Extract one issuer label; industry is static in the configured feed."""
    labels = field.ffill()
    if labels.empty:
        return pd.Series(index=field.columns, dtype=object)
    return labels.iloc[-1].reindex(field.columns)


def _industry_residual(signal: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Leave-one-out industry median residual, with raw signal as fallback."""
    output = signal.copy()
    for group in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        columns = labels.index[labels == group]
        if len(columns) < 4:
            continue
        group_signal = signal.loc[:, columns]
        for column in columns:
            peers = group_signal.drop(columns=column)
            peer_median = peers.median(axis=1, skipna=True)
            peer_count = peers.notna().sum(axis=1)
            residual = group_signal[column] - peer_median
            output.loc[:, column] = residual.where(peer_count >= 3, group_signal[column])
    return output


@register_factor
class IdiosyncraticCadenceCompressionContinuation(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "idiosyncratic_cadence_compression_continuation"
    name = "Idiosyncratic Cadenced Compression Drift"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Industry-residual close-location pressure weighted by persistent relative "
        "participation, intraday range compression, and regularity of the recent "
        "participation schedule; high values predict continuation."
    )
    window_length = 17
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        valid = (
            close.notna()
            & high.notna()
            & low.notna()
            & volume.notna()
            & (close > 0.0)
            & (high > low)
            & (volume > 0.0)
        )
        bar_range = ((high - low) / close.where(close > 0.0)).where(valid)
        close_location = (
            (2.0 * close - high - low) / (high - low).where(high > low)
        ).where(valid)

        prior_volume = volume.where(valid).shift(1).rolling(12, min_periods=6).median()
        prior_range = bar_range.shift(1).rolling(12, min_periods=6).median()
        relative_volume = (volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=4.0)
        relative_range = bar_range / prior_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        daily_pressure = (
            close_location
            * np.log1p(relative_volume)
            / relative_range.clip(lower=0.30)
        ).where(valid & relative_volume.notna() & relative_range.notna())

        persistent_pressure = daily_pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean()
        mean_volume = relative_volume.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean()
        volume_cv = relative_volume.rolling(5, min_periods=3).std(ddof=0) / mean_volume.where(mean_volume > 0.0)
        mean_range = relative_range.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean()

        cadence_weight = (mean_volume / (1.0 + volume_cv)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
        compression_weight = (1.0 - mean_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        scheduled_pressure = persistent_pressure * cadence_weight * compression_weight

        labels = _static_industry_labels(data["industry"])
        residual = _industry_residual(scheduled_pressure, labels)
        neutralized = residual.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
        return rank(neutralized).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
programs.name: Idiosyncratic Cadenced Compression Drift
programs.trading_idea: Compressed-range, high-participation close-location pressure is ambiguous by itself: it can be temporary inventory pressure or informed/scheduled demand. The child conditions that state on Parent A's regular multi-day participation cadence and removes industry-common pressure; recurrent, name-specific pressure is more consistent with an unfinished execution schedule than a one-off liquidity transfer. This interaction explains why Parent B's realized positive sign can hold at six bars: regularity identifies pressure that remains active, whereas isolated compressed-volume events are more likely to unwind.
programs.description: Cross-sectionally ranks industry-residual directional close-location pressure, weighted by persistent relative volume, compressed range, and the regularity of participation over the preceding five bars. Sparse or unavailable observations are assigned a neutral cross-sectional value rather than being aggressively masked.

class ParticipationWithdrawalEndpointInventoryReve(BaseFactor):
    """Directional rejection after tapered participation confirms pressure exhaustion."""

    factor_id = "participation_withdrawal_endpoint_inventory_reve"
    name = "Directional Rejection Taper Confirmation"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Endpoint-confirmation interaction for a prior five-day signed "
        "price-participation imbalance: ranks reversal candidates only when "
        "participation withdraws and the current close rejects the prior "
        "direction at the opposite end of its daily range. Intended for "
        "incremental testing conditional on scheduled_participation_taper_reversal."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "epsActual", "revenueActual"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        # Relative participation uses only the preceding 20 observations.
        prior_volume_median = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median().shift(1)
        participation = volume / prior_volume_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        participation = participation.clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)

        returns = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
        signed_flow = returns * participation

        # All pressure and abnormal-participation terms end at t-1.
        pressure = signed_flow.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum().shift(1)
        prior_participation = participation.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean().shift(1)
        abnormal_participation = (prior_participation - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)
        withdrawal = (prior_participation - participation).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)

        daily_range = (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = 2.0 * (close - low) / daily_range - 1.0
        close_location = close_location.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

        pressure_sign = np.sign(pressure)
        directional_rejection = (-pressure_sign * close_location).clip(lower=0.0)
        score = (
            -pressure_sign
            * pressure.abs()
            * abnormal_participation
            * withdrawal
            * directional_rejection
        )
        score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        # Liquidity eligibility is based on trailing median dollar volume.
        dollar_volume = (close * volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        median_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        dollar_volume_rank = median_dollar_volume.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        liquid = dollar_volume_rank.ge(0.30)

        eps_release = _earnings_release_day(data["epsActual"])
        revenue_release = _earnings_release_day(data["revenueActual"])
        eligible = liquid & ~(eps_release | revenue_release) & score.notna()

        eligible_score = score.where(eligible)
        winsorized = _cross_sectional_winsorize(eligible_score, 0.01, 0.99)
        scaled_rank = 2.0 * rank(winsorized) - 1.0

        # Ineligible names receive neutral exposure while preserving panel shape.
        return scaled_rank.where(eligible, 0.0).fillna(0.0)

programs.trading_idea: This is not a standalone claim that daily OHLCV identifies forced execution or intermediary inventory. Instead, it is an incremental endpoint-confirmation condition for an existing participation-taper signal: a prior multi-day price-volume imbalance is more likely exhausted when current participation contracts and the close finishes at the opposite end of the daily range. The predicted reversal is conditional on that same-day directional rejection; absent rejection, reduced volume may simply be a pause in informed or news-driven trading rather than completion.
programs.description: Form the signal at the close of day t and trade no earlier than the open of t+1. Let r_i = close_i / close_{i-1} - 1 and dv_i = close_i * volume_i. Define relative participation q_i = volume_i / median(volume_{i-20},...,volume_{i-1}), requiring at least 15 non-missing observations and clipping q_i to [0, 5]. Define prior five-day signed pressure P_t = sum_{i=t-5}^{t-1}(r_i * q_i). Define prior abnormal participation A_t = clip(mean(q_{t-5},...,q_{t-1}) - 1, 0, 2) and current participation withdrawal W_t = clip(mean(q_{t-5},...,q_{t-1}) - q_t, 0, 2). Define close-location rejection R_t = 2 * (close_t - low_t) / (high_t - low_t) - 1, setting R_t to 0 when high_t equals low_t. The raw endpoint-confirmation score is S_t = -sign(P_t) * abs(P_t) * A_t * W_t * max(0, -sign(P_t) * R_t): prior sell pressure contributes positively only when the current close is in the upper part of its range, while prior buy pressure contributes negatively only when the close is in the lower part of its range. Winsorize S_t cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles each day and convert it to a cross-sectional rank scaled to [-1, 1]. Restrict eligibility to stocks in the top 70% of the cross-section by trailing-20-day median dollar volume and exclude observations on a day when epsActual or revenueActual changes from the prior available value, to reduce earnings-release contamination. The candidate must be tested as an interaction/residualized increment over scheduled_participation_taper_reversal: evaluate its forward-return coefficient after controlling for that existing taper score, rather than treating the taper component as a distinct standalone alpha.
