"""The signal treats an opening-price displacement that is subsequently traversed back through the prior close, but finishes without close-side acceptance, as a measurable nonacceptance pattern rather than as proof of any particular investor identity or information state. The hypothesis is that, conditional on unusually large opening dislocations and unusually high participation, an interior close after a full auction-to-prior-close traversal reflects temporarily unstable price formation and has a negative relation to the terminal same-day close direction over the following six sessions. This is an empirical liquidity-replenishment and price-acceptance hypothesis; it does not assume that benchmark, institutional, or informed flow can be identified from OHLCV alone."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _finite_positive(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return the validity mask for finite strictly positive numeric values."""
    return frame.gt(0.0) & np.isfinite(frame)


def _cross_sectional_standardize(
    raw: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Standardize only across the contemporaneously eligible universe."""
    eligible_raw = raw.where(eligible)
    mean = eligible_raw.mean(axis=1)
    std = eligible_raw.std(axis=1, ddof=0)
    zscore = eligible_raw.sub(mean, axis=0).div(std.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
    return zscore.where(eligible & std.gt(0.0), 0.0).clip(-3.0, 3.0).fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class AuctionRoundtripNonacceptanceReversion(BaseFactor):
    """Fade high-participation opening auctions that traverse and reject the prior close."""

    factor_id = "auction_roundtrip_nonacceptance_reversion"
    name = "Auction Round-Trip Nonacceptance Reversion"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks volatility-normalized opening gaps, normalized intraday range, and "
        "relative participation when the bar traverses the prior close but ends at "
        "an interior location, then fades the terminal close direction."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        daily_return = (
            close.div(prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan))
            .sub(1.0)
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        )

        # At t these windows end at t-1, excluding the completed bar's return
        # and volume from their respective normalizers.
        prior_returns = daily_return.shift(1)
        sigma = prior_returns.rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        prior_volume = volume.shift(1)
        volume_count = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).count()
        average_volume = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()

        price_valid = (
            _finite_positive(prior_close)
            & _finite_positive(open_)
            & _finite_positive(high)
            & _finite_positive(low)
            & _finite_positive(close)
            & _finite_positive(volume)
        )
        sigma_valid = sigma.gt(0.0) & np.isfinite(sigma)
        volume_valid = (
            volume_count.ge(15.0)
            & average_volume.gt(0.0)
            & np.isfinite(average_volume)
        )
        eligible = price_valid & sigma_valid & volume_valid

        gap = open_.div(prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)).sub(1.0)
        close_return = close.div(prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)).sub(1.0)
        gap = gap.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        close_return = close_return.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        normalized_gap = gap.abs().div(sigma).clip(0.0, 5.0)
        relative_participation = volume.div(average_volume).clip(0.0, 10.0)
        normalized_range = (
            high.sub(low).div(prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)).div(sigma).clip(0.0, 8.0)
        )

        eligible_gap = normalized_gap.where(eligible)
        eligible_participation = relative_participation.where(eligible)
        eligible_range = normalized_range.where(eligible)

        gap_cutoff = eligible_gap.quantile(0.80, axis=1)
        participation_cutoff = eligible_participation.quantile(0.80, axis=1)
        material_gap = normalized_gap.ge(gap_cutoff, axis=0) & normalized_gap.notna()
        material_participation = (
            relative_participation.ge(participation_cutoff, axis=0)
            & relative_participation.notna()
        )

        bar_range = high.sub(low)
        clv = close.sub(low).div(bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        interior_close = bar_range.gt(0.0) & clv.ge(0.25) & clv.le(0.75)

        upward_traversal = gap.gt(0.0) & high.ge(open_) & low.le(prior_close)
        downward_traversal = gap.lt(0.0) & low.le(open_) & high.ge(prior_close)
        traversal = upward_traversal | downward_traversal

        qualifying = (
            eligible
            & material_gap
            & material_participation
            & traversal
            & interior_close
        )

        gap_rank = eligible_gap.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        range_rank = eligible_range.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        participation_rank = eligible_participation.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        quality = gap_rank.add(range_rank).add(participation_rank).div(3.0)

        raw = (-np.sign(close_return) * quality).where(qualifying, 0.0)
        return _cross_sectional_standardize(raw, eligible)

"""An opening gap that remains substantially unrefilled and closes at the directional end of the daily range is interpreted as evidence that opposing displayed liquidity did not replenish sufficiently during the session. With daily OHLCV data, this is not claimed to identify scheduled institutional execution or auction-specific order flow; it is a reduced-form proxy for persistent directional liquidity imbalance. The prediction is continuation when the imbalance persists over several sessions, while explicitly recognizing that information-driven repricing is an observationally similar alternative explanation."""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import indneutralize, rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _gap_imbalance_score(open_: pd.DataFrame, high: pd.DataFrame, low: pd.DataFrame, close: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute the causal daily unrefilled-opening-gap imbalance score."""
    previous_close = close.shift(1)
    valid_prices = (open_ > 0.0) & (previous_close > 0.0)
    gap = np.log((open_ / previous_close).where(valid_prices))
    gap_sign = np.sign(gap)
    intraday_range = high - low
    true_range = np.maximum(intraday_range, np.maximum((high - previous_close).abs(), (low - previous_close).abs()))
    normalized_true_range = (true_range / previous_close).where(previous_close > 0.0)
    median_normalized_range = normalized_true_range.rolling(22, min_periods=20).median()
    magnitude = (gap.abs() / median_normalized_range.where(median_normalized_range > 0.0)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
    upward_refill = (open_ - low) / (open_ - previous_close).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    downward_refill = (high - open_) / (previous_close - open_).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    refill = upward_refill.where(gap > 0.0, downward_refill).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    close_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / intraday_range.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0).where(intraday_range > 0.0, 0.0)
    retention = (1.0 + gap_sign * close_location) / 2.0
    daily = gap_sign * magnitude * (1.0 - refill) * retention
    nonzero_gap = gap.notna() & gap.ne(0.0)
    daily = daily.where(nonzero_gap)
    daily = daily.mask(gap.eq(0.0), 0.0)
    return daily.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

@register_factor
class OpenGapRefillParticipationClock(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks persistent directional opening gaps whose opposing liquidity did not refill."""
    factor_id = 'open_gap_refill_participation_clock_j'
    name = 'Unrefilled Gap Liquidity Persistence'
    category = 'microstructure'
    description = 'Cross-sectional sector-neutral rank of the mean three-session signed opening-gap imbalance score, where large unrefilled gaps closing at their directional range extreme indicate persistent liquidity imbalance.'
    window_length = 22
    inputs = ['open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'sector']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        daily_score = _gap_imbalance_score(data['open'], data['high'], data['low'], data['close'])
        persistence = daily_score.rolling(2, min_periods=2).mean()
        mapped_rank = 2.0 * rank(persistence) - 1.0
        neutralized = indneutralize(mapped_rank, data['sector'])
        return neutralized.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

Define true range TR_t = max(High_t-Low_t, abs(High_t-Close_{t-1}), abs(Low_t-Close_{t-1})) and normalized gap magnitude m_t = min(abs(g_t) / median(TR_{t-19:t} / Close_{t-1}), 3); if the median denominator is missing or nonpositive, set the daily score to NaN. Positive factor exposure is long and negative exposure is short. All inputs are observed through Close_t only, and positions may be entered no earlier than t+1.

"""This is a constrained test of whether a fully or substantially repaired opening gap reflects temporary opening liquidity pressure rather than durable information. A downside opening gap that is repaired by the close is weighted more heavily for firms with stronger pre-existing balance-sheet resilience, where forced financing or distress news is less plausible; an upside gap repair is weighted more heavily for financially fragile firms, where an early upward move may be more vulnerable to liquidity withdrawal or short-covering reversal. The factor does not claim to observe auction imbalance, depth, cancellations, or informed order flow directly; it uses daily OHLCV as an indirect and explicitly conditional proxy for opening-price pressure."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _cross_sectional_winsorize(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Clip each date's cross-section at its finite 1st and 99th percentiles."""
    clean = df.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    lower = clean.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = clean.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    return clean.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)


def _resilience_percentile(data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Construct the available-component balance-sheet resilience percentile."""
    cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    debt_to_assets = data["debtToAssets"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    operating_cash_flow = data["operatingCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    market_cap = data["marketCap"].replace([0.0, np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    interest_coverage = data["interestCoverage"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    cash_rank = cash_ratio.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    debt_rank = (-debt_to_assets).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    ocf_yield_rank = (operating_cash_flow / market_cap).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    coverage_rank = interest_coverage.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

    components = pd.concat(
        [cash_rank, debt_rank, ocf_yield_rank, coverage_rank],
        axis=0,
        keys=["cash", "debt", "ocf", "coverage"],
    )
    component_count = components.notna().groupby(level=1).sum()
    component_mean = components.groupby(level=1).mean()

    eligible_mean = component_mean.where(component_count >= 2)
    return eligible_mean.rank(axis=1, pct=True)


@register_factor
class SolvencyBufferedOpeningGapRepair(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks high-volume opening-gap repairs conditional on balance-sheet resilience."""

    factor_id = "solvency_buffered_opening_gap_repair"
    name = "Asymmetric Solvency-Weighted Gap Repair"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Cross-sectional rank of repaired opening gaps, emphasizing repaired "
        "downside gaps in solvent firms and repaired upside gaps in fragile firms, "
        "with abnormal-volume confirmation."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = [
        "open",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "cashRatio",
        "debtToAssets",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "marketCap",
        "interestCoverage",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_price = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        previous_close = close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        safe_open = open_price.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        gap = open_price / previous_close - 1.0
        intraday_return = close / safe_open - 1.0
        gap_winsorized = _cross_sectional_winsorize(gap)

        repair_fraction = (-intraday_return / gap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        repair_fraction = repair_fraction.where(gap.ne(0.0), 0.0)

        prior_volume_median = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        abnormal_volume = volume / prior_volume_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        abnormal_volume = _cross_sectional_winsorize(abnormal_volume)
        abnormal_volume_percentile = abnormal_volume.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

        resilience = _resilience_percentile(data)
        valid = (
            gap.notna()
            & gap_winsorized.notna()
            & repair_fraction.notna()
            & abnormal_volume_percentile.notna()
            & resilience.notna()
        )

        downside = gap.lt(0.0)
        upside = gap.gt(0.0)
        raw = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=close.index, columns=close.columns, dtype=float)

        downside_signal = (
            gap_winsorized.abs()
            * repair_fraction
            * abnormal_volume_percentile
            * resilience
        )
        upside_signal = (
            -gap_winsorized.abs()
            * repair_fraction
            * abnormal_volume_percentile
            * (1.0 - resilience)
        )

        raw = raw.where(~downside, downside_signal)
        raw = raw.where(~upside, upside_signal)
        raw = raw.where(~gap.eq(0.0), 0.0)
        raw = raw.where(valid)

        percentile = raw.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        return (2.0 * percentile - 1.0).where(valid)

"""Temporary liquidity pressure can create short-lived relative-price dislocations among stocks that historically exhibit synchronous directional price-volume behavior. Daily OHLCV cannot identify signed order flow, ETF activity, or informed trading, so the close-location-volume measure is used only as a directional-pressure proxy and as an exclusion filter for likely idiosyncratic events. The hypothesis is therefore conditional residual reversal: a stock's abnormal return versus stable positive-flow peers should revert over the next six bars only when its own directional-pressure and intraday-range proxies are not exceptional."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _pairwise_correlation(values: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Pairwise-complete Pearson correlations for one trailing time window.

    The calculations are matrix products over observations in ``values`` and
    therefore preserve pair-specific missing-data counts without imputing a
    missing directional-pressure observation as zero.
    """
    valid = np.isfinite(values)
    mask = valid.astype(float)
    clean = np.where(valid, values, 0.0)

    counts = mask.T @ mask
    sum_x = clean.T @ mask
    sum_x2 = (clean * clean).T @ mask
    sum_xy = clean.T @ clean

    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        mean_product = np.divide(
            sum_x * sum_x.T,
            counts,
            out=np.zeros_like(sum_xy),
            where=counts > 0.0,
        )
        covariance = sum_xy - mean_product
        var_x = sum_x2 - np.divide(
            sum_x * sum_x,
            counts,
            out=np.zeros_like(sum_x2),
            where=counts > 0.0,
        )
        var_y = var_x.T
        denominator = np.sqrt(np.maximum(var_x, 0.0) * np.maximum(var_y, 0.0))
        corr = np.divide(
            covariance,
            denominator,
            out=np.full_like(covariance, np.nan),
            where=denominator > 0.0,
        )

    return np.clip(corr, -1.0, 1.0), counts


def _rolling_standard_score(values: pd.DataFrame, window: int = 60) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal rolling z-score requiring forty valid observations."""
    mean = values.rolling(window, min_periods=40).mean()
    deviation = values.rolling(window, min_periods=40).std()
    return (values - mean) / deviation.replace(0.0, np.nan)


@register_factor
class GraphFlowHarmonicDislocation(BaseFactor):
    """Sector-neutral conditional reversal versus stable flow-correlated peers."""

    factor_id = "graph_flow_harmonic_dislocation"
    name = "Liquidity-Conditioned Peer Dislocation"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "Builds a stable positive directional-pressure correlation graph, then "
        "fades standardized return residuals versus graph peers only when the "
        "stock's flow and intrabar-range conditions are ordinary."
    )
    window_length = 180
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].astype(float)
        high = data["high"].astype(float)
        low = data["low"].astype(float)
        volume = data["volume"].astype(float)
        sector = data["sector"]

        index = close.index
        columns = close.columns
        n_rows, n_assets = close.shape
        output = np.zeros((n_rows, n_assets), dtype=float)

        bar_range = high - low
        valid_ohlcv = (
            np.isfinite(close)
            & np.isfinite(high)
            & np.isfinite(low)
            & np.isfinite(volume)
            & (close != 0.0)
            & (high > low)
            & (volume >= 0.0)
        )

        clv = (2.0 * (close - low) / bar_range - 1.0).where(valid_ohlcv)
        pressure = clv * np.log1p(volume.where(volume >= 0.0))
        pressure = pressure.where(valid_ohlcv)
        flow_z = _rolling_standard_score(pressure, 60)

        one_bar_return = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
        one_bar_return = one_bar_return.where(
            np.isfinite(close) & np.isfinite(close.shift(1)) & (close.shift(1) != 0.0)
        )
        return_sd = one_bar_return.rolling(60, min_periods=40).std()
        standardized_return = one_bar_return / return_sd.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        intrabar_range = (bar_range / close).where(valid_ohlcv)
        range_z = _rolling_standard_score(intrabar_range, 60)

        flow_values = flow_z.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        return_values = standardized_return.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        range_values = range_z.to_numpy(dtype=float)

        for t in range(119, n_rows):
            full_corr, full_count = _pairwise_correlation(flow_values[t - 119 : t + 1])
            first_corr, first_count = _pairwise_correlation(flow_values[t - 119 : t - 59])
            second_corr, second_count = _pairwise_correlation(flow_values[t - 59 : t + 1])

            edge_mask = (
                (full_corr >= 0.30)
                & (full_count >= 80.0)
                & (first_corr >= 0.15)
                & (first_count >= 40.0)
                & (second_corr >= 0.15)
                & (second_count >= 40.0)
            )
            weights = np.where(edge_mask, full_corr, 0.0)
            np.fill_diagonal(weights, 0.0)

            current_return = return_values[t]
            return_valid = np.isfinite(current_return)
            peer_count = ((weights > 0.0) @ return_valid.astype(float))
            peer_weight = weights @ return_valid.astype(float)
            peer_return = np.divide(
                weights @ np.where(return_valid, current_return, 0.0),
                peer_weight,
                out=np.full(n_assets, np.nan),
                where=peer_weight > 0.0,
            )

            current_flow = flow_values[t]
            current_range = range_values[t]
            eligible = (
                np.isfinite(current_return)
                & np.isfinite(current_flow)
                & np.isfinite(current_range)
                & np.isfinite(peer_return)
                & (peer_count >= 3.0)
            )
            if not eligible.any():
                continue

            flow_gate = np.clip(
                1.0 - np.maximum(np.abs(current_flow) - 1.0, 0.0) / 2.0,
                0.0,
                1.0,
            )
            range_gate = np.clip(
                1.0 - np.maximum(current_range - 1.0, 0.0) / 2.0,
                0.0,
                1.0,
            )
            raw_signal = -(current_return - peer_return) * flow_gate * range_gate
            eligible &= np.isfinite(raw_signal)
            if not eligible.any():
                continue

            labels = sector.iloc[t].to_numpy()
            groups: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
            for asset_idx, label in enumerate(labels):
                if eligible[asset_idx] and not pd.isna(label):
                    groups.setdefault(str(label), []).append(asset_idx)

            demeaned = np.zeros(n_assets, dtype=float)
            final_eligible = np.zeros(n_assets, dtype=bool)
            for members in groups.values():
                if len(members) < 5:
                    continue
                member_array = np.asarray(members, dtype=int)
                sector_mean = np.mean(raw_signal[member_array])
                demeaned[member_array] = raw_signal[member_array] - sector_mean
                final_eligible[member_array] = True

            gross_exposure = np.sum(np.abs(demeaned[final_eligible]))
            if np.isfinite(gross_exposure) and gross_exposure > 0.0:
                output[t, final_eligible] = demeaned[final_eligible] / gross_exposure

        return pd.DataFrame(output, index=index, columns=columns)
programs.name: Liquidity-Conditioned Peer Dislocation
programs.trading_idea: Temporary liquidity pressure can create short-lived relative-price dislocations among stocks that historically exhibit synchronous directional price-volume behavior. Daily OHLCV cannot identify signed order flow, ETF activity, or informed trading, so the close-location-volume measure is used only as a directional-pressure proxy and as an exclusion filter for likely idiosyncratic events. The hypothesis is therefore conditional residual reversal: a stock's abnormal return versus stable positive-flow peers should revert over the next six bars only when its own directional-pressure and intraday-range proxies are not exceptional.
programs.description: At signal-bar close t, define one-bar return r_i,t = close_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1. Define close location CLV_i,t = 2*(close_i,t-low_i,t)/(high_i,t-low_i,t)-1 when high_i,t>low_i,t and 0 otherwise. Define directional pressure proxy q_i,t = CLV_i,t*log(1+volume_i,t). Standardize q using its trailing 60-bar mean and standard deviation, including t and requiring at least 40 valid observations: x_i,t=(q_i,t-mean60(q_i,t))/sd60(q_i,t). For every pair i,j, compute Pearson correlations of x over the trailing 120 bars through t, requiring at least 80 joint valid observations. Retain a positive graph edge only if the full-window correlation is at least 0.30 and the correlations separately computed over bars t-119 through t-60 and t-59 through t are each at least 0.15, with at least 40 joint observations in each half-window. Edge weight is the full-window correlation; all other weights are zero. Standardize each stock return by its trailing 60-bar return standard deviation through t, requiring 40 observations: y_i,t=r_i,t/sd60(r_i,t). For names with at least three retained peers, calculate peer-implied standardized return p_i,t=sum_j(w_i,j*y_j,t)/sum_j(w_i,j), and residual e_i,t=y_i,t-p_i,t. Define intrabar range a_i,t=(high_i,t-low_i,t)/close_i,t and z_i,t=(a_i,t-mean60(a_i,t))/sd60(a_i,t), again requiring 40 observations. Apply continuous gates gflow_i,t=max(0,1-max(0,abs(x_i,t)-1)/2) and grange_i,t=max(0,1-max(0,z_i,t-1)/2); each is one for ordinary activity, declines linearly above one standard deviation, and is zero at three standard deviations. The raw signal is s_i,t=-e_i,t*gflow_i,t*grange_i,t. Within each sector having at least five eligible names, subtract the same-day sector mean of s. Exclude names with missing inputs, insufficient rolling history, fewer than three graph peers, or an ineligible sector. Normalize the remaining sector-demeaned scores into portfolio weights w_i,t=s_i,t/sum_k(abs(s_k,t)); positive weights are long and negative weights are short. Every statistic, correlation, gate, and peer return uses information available no later than the signal-bar close t; execution may occur no earlier than the next bar.

"""An opening gap that remains substantially unrefilled and closes at the directional end of the daily range is interpreted as evidence that opposing displayed liquidity did not replenish sufficiently during the session. With daily OHLCV data, this is not claimed to identify scheduled institutional execution or auction-specific order flow; it is a reduced-form proxy for persistent directional liquidity imbalance. The prediction is continuation when the imbalance persists over several sessions, while explicitly recognizing that information-driven repricing is an observationally similar alternative explanation."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import indneutralize, rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _gap_imbalance_score(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute the causal daily unrefilled-opening-gap imbalance score."""
    previous_close = close.shift(1)
    valid_prices = (open_ > 0.0) & (previous_close > 0.0)
    gap = np.log((open_ / previous_close).where(valid_prices))
    gap_sign = np.sign(gap)

    intraday_range = high - low
    true_range = np.maximum(
        intraday_range,
        np.maximum((high - previous_close).abs(), (low - previous_close).abs()),
    )
    normalized_true_range = (true_range / previous_close).where(previous_close > 0.0)
    median_normalized_range = normalized_true_range.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
    magnitude = (gap.abs() / median_normalized_range.where(median_normalized_range > 0.0)).clip(
        lower=0.0, upper=3.0
    )

    upward_refill = (open_ - low) / (open_ - previous_close).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    downward_refill = (high - open_) / (previous_close - open_).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    refill = upward_refill.where(gap > 0.0, downward_refill).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

    close_location = (
        2.0 * (close - low) / intraday_range.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
    ).where(intraday_range > 0.0, 0.0)
    retention = (1.0 + gap_sign * close_location) / 2.0

    daily = gap_sign * magnitude * (1.0 - refill) * retention
    nonzero_gap = gap.notna() & gap.ne(0.0)
    daily = daily.where(nonzero_gap)
    daily = daily.mask(gap.eq(0.0), 0.0)
    return daily.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


@register_factor
class OpenGapRefillParticipationClock(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks persistent directional opening gaps whose opposing liquidity did not refill."""

    factor_id = "open_gap_refill_participation_clock"
    name = "Unrefilled Gap Liquidity Persistence"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Cross-sectional sector-neutral rank of the mean three-session signed "
        "opening-gap imbalance score, where large unrefilled gaps closing at "
        "their directional range extreme indicate persistent liquidity imbalance."
    )
    window_length = 22
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        daily_score = _gap_imbalance_score(
            data["open"],
            data["high"],
            data["low"],
            data["close"],
        )
        persistence = daily_score.rolling(3, min_periods=2).mean()
        mapped_rank = 2.0 * rank(persistence) - 1.0
        neutralized = indneutralize(mapped_rank, data["sector"])
        return neutralized.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

Define true range TR_t = max(High_t-Low_t, abs(High_t-Close_{t-1}), abs(Low_t-Close_{t-1})) and normalized gap magnitude m_t = min(abs(g_t) / median(TR_{t-19:t} / Close_{t-1}), 3); if the median denominator is missing or nonpositive, set the daily score to NaN. The factor is the arithmetic mean of valid d_t values over t-2 through t, requiring at least two valid observations; it is then converted to a cross-sectional percentile rank, mapped to [-1,1], and demeaned within sector. Positive factor exposure is long and negative exposure is short. All inputs are observed through Close_t only, and positions may be entered no earlier than t+1.

"""Opening-repair continuation conditioned on phase-markout alignment.

Mechanism: a repaired opening gap can still resume in its original direction when
its recent abnormal-volume/price loop indicates residual markout pressure in that
same direction.  The phase-loop state is used as a directional execution-state
filter rather than as an unconditional continuation signal.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _resilience_score(data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectional balance-sheet resilience using available PIT components."""
    cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    debt_assets = data["debtToAssets"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    operating_cash_flow = data["operatingCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    market_cap = data["marketCap"].replace([0.0, np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    coverage = data["interestCoverage"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    components = [
        cash_ratio.rank(axis=1, pct=True),
        (-debt_assets).rank(axis=1, pct=True),
        (operating_cash_flow / market_cap).rank(axis=1, pct=True),
        coverage.rank(axis=1, pct=True),
    ]
    available = sum(x.notna().astype(float) for x in components)
    total = sum(x.fillna(0.0) for x in components)
    return (total / available.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(available.ge(2.0))


def _phase_markout_state(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal oriented price-volume loop; high values historically denote sell markout."""
    valid = (
        open_.notna()
        & high.notna()
        & low.notna()
        & close.notna()
        & volume.notna()
        & volume.ge(0.0)
    )
    bar_range = high - low
    displacement = ((close - open_) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-2.0, 2.0)
    displacement = displacement.where(valid)
    displacement = displacement.where(~(valid & bar_range.eq(0.0)), 0.0)

    log_volume = np.log1p(volume.where(valid))
    mean = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().shift(1)
    scale = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0).shift(1)
    complete = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).count().shift(1).eq(20)
    volume_surprise = ((log_volume - mean) / scale.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
    volume_surprise = volume_surprise.where(valid & complete)

    increment = (
        displacement.shift(1) * volume_surprise
        - volume_surprise.shift(1) * displacement
    )
    oriented_area = increment.rolling(9, min_periods=9).sum() / 54.0
    endpoint_complete = (
        (displacement.notna() & volume_surprise.notna())
        .rolling(10, min_periods=10)
        .sum()
        .eq(10)
    )
    return (-oriented_area * displacement).where(endpoint_complete)


@register_factor
class OpeningRepairPhaseMarkoutAlignment(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "opening_repair_phase_markout_alignment"
    name = "Opening Repair Phase-Markout Alignment"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks repaired opening gaps whose causal price-volume phase-loop markout "
        "state remains aligned with the original gap direction, with solvency "
        "conditioning for downside versus upside repairs."
    )
    window_length = 30
    inputs = [
        "open",
        "high",
        "low",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "cashRatio",
        "debtToAssets",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "marketCap",
        "interestCoverage",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data["high"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data["low"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        previous_close = close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        gap = open_ / previous_close - 1.0
        intraday_return = close / open_.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        repair = (-intraday_return / gap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        gap_sign = np.sign(gap)

        prior_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        abnormal_volume = volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        participation = abnormal_volume.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

        resilience = _resilience_score(data)
        continuation_weight = pd.DataFrame(
            np.where(gap.lt(0.0), resilience, 1.0 - resilience),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        ).where(gap.ne(0.0))

        phase_markout = _phase_markout_state(open_, high, low, close, volume)
        directional_alignment = -gap_sign * phase_markout
        alignment_gate = directional_alignment.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

        raw = (
            gap_sign
            * gap.abs()
            * repair
            * participation
            * continuation_weight
            * alignment_gate
        )
        valid = (
            gap.notna()
            & repair.notna()
            & participation.notna()
            & resilience.notna()
            & phase_markout.notna()
            & raw.notna()
        )
        percentile = raw.where(valid).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        return (2.0 * percentile - 1.0).where(valid)
programs.name: Opening Repair Phase-Markout Alignment
programs.trading_idea: A repaired opening gap is informative only if the recent price-volume loop implies that the residual markout pressure still points in the original gap direction. The phase-loop parent's negative realized sign is interpreted as a sell-markout state: high loop scores identify price-led/reactive participation that has historically preceded weakness, rather than universally identifying informed buying; conditioning this directional state on the sign of the opening gap distinguishes unfinished execution from a completed liquidity repair. Resilient names with downward repairs are long only when the loop remains sell-aligned, while fragile names with upward repairs are short only when the loop remains buy-aligned; neither the auction repair nor the phase state alone identifies this directionally coherent backlog.
programs.description: Computes a causal abnormal-volume versus intrabar-displacement oriented-area score, interprets it as a directional residual-markout state, and gates signed opening-gap repairs by whether that state aligns with the original gap. The signal additionally scales downside cases by balance-sheet resilience and upside cases by fragility.

programs.code:
"""Daily OHLCV cannot identify dealer inventory management, metaorders, or limit-order cancellations. It can, however, identify a reduced-form state in which directional close-location pressure has repeatedly alternated on unusually active sessions and then transitions into sustained, unusually strong one-sided pressure. The hypothesis is that this state transition contains information beyond generic signed-volume continuation because the signal requires a statistically defined prior alternation regime and a subsequent two-bar directional break, rather than merely a high-pressure high-volume bar.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _abnormal_volume(volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal prior-20-bar median volume multiplier, excluding the current bar."""
    valid_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
    prior_volume = valid_volume.shift(1)
    prior_count = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=1).count()
    prior_median = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=1).median()
    multiplier = volume / prior_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    multiplier = multiplier.where(prior_count >= 15.0)
    return multiplier.clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)


def _alternation_score(pressure: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Compute the specified completed-history alternation score and scale.

    At t, the twelve observations are pressure[t-13] through pressure[t-2].
    The explicit lag construction avoids accidentally including the pair that
    crosses the beginning of the completed-history window.
    """
    nonzero_count = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pressure.index, columns=pressure.columns)
    differing_pairs = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pressure.index, columns=pressure.columns)

    lagged_signs: dict[int, pd.DataFrame] = {}
    lagged_valid: dict[int, pd.DataFrame] = {}
    for lag in range(2, 14):
        observation = pressure.shift(lag)
        valid = np.isfinite(observation) & observation.ne(0.0)
        lagged_signs[lag] = np.sign(observation)
        lagged_valid[lag] = valid
        nonzero_count = nonzero_count + valid.astype(float)

    for lag in range(2, 13):
        pair_valid = lagged_valid[lag] & lagged_valid[lag + 1]
        changed_sign = lagged_signs[lag].ne(lagged_signs[lag + 1])
        differing_pairs = differing_pairs + (pair_valid & changed_sign).astype(float)

    alternation = (differing_pairs / 11.0).where(nonzero_count >= 9.0)
    scale = pressure.abs().shift(2).rolling(12, min_periods=1).median()
    return alternation, scale


def _sector_upper_tercile(
    raw_signal: pd.DataFrame,
    impulse: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Keep upper-tercile eligible impulses within sectors of at least five names."""
    sector_labels = sector.iloc[0].reindex(raw_signal.columns)
    eligible_impulse = impulse.where(raw_signal.ne(0.0))
    grouped = eligible_impulse.T.groupby(sector_labels, sort=False)
    within_sector_rank = grouped.rank(pct=True).T
    sector_count = grouped.count().T

    retain = (
        raw_signal.ne(0.0)
        & sector_count.ge(5.0)
        & within_sector_rank.ge(2.0 / 3.0)
    )
    return raw_signal.where(retain, 0.0).fillna(0.0).astype(float)


@register_factor
class AlternatingInventoryResonanceEscape(BaseFactor):
    """Detects a high-volume break from a completed alternating-pressure regime."""

    factor_id = "alternating_inventory_resonance_escape"
    name = "Alternation-Break Pressure"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Long or short directional close-location pressure only after a statistically "
        "defined alternating active-session regime breaks into a strengthening two-bar "
        "one-sided impulse; retain only upper-tercile impulse magnitudes within sectors."
    )
    window_length = 34
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        price_range = high - low
        valid_range = price_range > 0.0
        valid_volume = volume.notna() & volume.gt(0.0)
        close_location = 2.0 * (close - low) / price_range.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        clp = (close_location * volume).where(valid_range & valid_volume, 0.0)

        abnormal_volume = _abnormal_volume(volume)
        pressure = clp * abnormal_volume.clip(upper=3.0)
        alternation, scale = _alternation_score(pressure)

        previous_pressure = pressure.shift(1)
        current_nonzero = np.isfinite(pressure) & pressure.ne(0.0)
        previous_nonzero = np.isfinite(previous_pressure) & previous_pressure.ne(0.0)
        same_direction = (
            current_nonzero
            & previous_nonzero
            & np.sign(pressure).eq(np.sign(previous_pressure))
        )

        valid_scale = np.isfinite(scale) & scale.gt(0.0)
        strengthening = pressure.abs().gt(previous_pressure.abs())
        large_impulse = pressure.abs().ge(2.0 * scale)
        active_session = abnormal_volume.ge(1.25)

        signal_condition = (
            alternation.ge(0.70)
            & same_direction
            & valid_scale
            & large_impulse
            & active_session
            & strengthening
        )
        raw_signal = np.sign(pressure).where(signal_condition, 0.0).fillna(0.0)
        impulse = (pressure.abs() / scale.replace(0.0, np.nan)).replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
        )

        return _sector_upper_tercile(raw_signal, impulse, data["sector"])
programs.name: Alternation-Break Pressure
programs.trading_idea: Daily OHLCV cannot identify dealer inventory management, metaorders, or limit-order cancellations. It can, however, identify a reduced-form state in which directional close-location pressure has repeatedly alternated on unusually active sessions and then transitions into sustained, unusually strong one-sided pressure. The hypothesis is that this state transition contains information beyond generic signed-volume continuation because the signal requires a statistically defined prior alternation regime and a subsequent two-bar directional break, rather than merely a high-pressure high-volume bar.
programs.description: At the close of bar t, define close-location pressure CLP_t = 0 when high_t <= low_t or volume_t is missing/nonpositive; otherwise CLP_t = [2*(close_t-low_t)/(high_t-low_t)-1] * volume_t. Define trailing abnormal-volume multiplier AV_t = volume_t / median(volume_{t-20},...,volume_{t-1}); set AV_t to NaN if fewer than 15 valid prior volumes exist, and clip AV_t to [0,5]. Define signed pressure P_t = CLP_t * min(AV_t,3). All quantities use only bars through t, with the volume baseline excluding bar t. For each ticker, using the 12 completed pressure observations P_{t-13},...,P_{t-2}, define the alternation score A_t as the fraction of the 11 adjacent pairs whose nonzero signs differ, provided at least 9 of the 12 pressures are nonzero and finite; otherwise A_t is NaN. Define the prior-regime scale S_t as the median absolute value of P_{t-13},...,P_{t-2}, requiring S_t > 0. A directional break is present only when: (1) A_t >= 0.70; (2) P_{t-1} and P_t have the same nonzero sign; (3) abs(P_t) >= 2*S_t; (4) AV_t >= 1.25; and (5) abs(P_t) > abs(P_{t-1}). The raw signal is sign(P_t) when all conditions hold and zero otherwise. At each signal-bar close, rank raw nonzero signals cross-sectionally by signed impulse magnitude abs(P_t)/S_t separately within sector, requiring at least five eligible names in that sector; retain only the upper tercile of magnitude and set all other signals to zero. The factor score is the retained sign, with a portfolio formed after the signal bar close using the next tradable bar and evaluated against the forward six-bar return; no forward return enters any feature or selection rule.

"""This is a nonlinear causal OHLCV feature rather than a confirmed identifier of informed execution. It tests whether the recent ordering of abnormal trading activity and directional close-location contains information beyond contemporaneous price movement: a volume-first, then directional-price sequence may reflect temporary liquidity depletion or gradual absorption, while the opposite ordering may be more consistent with reactive volume after a move. The fixed orientation convention is a falsifiable directional hypothesis; its incremental predictive value versus return, close location, range, and volume-surprise controls, as well as its net value after costs, must be established empirically."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _phase_score(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute the causal completed-window price-volume oriented-area score."""
    valid = (
        open_.notna()
        & high.notna()
        & low.notna()
        & close.notna()
        & volume.notna()
        & volume.ge(0.0)
    )

    bar_range = high - low
    displacement = (close - open_) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    displacement = displacement.where(valid)
    displacement = displacement.where(~(valid & bar_range.eq(0.0)), 0.0)

    log_volume = np.log1p(volume.where(valid))
    baseline_mean = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().shift(1)
    baseline_std = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0).shift(1)
    baseline_complete = log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).count().shift(1).eq(20)

    abnormal_volume = (log_volume - baseline_mean) / baseline_std
    abnormal_volume = abnormal_volume.where(baseline_std.ne(0.0), 0.0)
    abnormal_volume = abnormal_volume.where(valid & baseline_complete).clip(-3.0, 3.0)

    endpoint_complete = (
        (displacement.notna() & abnormal_volume.notna())
        .rolling(10, min_periods=10)
        .sum()
        .eq(10)
    )

    oriented_increment = (
        displacement.shift(1) * abnormal_volume
        - abnormal_volume.shift(1) * displacement
    )
    oriented_area = oriented_increment.rolling(9, min_periods=9).sum() / 54.0
    return (-oriented_area * displacement).where(endpoint_complete)


def _sector_percentile_score(
    score: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Rank eligible scores within each date's nonmissing sector groups."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=score.index, columns=score.columns, dtype=float)

    for timestamp in score.index:
        score_row = score.loc[timestamp]
        sector_row = sector.loc[timestamp]
        eligible = score_row.notna() & np.isfinite(score_row) & sector_row.notna()
        eligible_scores = score_row.loc[eligible]
        eligible_sectors = sector_row.loc[eligible]

        for _, group_scores in eligible_scores.groupby(eligible_sectors, sort=False):
            group_size = len(group_scores)
            if group_size < 5:
                continue
            average_rank = group_scores.rank(method="average")
            output.loc[timestamp, group_scores.index] = (
                2.0 * (average_rank - 1.0) / (group_size - 1.0) - 1.0
            )

    return output


@register_factor
class CausalPriceVolumePhaseScore(BaseFactor):
    """Sector-relative causal price-volume phase-loop participation score."""

    factor_id = "phase_loop_participation_lead_markout"
    name = "Causal Price-Volume Phase Score"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Uses a completed ten-bar price-displacement and abnormal-log-volume "
        "path to measure oriented phase-loop participation, then ranks the "
        "bounded directional score within sectors with at least five eligible names."
    )
    window_length = 30
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        raw_score = _phase_score(
            data["open"],
            data["high"],
            data["low"],
            data["close"],
            data["volume"],
        )
        return _sector_percentile_score(raw_score, data["sector"])

programs.description: At the close of bar t, define signed displacement d_i=(close_i-open_i)/(high_i-low_i) for each ticker and bar i; if high_i=low_i, set d_i=0. A bar is invalid if any OHLC value is missing or if volume is missing or negative. Define l_i=log(1+volume_i). For each i, compute abnormal log-volume z_i=(l_i-m_i)/s_i, where m_i and s_i are respectively the arithmetic mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) of l over the 20 immediately preceding valid daily bars i-20 through i-1; the current bar is never included in its own baseline. If any of those 20 observations is invalid, z_i is unavailable; if s_i=0, set z_i=0. Clip available z_i to [-3,3], with zero volume treated as valid and therefore l_i=0. Use the completed 10-bar endpoint window t-9 through t, requiring valid d_i and z_i for every bar in that window. Compute the normalized oriented area A_t=[sum from i=t-8 to t of (d_{i-1}*z_i-z_{i-1}*d_i)]/(9*6). The denominator 9*6 is fixed: there are nine transitions and each cross-product difference is bounded by 6 because d is in [-1,1] and clipped z is in [-3,3]. Define the raw directional score q_t=-A_t*d_t; no additional winsorization is applied because q_t is bounded in [-1,1]. The negative sign is fixed by convention: under coordinates (d,z), a clockwise transition has negative A, and multiplying by -A aligns that orientation with the current displacement. At each t, rank q_t only among eligible tickers sharing the same nonmissing static sector label, requiring at least five eligible tickers in that sector; use average ranks for ties and transform the percentile rank to 2*(rank-1)/(N-1)-1. Sectors with fewer than five eligible names and ineligible names receive no signal. Compute the signal only after the close of t and enter no earlier than the open of t+1; do not use the t close as an executable entry price.

programs.code:
"""This is a reduced-form test of whether an isolated negative opening dislocation that is substantially reversed during the same completed daily session predicts short-horizon continuation of that reversal. Daily OHLCV cannot identify auction-seller exhaustion, informed flow, or liquidity-provider inventory, so the factor makes no such attribution: it treats the pattern as observable evidence of temporary opening price pressure relative to sector peers. Elevated participation is used as a confirmation that the reversal occurred in an actively traded session rather than as proof of a particular counterparty mechanism."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _positive_finite(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Keep only finite, strictly positive numeric observations."""
    return df.where(np.isfinite(df) & df.gt(0.0))


def _sector_gap_median(
    gap: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return date-wise sector median gaps only for sectors with five names."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=gap.index, columns=gap.columns)
    labels = pd.unique(sector.to_numpy().ravel())

    for label in labels:
        if pd.isna(label):
            continue

        constituent = sector.eq(label)
        valid = constituent & gap.notna()
        usable_date = valid.sum(axis=1).ge(5)
        target = constituent & usable_date.to_numpy()[:, None]

        median = gap.where(valid).median(axis=1)
        median_panel = pd.DataFrame(
            np.broadcast_to(median.to_numpy()[:, None], gap.shape),
            index=gap.index,
            columns=gap.columns,
        )
        result = result.where(~target, median_panel)

    return result


def _cross_sectional_winsorized_rank(score: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Winsorize eligible scores by date and average-rank only broad universes."""
    eligible_count = score.notna().sum(axis=1)
    lower = score.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = score.quantile(0.99, axis=1)

    winsorized = score.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)
    ranked = winsorized.rank(axis=1, method="average", pct=True, ascending=True)
    return ranked.where(eligible_count.ge(20), np.nan)


@register_factor
class IdioOpeningSellRejectionRecovery(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks active idiosyncratic opening selloffs rejected by the close."""

    factor_id = "idio_opening_sell_rejection_recovery"
    name = "Idiosyncratic Gap-Rejection Reversal"
    category = "mean_reversion"
    description = (
        "Cross-sectional percentile rank of a negative sector-adjusted opening "
        "gap that reverses strongly into the close on elevated volume, using only "
        "completed daily-bar information."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"]

        prior_close = close.shift(1)

        safe_open = _positive_finite(open_)
        safe_high = _positive_finite(high)
        safe_low = _positive_finite(low)
        safe_close = _positive_finite(close)
        safe_volume = _positive_finite(volume)
        safe_prior_close = _positive_finite(prior_close)

        gap = (safe_open / safe_prior_close - 1.0).replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
        )
        sector_gap = _sector_gap_median(gap, sector)
        idiosyncratic_gap = gap - sector_gap

        historical_range = ((safe_high - safe_low) / safe_prior_close).where(
            safe_high.ge(safe_low)
        )
        historical_range = historical_range.where(historical_range.gt(0.0))
        historical_range = historical_range.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        sigma_range = historical_range.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median().shift(1)
        vol_base = safe_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median().shift(1)

        bar_range = safe_high - safe_low
        valid_current_geometry = (
            safe_high.ge(safe_open)
            & safe_high.ge(safe_close)
            & safe_low.le(safe_open)
            & safe_low.le(safe_close)
            & bar_range.gt(0.0)
        )

        current_valid = (
            safe_open.notna()
            & safe_high.notna()
            & safe_low.notna()
            & safe_close.notna()
            & safe_volume.notna()
            & safe_prior_close.notna()
            & valid_current_geometry
            & idiosyncratic_gap.notna()
            & sigma_range.gt(0.0)
            & vol_base.gt(0.0)
        )

        dislocation = (-idiosyncratic_gap / sigma_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)
        reversal = ((safe_close - safe_open) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        near_high = ((safe_close - safe_low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        participation = (safe_volume / vol_base - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=4.0)

        raw_score = (dislocation * reversal * near_high * participation).where(
            current_valid
        )
        raw_score = raw_score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        return _cross_sectional_winsorized_rank(raw_score)

Daily OHLCV cannot identify auction-seller exhaustion, informed flow, or liquidity-provider inventory, so the factor makes no such attribution: it treats the pattern as observable evidence of temporary opening price pressure relative to sector peers. programs.description: At the close of daily bar t, define the stock gap g_i,t = open_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1, using the immediately preceding available daily close. The sector gap G_s,t is the equal-weight cross-sectional median of g_i,t among all configured ticker columns with a nonmissing positive prior close and positive open, and with the same nonmissing static sector label s; a sector observation is usable only when at least five such constituents exist. Define the idiosyncratic gap e_i,t = g_i,t - G_s,t. For each stock, define prior daily relative range r_i,u = (high_i,u - low_i,u) / close_i,u-1 and require 20 valid, strictly positive observations from u=t-20 through t-1; set sigmaRange_i,t to their median. Require 20 valid, strictly positive daily volumes over the same t-20 through t-1 window and set volBase_i,t to their median. The completed-day measures are D_i,t = clip((-e_i,t / sigmaRange_i,t), 0, 5), R_i,t = clip((close_i,t - open_i,t) / (high_i,t - low_i,t), 0, 1), N_i,t = clip((close_i,t - low_i,t) / (high_i,t - low_i,t), 0, 1), and A_i,t = clip((volume_i,t / volBase_i,t) - 1, 0, 4). The raw score is S_i,t = D_i,t * R_i,t * N_i,t * A_i,t. A stock is ineligible, and receives NaN rather than an imputed score, if any required current or historical input is missing or nonpositive, if high < max(open, close), if low > min(open, close), if high equals low, if sigmaRange or volBase is nonpositive, or if its sector lacks five valid gap observations. Thus zero-range bars, including bars that may be mechanically locked or limit-like, are excluded; the feed has no limit-status field, so nonzero-range bars are not otherwise classified as limit bars. On each date with at least 20 eligible stocks, winsorize S cross-sectionally at its 1st and 99th percentiles and convert it to an ascending percentile rank using average ranks for ties; this percentile rank is the factor value, with higher values predicting higher returns. The score is computed only after bar t has fully closed. It is entered no earlier than the next executable daily bar's open, t+1, and the six-bar forecast/holding return is measured from the t+1 open to the t+7 open; a name without a tradable next open is not entered.

programs.code:
"""Solvency-conditioned opening repair under liquidity-elasticity exhaustion.

Mechanism: a repair-side close following an opening gap can be a temporary
inventory-transfer event rather than information assimilation when range rises
as relative volume falls and the same bar edge is repeatedly reached. Solvency
separates non-distress downside repairs from genuinely adverse financing news,
while fragile firms' repaired upside gaps are more susceptible to withdrawal of
short-covering or thin-book support.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _winsorize_cross_section(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causality-neutral, per-date clipping of extreme panel observations."""
    clean = df.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    lower = clean.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = clean.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    return clean.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)

def _resilience(data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Available-component cross-sectional balance-sheet resilience score."""
    cash_ratio = data['cashRatio'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    debt_assets = data['debtToAssets'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    operating_cf = data['operatingCashFlow'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    market_cap = data['marketCap'].replace([0.0, np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    coverage = data['interestCoverage'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    components = [cash_ratio.rank(axis=1, pct=True), (-debt_assets).rank(axis=1, pct=True), (operating_cf / market_cap).rank(axis=1, pct=True), coverage.rank(axis=1, pct=True)]
    total = sum((component.fillna(0.0) for component in components))
    count = sum((component.notna().astype(float) for component in components))
    composite = total / count.where(count >= 2.0)
    return composite.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

def _inverse_range_volume_elasticity(log_volume: pd.DataFrame, log_range: pd.DataFrame, lookback: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Trailing OLS inverse elasticity, -Cov(log range, log volume)/Var(log volume)."""
    covariance = log_volume.rolling(lookback, min_periods=lookback).cov(log_range)
    variance = log_volume.rolling(lookback, min_periods=lookback).var()
    return -covariance / variance.replace(0.0, np.nan)

@register_factor
class SolvencyConditionedGapRepairElasticityExhaustion(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = 'solvency_conditioned_gap_repair_elasticity_exhau'
    name = 'Solvency-Gated Repair Exhaustion'
    category = 'microstructure'
    description = 'Asymmetric solvency-weighted opening-gap repair, activated only when accelerating inverse range-volume elasticity and repeated repair-side edge closes indicate a depleted-liquidity execution climax.'
    window_length = 45
    inputs = ['open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume', 'cashRatio', 'debtToAssets', 'operatingCashFlow', 'marketCap', 'interestCoverage']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_price = data['open'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data['high'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data['low'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        close = data['close'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data['volume'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        previous_close = close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        safe_open = open_price.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        gap = open_price / previous_close - 1.0
        intraday_return = close / safe_open - 1.0
        repair_fraction = (-intraday_return / gap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        prior_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0).shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        abnormal_volume = volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        volume_rank = _winsorize_cross_section(abnormal_volume).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        normalized_range = (high - low) / previous_close
        positive_range = normalized_range.where(normalized_range > 0.0)
        range_baseline = positive_range.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        range_ratio = normalized_range / range_baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        volume_ratio = volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        log_volume = np.log(volume_ratio.where(volume_ratio > 0.0))
        log_range = np.log(range_ratio.where(range_ratio > 0.0))
        elasticity = _inverse_range_volume_elasticity(log_volume, log_range, 20)
        acceleration = elasticity - elasticity.shift(5)
        elasticity_state = acceleration.where((elasticity > 0.0) & (acceleration > 0.0))
        elasticity_rank = elasticity_state.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        bar_range = high - low
        close_location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range).where(bar_range > 0.0)
        edge_direction = np.sign(close_location.where(close_location.abs() >= 0.8, 0.0)).fillna(0.0)
        repair_direction = (-np.sign(gap)).where(gap.ne(0.0), 0.0)
        repeated_repair_edge = edge_direction.ne(0.0) & edge_direction.eq(edge_direction.shift(1)) & edge_direction.eq(edge_direction.shift(2)) & edge_direction.eq(repair_direction)
        resilience = _resilience(data)
        solvency_weight = pd.DataFrame(np.where(gap.to_numpy() < 0.0, resilience.to_numpy(), 1.0 - resilience.to_numpy()), index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        directional_repair = -np.sign(gap) * _winsorize_cross_section(gap).abs()
        valid = gap.ne(0.0) & repair_fraction.notna() & volume_rank.notna() & resilience.notna() & elasticity_rank.notna() & repeated_repair_edge
        raw = (directional_repair * repair_fraction * volume_rank * solvency_weight * elasticity_rank).where(valid)
        percentile = raw.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        return (2.0 * percentile - 1.0).where(valid, 0.0).astype(float)
