"""The hypothesis is that positive EPS-consensus revisions are more likely to continue to outperform when the contemporaneously available quarterly filing shows that operating cash generation is improving and working-capital demands are easing. The proposed counterparty is revision-oriented capital that reacts to the directional consensus change but does not fully condition its position on the filing-based cash-conversion evidence. This revision deliberately does not rely on an assumed delayed interpretation of an event-day price reaction; it tests the narrower, cross-sectional proposition that cash-backed upgrades have better six-day outcomes than equally sized upgrades with deteriorating cash conversion."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _clean_numeric(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Remove non-finite observations without converting genuine missing data."""
    return df.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _cross_sectional_winsor_zscore(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Same-date 1/99 percentile winsorization followed by population z-score."""
    clean = _clean_numeric(df)
    lower = clean.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = clean.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    clipped = clean.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)
    mean = clipped.mean(axis=1)
    std = clipped.std(axis=1, ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return clipped.sub(mean, axis=0).div(std, axis=0)


def _revenue_update_mask(revenue: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Mark new quarterly revenue observations relative to the prior available value."""
    revenue = _clean_numeric(revenue)
    prior_available = revenue.ffill().shift(1)
    return revenue.notna() & (prior_available.isna() | revenue.ne(prior_available))


def _previous_update_value(values: pd.DataFrame, updates: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Value at the preceding revenue-update date, available causally at t."""
    return _clean_numeric(values).where(updates).ffill().shift(1)


@register_factor
class CashConversionRevisionCredibilityGap(BaseFactor):
    """EPS upgrades weighted by contemporaneous cash-conversion improvement."""

    factor_id = "cash_conversion_revision_credibility_gap"
    name = "Cash-Backed EPS Upgrade"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "At newly available revenue-report dates, multiplies the positive part "
        "of a 21-bar EPS-consensus revision z-score by a cross-sectional "
        "cash-conversion credibility score based on operating-cash-flow margin, "
        "receivables intensity, inventory intensity, and cash-conversion-cycle "
        "changes from the preceding revenue update."
    )
    window_length = 252
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenue",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "receivables",
        "inventory",
        "cashConversionCycle",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        template = data["close"]
        eps_estimate = _clean_numeric(data["epsEstimate"])
        revenue = _clean_numeric(data["revenue"])
        operating_cash_flow = _clean_numeric(data["operatingCashFlow"])
        receivables = _clean_numeric(data["receivables"])
        inventory = _clean_numeric(data["inventory"])
        cash_conversion_cycle = _clean_numeric(data["cashConversionCycle"])

        prior_eps_estimate = eps_estimate.shift(21)
        eps_denominator = prior_eps_estimate.abs().clip(lower=0.01)
        eps_revision = (eps_estimate - prior_eps_estimate) / eps_denominator
        eps_revision = eps_revision.where(
            eps_estimate.notna() & prior_eps_estimate.notna()
        )
        eps_zscore = _cross_sectional_winsor_zscore(eps_revision)
        upgrade = eps_zscore.clip(lower=0.0)

        revenue_updates = _revenue_update_mask(revenue)
        previous_revenue = _previous_update_value(revenue, revenue_updates)
        previous_ocf = _previous_update_value(operating_cash_flow, revenue_updates)
        previous_receivables = _previous_update_value(receivables, revenue_updates)
        previous_inventory = _previous_update_value(inventory, revenue_updates)
        previous_ccc = _previous_update_value(cash_conversion_cycle, revenue_updates)

        ocf_margin = operating_cash_flow / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        previous_ocf_margin = previous_ocf / previous_revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        receivables_intensity = receivables / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        previous_receivables_intensity = previous_receivables / previous_revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        inventory_intensity = inventory / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        previous_inventory_intensity = previous_inventory / previous_revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        complete_cash_data = (
            revenue_updates
            & revenue.gt(0.0)
            & previous_revenue.gt(0.0)
            & operating_cash_flow.notna()
            & previous_ocf.notna()
            & receivables.notna()
            & previous_receivables.notna()
            & inventory.notna()
            & previous_inventory.notna()
            & cash_conversion_cycle.notna()
            & previous_ccc.notna()
        )

        delta_ocf_margin = (ocf_margin - previous_ocf_margin).where(complete_cash_data)
        delta_receivables = (receivables_intensity - previous_receivables_intensity).where(
            complete_cash_data
        )
        delta_inventory = (inventory_intensity - previous_inventory_intensity).where(
            complete_cash_data
        )
        delta_ccc = (cash_conversion_cycle - previous_ccc).where(complete_cash_data)

        z_ocf_margin = _cross_sectional_winsor_zscore(delta_ocf_margin)
        z_receivables = _cross_sectional_winsor_zscore(delta_receivables)
        z_inventory = _cross_sectional_winsor_zscore(delta_inventory)
        z_ccc = _cross_sectional_winsor_zscore(delta_ccc)

        quality = (
            0.40 * z_ocf_margin
            - 0.20 * z_receivables
            - 0.20 * z_inventory
            - 0.20 * z_ccc
        )
        valid_signal = complete_cash_data & upgrade.notna() & quality.notna()
        signal = (upgrade * quality).where(valid_signal, 0.0)

        return _clean_numeric(signal).fillna(0.0).reindex_like(template)
programs.name: Cash-Backed EPS Upgrade
programs.trading_idea: The hypothesis is that positive EPS-consensus revisions are more likely to continue to outperform when the contemporaneously available quarterly filing shows that operating cash generation is improving and working-capital demands are easing. The proposed counterparty is revision-oriented capital that reacts to the directional consensus change but does not fully condition its position on the filing-based cash-conversion evidence. This revision deliberately does not rely on an assumed delayed interpretation of an event-day price reaction; it tests the narrower, cross-sectional proposition that cash-backed upgrades have better six-day outcomes than equally sized upgrades with deteriorating cash conversion.
programs.description: Signal formation occurs only on a date t at which point-in-time revenue changes from its prior available value, identifying a newly available quarterly-report observation. All inputs are read at the close of t and are therefore public by that timestamp. Define the EPS revision as rEPS_t = (epsEstimate_t - epsEstimate_{t-21}) / max(abs(epsEstimate_{t-21}), 0.01), using the latest-quarter EPS consensus available at each date; set it missing unless both observations exist. Winsorize rEPS_t cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles and standardize it to zEPS_t using the same-date cross-sectional mean and standard deviation. Define U_t = max(zEPS_t, 0), so the hypothesis is explicitly restricted to upgrades rather than imposing an unsupported symmetric interpretation for downgrades. At each revenue-update date, calculate changes from the preceding revenue-update date: dOCFM = (operatingCashFlow/revenue)_t - (operatingCashFlow/revenue)_prev; dREC = (receivables/revenue)_t - (receivables/revenue)_prev; dINV = (inventory/revenue)_t - (inventory/revenue)_prev; and dCCC = cashConversionCycle_t - cashConversionCycle_prev. Require positive revenue at both dates and non-missing values for every component. Winsorize each change cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles and convert each to a same-date cross-sectional z-score. The pre-committed cash-conversion credibility score is Q_t = 0.40*z(dOCFM) - 0.20*z(dREC) - 0.20*z(dINV) - 0.20*z(dCCC): improving operating-cash-flow margin is favorable, while rising receivables intensity, inventory intensity, and cash-conversion-cycle days are unfavorable. The final factor is S_t = U_t * Q_t. Higher S_t means a positive EPS revision accompanied by better cash conversion; negative S_t identifies an EPS upgrade paired with deteriorating cash conversion. No contemporaneous-price-reaction, volatility-normalization, or post-event return is included, eliminating same-close execution ambiguity and accidental short-term reversal exposure. Form the signal after the close of t, execute no earlier than the next tradable bar's open, and measure the six-bar return from that execution through the close of the sixth subsequent daily bar. Evaluation must test S_t incrementally versus standalone EPS revision, standalone cash-conversion score, and their additive combination, with transaction-cost and earnings-event liquidity controls.

programs.code:
"""A sector-wide correlation jump can arise when common de-risking or basket-flow trading temporarily dominates firm-specific price discovery. The strategy does not assume that all low-quality stocks should fall or that quality has a fixed market-beta sign; instead, within a triggered sector it buys liquid, fundamentally resilient stocks whose five-day return has lagged an equal-weighted leave-one-out sector peer basket. The expected positive payoff is a sector-relative normalization after the common-flow episode, rather than an unconditional quality or short-term-reversal premium."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _leave_one_out_correlations(window: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Return each column's correlation with its leave-one-out peer basket."""
    n_obs, n_names = window.shape
    if n_obs < 2 or n_names < 2:
        return np.full(n_names, np.nan)

    peer = (window.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) - window) / float(n_names - 1)
    x = window - window.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    y = peer - peer.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    denom = np.sqrt((x * x).sum(axis=0) * (y * y).sum(axis=0))
    numer = (x * y).sum(axis=0)
    return np.divide(numer, denom, out=np.full(n_names, np.nan), where=denom > 0.0)


def _sector_correlation_history(history: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, float]:
    """Compute current member-wise correlations, current median, and 120-day baseline.

    The supplied 139 return observations are trailing and membership is held
    fixed at the current date, matching the pre-registered construction.
    """
    n_names = history.shape[1]
    current = _leave_one_out_correlations(history[-20:, :])
    medians = np.full(120, np.nan)

    # Endpoints are t-119 through t.  Each uses its own trailing 20-bar window,
    # but always the sector membership known at t.
    for j, endpoint in enumerate(range(19, 139)):
        corr = _leave_one_out_correlations(history[endpoint - 19 : endpoint + 1, :])
        medians[j] = np.nanmedian(corr) if np.isfinite(corr).any() else np.nan

    current_median = np.nanmedian(current) if np.isfinite(current).any() else np.nan
    baseline = np.nanmean(medians) if np.isfinite(medians).any() else np.nan
    return current, current_median, baseline


def _winsorized_values(values: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Contemporaneously winsorize a valid eligible-universe cross section."""
    if values.empty:
        return values
    lower = values.quantile(0.05)
    upper = values.quantile(0.95)
    return values.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper)


@register_factor
class CorrelationSqueezeQualityReemergence(BaseFactor):
    """Long-only sector-relative normalization after correlation squeezes."""

    factor_id = "correlation_squeeze_quality_reemergence"
    name = "Pre-Registered Correlation Squeeze Reversion"
    category = "mean_reversion"
    description = (
        "Sector-balanced long-only positions in high-quality liquid names that "
        "lagged their leave-one-out sector basket during a sector correlation squeeze."
    )
    window_length = 140
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "sector",
        "marketCap",
        "incomeQuality",
        "freeCashFlowYield",
        "interestCoverage",
        "debtToEquity",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        sector = data["sector"]
        market_cap = data["marketCap"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        income_quality = data["incomeQuality"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        fcf_yield = data["freeCashFlowYield"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        interest_coverage = data["interestCoverage"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        debt_to_equity = data["debtToEquity"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        output = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        safe_close = close.where(close > 0.0)
        log_return = np.log(safe_close / safe_close.shift(1))
        history_complete = (
            log_return.notna().rolling(139, min_periods=139).sum().eq(139)
        )
        dollar_volume = safe_close * volume.where(volume >= 0.0)
        median_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()

        metric_frames = [income_quality, fcf_yield, interest_coverage, debt_to_equity]
        metric_valid = pd.DataFrame(True, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        for frame in metric_frames:
            metric_valid &= frame.notna()

        eligible = (
            sector.notna()
            & (market_cap >= 1_000_000_000.0)
            & (safe_close >= 5.0)
            & metric_valid
            & (median_dollar_volume >= 5_000_000.0)
            & history_complete
        )

        columns = list(close.columns)
        reference_portfolio = 100_000_000.0

        for row_pos in range(138, len(close.index)):
            eligible_row = eligible.iloc[row_pos]
            tickers = list(eligible_row.index[eligible_row.to_numpy(dtype=bool)])
            if len(tickers) < 10:
                continue

            sector_row = sector.iloc[row_pos]
            groups: dict[str, list[object]] = {}
            for ticker in tickers:
                label = sector_row.loc[ticker]
                if pd.notna(label):
                    groups.setdefault(str(label), []).append(ticker)

            active_sectors: list[tuple[list[object], pd.Series]] = []
            quality_universe = tickers

            iq = _winsorized_values(income_quality.iloc[row_pos].loc[quality_universe])
            fy = _winsorized_values(fcf_yield.iloc[row_pos].loc[quality_universe])
            ic = _winsorized_values(interest_coverage.iloc[row_pos].loc[quality_universe])
            de = _winsorized_values(debt_to_equity.iloc[row_pos].loc[quality_universe])

            for members in groups.values():
                if len(members) < 10:
                    continue

                history = log_return.iloc[row_pos - 138 : row_pos + 1].loc[:, members].to_numpy(dtype=float)
                if history.shape != (139, len(members)) or not np.isfinite(history).all():
                    continue

                _, current_corr, baseline_corr = _sector_correlation_history(history)
                if not (
                    np.isfinite(current_corr)
                    and np.isfinite(baseline_corr)
                    and current_corr >= 0.50
                    and (current_corr - baseline_corr) >= 0.20
                ):
                    continue

                q_iq = iq.loc[members].rank(pct=True)
                q_fy = fy.loc[members].rank(pct=True)
                q_ic = ic.loc[members].rank(pct=True)
                q_de = de.loc[members].rank(ascending=False, pct=True)
                quality = (q_iq + q_fy + q_ic + q_de) / 4.0

                five_day = history[-5:, :]
                peer_five_day = (five_day.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) - five_day) / float(len(members) - 1)
                residual = five_day.sum(axis=0) - peer_five_day.sum(axis=0)
                lag_score = pd.Series(-residual, index=members).rank(pct=True)
                score = 0.5 * quality + 0.5 * lag_score
                active_sectors.append((members, score))

            if not active_sectors:
                continue

            sector_capital_weight = 1.0 / float(len(active_sectors))
            for members, score in active_sectors:
                n_select = max(2, int(np.floor(0.20 * len(members))))
                ordered = sorted(
                    members,
                    key=lambda ticker: (-float(score.loc[ticker]), str(ticker)),
                )
                selected = ordered[:n_select]
                initial_weight = sector_capital_weight / float(len(selected))

                for ticker in selected:
                    adv_limit = (
                        0.01 * float(median_dollar_volume.iloc[row_pos].loc[ticker])
                        / reference_portfolio
                    )
                    if np.isfinite(adv_limit) and adv_limit > 0.0:
                        output.iloc[row_pos, output.columns.get_loc(ticker)] = min(
                            initial_weight, adv_limit
                        )

        return output
programs.name: Pre-Registered Correlation Squeeze Reversion
programs.trading_idea: A sector-wide correlation jump can arise when common de-risking or basket-flow trading temporarily dominates firm-specific price discovery. The strategy does not assume that all low-quality stocks should fall or that quality has a fixed market-beta sign; instead, within a triggered sector it buys liquid, fundamentally resilient stocks whose five-day return has lagged an equal-weighted leave-one-out sector peer basket. The expected positive payoff is a sector-relative normalization after the common-flow episode, rather than an unconditional quality or short-term-reversal premium.
programs.description: At each close t, form the eligible universe using only point-in-time fields available at t: non-null sector, marketCap >= USD 1 billion, close >= USD 5, non-null incomeQuality/freeCashFlowYield/interestCoverage/debtToEquity, and median(close*volume) over t-19 through t >= USD 5 million. Retain only sectors with at least 10 eligible names and with complete daily close-return history for the prior 139 bars. Define daily log return r_i,u = log(close_i,u / close_i,u-1). For each eligible stock i in sector s, calculate its leave-one-out peer return on each day as the equal-weighted return of all other eligible sector members. Compute rho_i,s,t as the Pearson correlation of r_i and its leave-one-out peer return over the fixed 20-bar window t-19 through t; sector correlation C_s,t is the cross-sectional median of rho_i,s,t. Define the fixed slow baseline B_s,t as the arithmetic mean of C_s,t-j for j=0,...,119, calculated using the same current eligible sector membership and each respective trailing 20-bar return window. A sector is triggered only when C_s,t >= 0.50 and C_s,t - B_s,t >= 0.20. For every eligible name, winsorize each of incomeQuality, freeCashFlowYield, interestCoverage, and debtToEquity at the contemporaneous 5th and 95th percentiles of the full eligible universe. Within each sector, convert the first three winsorized metrics to percentile ranks, convert debtToEquity to its inverse percentile rank, and define quality Q_i,t as their equal-weighted average. Define the five-bar leave-one-out residual return R_i,t as the sum from t-4 through t of stock log returns minus the corresponding sum of leave-one-out peer returns. Within each triggered sector, convert -R_i,t to a percentile rank L_i,t and define score S_i,t = 0.5*Q_i,t + 0.5*L_i,t. Buy the top floor(20% of names) by S in each triggered sector, with a minimum of two names; ties are broken by ticker identifier. This is deliberately a long-only, sector-balanced implementation because borrow availability and borrow cost are not available in the configured data and therefore cannot be validly assumed for a fragile-stock short leg. Allocate equal initial capital across triggered sectors and equal weight across selected names within each sector. Signals are generated after the close, entered at the next daily open, and each daily vintage is held for exactly six daily bars before exit at the next open; six overlapping vintages each receive one-sixth of the strategy capital. Sector neutrality is implemented through equal capital per active sector, and reported performance should be measured versus an equal-sector-weighted eligible-stock benchmark. Investability is constrained to the USD 5 million trailing-dollar-volume screen and a maximum position of 1% of trailing 20-day dollar volume for a USD 100 million reference portfolio; capital that cannot be deployed under this cap remains in cash. Apply a fixed 10 bp cost on every buy and sell, or 20 bp round trip, with no unsupported borrow-cost assumption.

"""The revised mechanism does not interpret elevated pre-report volatility as evidence that a public estimate revision contains superior private information. Instead, idiosyncratic range-variance acceleration is treated as a price-discovery and adverse-selection warning: when a stock has already experienced unusually rapid volatility acceleration relative to its sector, the information motivating a subsequent consensus change may already be reflected in price and implementation costs are likely elevated. The factor therefore seeks late-quarter estimate revisions only where sector-adjusted variance acceleration is subdued, consistent with slower diffusion of public analyst information into constrained institutional portfolios over the subsequent six sessions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _report_age(reset: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return bars elapsed since the latest point-in-time report reset."""
    n_rows, n_cols = reset.shape
    positions = pd.DataFrame(
        np.broadcast_to(np.arange(n_rows, dtype=float)[:, None], (n_rows, n_cols)),
        index=reset.index,
        columns=reset.columns,
    )
    latest_reset = positions.where(reset).ffill()
    return positions - latest_reset


def _finite_change_reset(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Identify actual-value updates relative to the preceding available value."""
    prior_available = actual.ffill().shift(1)
    current_valid = actual.notna() & ~actual.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    prior_valid = prior_available.notna() & ~prior_available.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    return current_valid & prior_valid & actual.ne(prior_available)


def _normalized_revision(
    estimate: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    lag: int,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute a lagged estimate revision with a causal cross-sectional floor."""
    prior = estimate.shift(lag)
    valid = (
        eligible
        & estimate.notna()
        & prior.notna()
        & ~estimate.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
        & ~prior.isin([np.inf, -np.inf])
    )
    prior_abs = prior.abs().where(valid)
    cross_sectional_floor = 0.01 * prior_abs.median(axis=1)
    denominator = prior.abs().where(
        prior.abs().ge(cross_sectional_floor, axis=0),
        cross_sectional_floor,
        axis=0,
    ).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    revision = ((estimate - prior) / denominator).where(valid)
    return revision.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _sector_acceleration_zscore(
    q: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Calculate sector robust z-scores, falling back to the eligible universe."""
    q_valid = q.where(eligible)
    universe_median = q_valid.median(axis=1)
    universe_mad = q_valid.sub(universe_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)

    labels = sector.ffill().iloc[-1].astype(object)
    labels = labels.where(labels.notna(), "__UNKNOWN_SECTOR__")
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=q.index, columns=q.columns, dtype=float)

    for _, members in labels.groupby(labels).groups.items():
        group_q = q_valid.loc[:, members]
        group_count = group_q.notna().sum(axis=1)
        group_median = group_q.median(axis=1)
        group_mad = group_q.sub(group_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        use_group = group_count.ge(5)
        location = group_median.where(use_group, universe_median)
        dispersion = group_mad.where(use_group, universe_mad)
        output.loc[:, members] = group_q.sub(location, axis=0).div(
            1.4826 * dispersion + 1e-12,
            axis=0,
        )

    return output.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


@register_factor
class ReportClockVarianceAccelerationRevision(BaseFactor):
    """Late-quarter revisions screened for sector-relative range-variance acceleration."""

    factor_id = "report_clock_variance_acceleration_revision"
    name = "Late-Clock Revision Diffusion with Variance-Completion Screen"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Ranks late-quarter EPS and revenue consensus revisions, then attenuates "
        "them when Parkinson range variance has accelerated unusually rapidly "
        "relative to the stock's sector."
    )
    window_length = 90
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "sector",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        if close.empty:
            return close.astype(float)

        eps_actual = data["epsActual"]
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"]
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"]
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"]

        reset = _finite_change_reset(eps_actual) | _finite_change_reset(revenue_actual)
        age = _report_age(reset)
        eligible = age.ge(35) & age.le(65)

        eps_revision = _normalized_revision(eps_estimate, eligible, 21)
        revenue_revision = _normalized_revision(revenue_estimate, eligible, 21)

        eps_score = 2.0 * eps_revision.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        revenue_score = 2.0 * revenue_revision.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0
        revision_score = 0.60 * eps_score + 0.40 * revenue_score

        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        valid_range = high.gt(0.0) & low.gt(0.0)
        range_ratio = high.where(valid_range) / low.where(valid_range)
        range_variance = np.log(range_ratio).pow(2) / (4.0 * np.log(2.0))

        short_variance = range_variance.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        long_variance = range_variance.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        acceleration = np.log((short_variance + 1e-12) / (long_variance + 1e-12))
        acceleration = acceleration.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        zscore = _sector_acceleration_zscore(acceleration, eligible, data["sector"])
        attenuation = zscore.clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0) / 2.0
        signal = revision_score * (1.0 - attenuation)

        valid_signal = eligible & revision_score.notna() & zscore.notna()
        return signal.where(valid_signal, 0.0).fillna(0.0).reindex(
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )

programs.code:
"""A broad industry move can coincide with one-day, stock-specific liquidity-demand imbalances: an extreme residual move accompanied by unusually high participation, an unusually large intraday range, and a close near that residual move's directional extreme is treated as a temporary price-pressure signature rather than as a generic disagreement signal. The strategy explicitly bets on reversal only for these pressure-signature residuals, going long negative residual receivers and short positive residual receivers after a material, broad, and unusually dispersed industry shock. The mechanism fails when the residual move reflects durable firm-specific information that is incorporated rapidly rather than temporary order imbalance."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _industry_leave_one_out_metrics(
    ret: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Compute causal same-day leave-one-out shocks, breadth, and dispersion."""
    shock = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    breadth = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)
    dispersion = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns, dtype=float)

    # Industry is static by contract. Reading the first row avoids using any
    # time-varying future classification information if a feed is sparse later.
    labels = industry.iloc[0]
    grouped = labels.groupby(labels).groups

    for _, members in grouped.items():
        if len(members) < 9:
            continue

        group_ret = ret.loc[:, members]
        values = group_ret.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        valid = np.isfinite(values)
        counts = valid.sum(axis=1)
        eligible = counts >= 9

        # Sorting valid observations permits an exact leave-one-out median for
        # every constituent without constructing a three-dimensional panel.
        filled = np.where(valid, values, np.inf)
        sorted_values = np.sort(filled, axis=1)
        order = np.argsort(filled, axis=1)
        inverse_order = np.empty_like(order)
        row_index = np.arange(values.shape[0])[:, None]
        inverse_order[row_index, order] = np.arange(values.shape[1])[None, :]

        peer_count = counts - 1
        lower_position = (peer_count - 1) // 2
        upper_position = peer_count // 2
        lower_original = lower_position[:, None] + (
            inverse_order <= lower_position[:, None]
        )
        upper_original = upper_position[:, None] + (
            inverse_order <= upper_position[:, None]
        )
        lower = np.take_along_axis(sorted_values, lower_original, axis=1)
        upper = np.take_along_axis(sorted_values, upper_original, axis=1)
        loo_median = (lower + upper) / 2.0
        loo_median = np.where(valid & eligible[:, None], loo_median, np.nan)

        positive = (values > 0.0) & valid
        negative = (values < 0.0) & valid
        positive_count = positive.sum(axis=1)[:, None] - positive.astype(int)
        negative_count = negative.sum(axis=1)[:, None] - negative.astype(int)
        matching_count = np.where(loo_median > 0.0, positive_count, negative_count)
        group_breadth = matching_count / np.where(peer_count[:, None] > 0, peer_count[:, None], np.nan)
        group_breadth = np.where(valid & eligible[:, None], group_breadth, np.nan)

        residual = values - loo_median
        residual_frame = pd.DataFrame(residual, index=ret.index, columns=members)
        residual_frame = residual_frame.where(valid & eligible[:, None])
        residual_median = residual_frame.median(axis=1)
        group_dispersion = residual_frame.sub(residual_median, axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)
        group_dispersion = group_dispersion.where(eligible)

        shock.loc[:, members] = loo_median
        breadth.loc[:, members] = group_breadth
        dispersion.loc[:, members] = np.repeat(
            group_dispersion.to_numpy()[:, None], len(members), axis=1
        )

    return shock, breadth, dispersion


@register_factor
class CommonShockAbsorptionDispersion(BaseFactor):
    """Reversal alpha for liquidity-pressure residuals following broad industry shocks."""

    factor_id = "common_shock_absorption_dispersion"
    name = "Industry Shock Liquidity-Pressure Reversal"
    category = "mean_reversion"
    description = (
        "Reverses stock-specific residual moves only when a broad, material, "
        "high-dispersion industry shock coincides with abnormal volume, range, "
        "and a directional close-location liquidity-pressure signature."
    )
    window_length = 61
    inputs = ["close", "open", "high", "low", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        return_valid = (
            close.notna()
            & previous_close.notna()
            & (close > 0.0)
            & (previous_close > 0.0)
        )
        ret = (close / previous_close - 1.0).where(return_valid)

        shock, breadth, dispersion = _industry_leave_one_out_metrics(
            ret, data["industry"]
        )
        peer_ok = shock.notna() & (shock != 0.0)

        available_shock = shock.abs().where(peer_ok)
        shock_threshold = available_shock.shift(1).rolling(
            60, min_periods=40
        ).quantile(0.80)
        material_shock = available_shock >= shock_threshold

        dispersion_threshold = dispersion.shift(1).rolling(
            60, min_periods=40
        ).quantile(0.80)
        abnormal_dispersion = (
            dispersion.notna()
            & (dispersion > 0.0)
            & (dispersion >= dispersion_threshold)
        )

        valid_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
        prior_volume_count = valid_volume.notna().astype(float).shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=20
        ).sum()
        prior_volume_median = valid_volume.shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=15
        ).median()
        volume_pressure = (
            (volume > 0.0)
            & (prior_volume_count >= 15.0)
            & prior_volume_median.notna()
            & (prior_volume_median != 0.0)
            & (volume / prior_volume_median >= 1.50)
        )

        positive_hlc = (high > 0.0) & (low > 0.0) & (close > 0.0)
        high_low = high - low
        valid_range = positive_hlc & (high_low > 0.0)
        intraday_range = ((high_low / close) - 1.0).where(valid_range)
        prior_range_count = intraday_range.notna().astype(float).shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=20
        ).sum()
        prior_range_median = intraday_range.shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=15
        ).median()
        range_pressure = (
            valid_range
            & (prior_range_count >= 15.0)
            & prior_range_median.notna()
            & (prior_range_median != 0.0)
            & (intraday_range / prior_range_median >= 1.50)
        )

        close_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / high_low - 1.0).where(valid_range)
        residual = ret - shock
        directional_close = residual.notna() & (
            np.sign(residual) * close_location >= 0.80
        )

        liquidity_valid = (
            (open_ > 0.0)
            & (high > 0.0)
            & (low > 0.0)
            & (close > 0.0)
            & (volume > 0.0)
            & (high_low > 0.0)
        )
        z_score = residual / (1.4826 * dispersion).replace(0.0, np.nan)

        qualifies = (
            return_valid
            & peer_ok
            & (breadth >= 0.70)
            & material_shock
            & abnormal_dispersion
            & liquidity_valid
            & volume_pressure
            & range_pressure
            & directional_close
            & (z_score.abs() >= 1.50)
        )
        return (-z_score).where(qualifies, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)

The strategy explicitly bets on reversal only for these pressure-signature residuals, going long negative residual receivers and short positive residual receivers after a material, broad, and unusually dispersed industry shock. The mechanism fails when the residual move reflects durable firm-specific information that is incorporated rapidly rather than temporary order imbalance.
programs.description: At the close of day t, compute each valid stock's one-day close-to-close return r_i,t = close_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1. A stock is invalid on t if either close is missing or nonpositive; it receives score 0. Industries use the static data['industry'] label. For stock i, require at least 8 other valid same-industry peers on t, and define its leave-one-out industry shock s_i,t as the median return of those peers. Define peer breadth b_i,t as the fraction of those peers whose nonzero return has the same sign as s_i,t; require b_i,t >= 0.70 and s_i,t != 0. Require the absolute shock to be material: |s_i,t| must be at least the 80th percentile of the previous 60 bars' available |s_i,u| values, with at least 40 prior valid observations. Define the residual e_i,t = r_i,t - s_i,t. For each industry-day with at least 9 valid stocks, compute robust residual dispersion D_g,t = median_i(|e_i,t - median_j(e_j,t)|). The industry is in the abnormal-dispersion regime only when D_g,t is at least the 80th percentile of its own previous 60 available daily D_g,u values, with at least 40 prior observations and D_g,t > 0. For liquidity-pressure confirmation, require valid positive open, high, low, close, and volume; volume_t / median(volume over the prior 20 bars) >= 1.50 using at least 15 valid prior volumes; range_t = (high_t-low_t)/close_t-1 and range_t / median(range over the prior 20 bars) >= 1.50 using at least 15 valid prior ranges; and directional close location sign(e_i,t) * (2*(close_t-low_t)/(high_t-low_t)-1) >= 0.80. A zero or negative high-low range, missing observation, zero median denominator, halted zero-volume bar, or failed history requirement produces score 0. Let z_i,t = e_i,t / (1.4826*D_g,t). The deterministic alpha score is A_i,t = -z_i,t only when all common-shock, breadth, dispersion, liquidity-pressure conditions hold and |z_i,t| >= 1.50; otherwise A_i,t = 0. No fundamental or earnings controls are used. Form the signal after the t close and execute no earlier than the t+1 open. Rebalance daily: within each qualifying industry, equal-weight the A>0 names on the long side and the A<0 names on the short side, with equal dollar long and short exposure for that industry; allocate equal gross exposure across qualifying industries. Each daily vintage is held for 6 bars, so the live portfolio is the equal-weight combination of the six overlapping daily vintages.
